```csharp
        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                string safeGroupName =
                    MakeSafeName(
                        group.Name);

                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        safeGroupName);

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupPath))
                {
                    currentGroupPath =
                        group.Name;
                }
                else
                {
                    currentGroupPath =
                        groupPath +
                        "\\" +
                        group.Name;
                }
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile +
                    "; ProtectionProvider=" +
                    providerAvailable);

            catch (Exception ex)

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(

        {
            Console.WriteLine(

            ExportTagTableCollection(

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath;

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    groupPath))
                {
                    newGroupPath =
                        groupName;
                }
                else
                {
                    newGroupPath =
                        groupPath +
                        "\\" +
                        groupName;
                }

                object tagTables =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables");

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    tagTables,
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                object childGroups =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups");

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    childGroups,
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    // WICHTIG:
                    // Bei WinCC Unified sitzt Export()
                    // nicht auf HmiTagTable selbst,
                    // sondern auf HmiTagTable.Tags.
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition der " +
                            "Tagtabelle nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "UnifiedTagTable",
                        "OK",
                        "Gruppe=" +
                        groupPath +
                        "; Ziel=" +
                        tableDirectory +
                        "; Dateien=" +
                        files.Count);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actualException =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actualException.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "UnifiedTagTable",
                        "ERROR",
                        actualException.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actualException.Message);
                }
            }
        }

                    csv.Append(

                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "Name")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetObjectNameProperty(
                                tag,
                                "TagTable")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "DataType")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetObjectNameProperty(
                                tag,
                                "Connection")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "PlcTag")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "Address")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "SymbolicAddress")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "AccessMode")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(

        // ============================================================
        // HMI CONNECTIONS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteConnections(
            string connectionsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string csvFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    connectionsDirectory,
                    "Connections.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;Type;Properties");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object connection
                    in connections)
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    string name =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            connection,
                            "Name");

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        name))
                    {
                        name =
                            "UnnamedConnection";
                    }

                    string properties =
                        GetSimplePropertiesText(
                            connection);

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .FullName));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(properties));

                    csv.AppendLine();

                    string nativeDirectory =
                        Path.Combine(
                            connectionsDirectory,
                            "Native",
                            MakeSafeName(
                                name));

                    try
                    {
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(
                            nativeDirectory);

                        List<string> exported =
                            InvokeNativeExport(
                                connection,
                                nativeDirectory,
                                name);

                        if (exported.Count > 0)
                        {
                            AddReport(
                                "HMI_CONNECTION_NATIVE",
                                device.Name,
                                name,
                                connection
                                    .GetType()
                                    .Name,
                                "OK",
                                exported.Count +
                                " native Datei(en) exportiert");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (NotSupportedException)
                    {
                        // Kein nativer Export vorhanden.
                        // Connections.csv bleibt erhalten.
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        HmiConnectionsFailed++;

                        Exception actualException =
                            UnwrapException(
                                ex);

                        AddReport(
                            "HMI_CONNECTION_NATIVE",
                            device.Name,
                            name,
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .Name,
                            "WARNING",
                            actualException
                                .GetType()
                                .Name +
                            ": " +
                            actualException.Message);
                    }
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                csvFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiConnectionsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: {count}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_CONNECTIONS",
                device.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "Connections.csv",
                "OK",
                $"{count} Verbindung(en) dokumentiert; " +
                $"Datei={csvFile}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // GENERIC NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            List<string> beforeFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo[] methods =
                exportObject
                    .GetType()
                    .GetMethods(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in methods)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(
                    method.Name,
                    "Export",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            object returnValue;

            if (twoParameters != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    twoParameters.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else if (oneParameter != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    oneParameter.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte native " +
                    "Export(DirectoryInfo...) " +
                    "Methode gefunden auf Typ " +
                    exportObject
                        .GetType()
                        .FullName);
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable files =
                returnValue
                as IEnumerable;

            if (files != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in files)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file != null)
                    {
                        if (!result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                        {
                            result.Add(
                                file.FullName);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            List<string> afterFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            foreach (
                string file
                in afterFiles)
            {
                if (!beforeFiles.Contains(
                        file) &&
                    !result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                files.Add(
                    file);
            }

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead)
                    continue;

                if (property
                    .GetIndexParameters()
                    .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type type =
                    value.GetType();

                if (!IsSimpleType(
                    type))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                {
                    text.Append(
                        " | ");
                }

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    value.ToString());
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                object value =
                    property.GetValue(
                        collection,
                        null);

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{name}: {value}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{name}: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // GENERAL HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "\"\"";

            return "\"" +
                   value.Replace(
                       "\"",
                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

        private class ReportEntry
        {
            public string Category
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string Device
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string ObjectName
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string ObjectType
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string Status
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string Details
            {
                get;
                set;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`.csproj` und `App.config` bleiben weiterhin unverändert.

Dann wieder:

```powershell
dotnet build
dotnet run
```

Der entscheidende Unterschied ist jetzt:

```csharp
object tags =
    GetPropertyValue(
        table,
        "Tags");

List<string> files =
    InvokeNativeExport(
        tags,
        tableDirectory,
        tableName);
```

und damit entspricht der Aufruf der von Siemens dokumentierten V21-Struktur `HmiTagTable.Tags.Export(DirectoryInfo, string)`. ([Siemens TIA](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/functions-for-accessing-the-data-of-an-hmi-unified-device/hmisoftware/tagtables/tagtable.tags.export?contentId=vGv7R7LqLCPDrcIiYLyM3A&utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Bei Erfolg sollten wir diesmal statt

```text
TagTable: Global    FEHLER
```

etwa Folgendes bekommen:

```text
TagTable: Global    OK (3 Dateien)
    Global.hmi.yml
    NameData.yml
    ...
```

Die genaue Zahl kann variieren. Siemens weist ausdrücklich darauf hin, dass neben der eigentlichen `.hmi.yml` unter anderem `NameData.yml`, ein `.ile`-Verzeichnis und bei Struktur-Tags zusätzliche `def.hmi.yml`-Dateien entstehen können. ([Siemens TIA](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/functions-for-accessing-the-data-of-an-hmi-unified-device/hmisoftware/tagtables/exporting-and-importing-tag-tables?contentId=c~Q5ydoG0Zy2i5dOG8rGrQ&utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```csharp
using Siemens.Engineering.HW;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW.Features;

using Siemens.Engineering.SW.Blocks;

namespace TiaOpennessTest
{
    internal class Program

        private static int HmiScriptExportsFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiPropertyEventsDocumented = 0;

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

                Console.WriteLine("SCHWERER FEHLER:");

                Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                   processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project =
                    tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"Projekt: {project.Name}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(
                        project.Name);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Archivziel:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    archiveRoot);

                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                foreach (
                    Device device
                    in project.Devices)
                {
                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            plcSoftware);
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            hmiSoftware);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteSummary(
                    archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(

            string archiveRoot =
                Path.Combine(

                    "_" +

            return archiveRoot;
        }

        private static void CreateBaseDirectories(

        private static void ExportPlc(

        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftware.Name}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftware.Name));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{ex.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                string safeGroupName =
                    MakeSafeName(
                        group.Name);

                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        safeGroupName);

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupPath))
                {
                    currentGroupPath =
                        group.Name;
                }
                else
                {
                    currentGroupPath =
                        groupPath +
                        "\\" +
                        group.Name;
                }
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile +
                    "; ProtectionProvider=" +
                    providerAvailable);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    ex.Message);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath;

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    groupPath))
                {
                    newGroupPath =
                        groupName;
                }
                else
                {
                    newGroupPath =
                        groupPath +
                        "\\" +
                        groupName;
                }

                object tagTables =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables");

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    tagTables,
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                object childGroups =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups");

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    childGroups,
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition der " +
                            "Tagtabelle nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "UnifiedTagTable",
                        "OK",
                        "Gruppe=" +
                        groupPath +
                        "; Ziel=" +
                        tableDirectory +
                        "; Dateien=" +
                        files.Count);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actualException =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actualException.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "UnifiedTagTable",
                        "ERROR",
                        actualException.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actualException.Message);
                }
            }
        }

                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "ReadOnly")));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiTagsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tags dokumentiert: {count}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_TAGS",
                device.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "Tags.csv",
                "OK",
                $"{count} Tags dokumentiert; " +
                $"Datei={file}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI CONNECTIONS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteConnections(
            string connectionsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string csvFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    connectionsDirectory,
                    "Connections.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;Type;Properties");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object connection
                    in connections)
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    string name =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            connection,
                            "Name");

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        name))
                    {
                        name =
                            "UnnamedConnection";
                    }

                    string properties =
                        GetSimplePropertiesText(
                            connection);

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .FullName));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(properties));

                    csv.AppendLine();

                    string nativeDirectory =
                        Path.Combine(
                            connectionsDirectory,
                            "Native",
                            MakeSafeName(
                                name));

                    try
                    {
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(
                            nativeDirectory);

                        List<string> exported =
                            InvokeNativeExport(
                                connection,
                                nativeDirectory,
                                name);

                        if (exported.Count > 0)
                        {
                            AddReport(
                                "HMI_CONNECTION_NATIVE",
                                device.Name,
                                name,
                                connection
                                    .GetType()
                                    .Name,
                                "OK",
                                exported.Count +
                                " native Datei(en) exportiert");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (NotSupportedException)
                    {
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        HmiConnectionsFailed++;

                        Exception actualException =
                            UnwrapException(
                                ex);

                        AddReport(
                            "HMI_CONNECTION_NATIVE",
                            device.Name,
                            name,
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .Name,
                            "WARNING",
                            actualException
                                .GetType()
                                .Name +
                            ": " +
                            actualException.Message);
                    }
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                csvFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiConnectionsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: {count}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_CONNECTIONS",
                device.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "Connections.csv",
                "OK",
                $"{count} Verbindung(en) dokumentiert; " +
                $"Datei={csvFile}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI SCREENS
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiScreens(
            string screensDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens: {hmiSoftware.Screens.Count}");

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenName,-30}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        screensDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            screenName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;

                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK " +
                        $"[{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        device.Name,
                        screenName,
                        screen.GetType().Name,
                        "OK",
                        $"Items={itemCount}; " +
                        $"Events={eventCount}; " +
                        $"Dynamizations={dynamizationCount}; " +
                        $"PropertyEvents={propertyEventCount}; " +
                        $"Ziel={screenDirectory}");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actualException =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actualException.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        device.Name,
                        screenName,
                        screen.GetType().Name,
                        "ERROR",
                        actualException
                            .GetType()
                            .Name +
                        ": " +
                        actualException.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        private static void WriteScreenInfo(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Name: " +
                $"{GetStringProperty(screen, "Name")}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $".NET-Typ: " +
                $"{screen.GetType().FullName}");

            text.AppendLine();

            string[] properties =
            {
                "DisplayName",
                "Width",
                "Height",
                "Enabled",
                "Visible",
                "BackgroundFillMode",
                "BackGraphicStretchMode"
            };

            foreach (
                string propertyName
                in properties)
            {
                object value =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        propertyName);

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{propertyName}: " +
                    $"{SafeToString(value)}");
            }

            object screenItems =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems");

            object eventHandlers =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "EventHandlers");

            object dynamizations =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "Dynamizations");

            object propertyEvents =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "PropertyEventHandlers");

            text.AppendLine();
            text.AppendLine(
                $"ScreenItems: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(screenItems)}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"EventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(eventHandlers)}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Dynamizations: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(dynamizations)}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PropertyEventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(propertyEvents)}");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static int WriteScreenItemsCsv(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenItems.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Index;Name;Type;FullType;" +
                "Left;Top;Width;Height;" +
                "Visible;Enabled;Text;" +
                "ProcessValue;Tag;Screen;ScreenName;" +
                "EventHandlers;Dynamizations;" +
                "PropertyEventHandlers");

            object collection =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems");

            IEnumerable items =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            int count =
                0;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(count.ToString()));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                item,
                                "Name")));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            item.GetType().Name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            item.GetType().FullName));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Left");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Top");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Width");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Height");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Visible");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Enabled");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Text");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ProcessValue");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Tag");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Screen");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ScreenName");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetCollectionCount(
                                GetPropertyValue(
                                    item,
                                    "EventHandlers"))
                            .ToString()));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetCollectionCount(
                                GetPropertyValue(
                                    item,
                                    "Dynamizations"))
                            .ToString()));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetCollectionCount(
                                GetPropertyValue(
                                    item,
                                    "PropertyEventHandlers"))
                            .ToString()));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    value == null
                        ? ""
                        : SafeToString(
                            value)));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            text.AppendLine(
                "SCREEN EVENTS");

            text.AppendLine(
                "=============");

            text.AppendLine();

            object screenEvents =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "EventHandlers");

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    screenEvents,
                    "Screen",
                    0);

            text.AppendLine();
            text.AppendLine(
                "SCREEN ITEM EVENTS");

            text.AppendLine(
                "==================");

            text.AppendLine();

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    int eventCount =
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            events);

                    if (eventCount == 0)
                        continue;

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        "--------------------------------------------------");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Objekt: {itemName}");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Typ: {item.GetType().FullName}");

                    text.AppendLine();

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            events,
                            itemName,
                            0);

                    text.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }
```
