```csharp
        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectCollection(
            StringBuilder text,
            object collection,
            string ownerName,
            int depth)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] {obj.GetType().Name}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: {obj.GetType().FullName}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);

                text.AppendLine();
            }

            if (count == 0)
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "<keine>");
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return;

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return;

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead)
                    continue;

                if (property
                    .GetIndexParameters()
                    .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: {actual.GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                Type valueType =
                    value.GetType();

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    int collectionCount =
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            value);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({collectionCount})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        int index =
                            0;

                        foreach (
                            object child
                            in enumerable)
                        {
                            index++;

                            if (child == null)
                            {
                                text.AppendLine(
                                    $"{indent}  [{index}] null");

                                continue;
                            }

                            if (IsSimpleType(
                                child.GetType()))
                            {
                                text.AppendLine(
                                    $"{indent}  [{index}] " +
                                    $"{SafeToString(child)}");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                text.AppendLine(
                                    $"{indent}  [{index}] " +
                                    $"{child.GetType().FullName}");

                                DumpObjectProperties(
                                    text,
                                    child,
                                    indent + "    ",
                                    depth + 1,
                                    maxDepth);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{valueType.FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    valueType) &&
                    depth + 1 < maxDepth)
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string property =
                propertyName
                    .ToLowerInvariant();

            if (property.Contains(
                    "script") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "trigger") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "tag") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "action") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "parameter") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "converter") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "mapping") ||
                property.Contains(
                    "reference"))
            {
                return true;
            }

            string typeName =
                valueType.FullName
                ?? valueType.Name;

            typeName =
                typeName.ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                typeName.Contains(
                    "script") ||
                typeName.Contains(
                    "trigger") ||
                typeName.Contains(
                    "tag") ||
                typeName.Contains(
                    "action") ||
                typeName.Contains(
                    "converter") ||
                typeName.Contains(
                    "mapping");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // GENERIC NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            List<string> beforeFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo[] methods =
                exportObject
                    .GetType()
                    .GetMethods(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in methods)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(
                    method.Name,
                    "Export",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            object returnValue;

            if (twoParameters != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    twoParameters.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else if (oneParameter != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    oneParameter.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte native " +
                    "Export(DirectoryInfo...) " +
                    "Methode gefunden auf Typ " +
                    exportObject
                        .GetType()
                        .FullName);
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable files =
                returnValue
                as IEnumerable;

            if (files != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in files)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file != null)
                    {
                        if (!result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                        {
                            result.Add(
                                file.FullName);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            List<string> afterFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            foreach (
                string file
                in afterFiles)
            {
                if (!beforeFiles.Contains(
                        file) &&
                    !result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                files.Add(
                    file);
            }

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead)
                    continue;

                if (property
                    .GetIndexParameters()
                    .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type type =
                    value.GetType();

                if (!IsSimpleType(
                    type))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                {
                    text.Append(
                        " | ");
                }

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(
                        value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo countProperty =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (countProperty != null)
                {
                    object countValue =
                        countProperty.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (countValue != null)
                    {
                        return Convert.ToInt32(
                            countValue);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection
                as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "<ToString nicht verfügbar>";
            }
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{name}: " +
                    $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{name}: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category = category,
                    Device = device,
                    ObjectName = objectName,
                    ObjectType = objectType,
                    Status = status,
                    Details = details
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Category));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Device));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.ObjectName));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.ObjectType));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Status));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static void WriteSummary(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string summaryFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "Summary.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA PROJECT ARCHIVE - SUMMARY");

            text.AppendLine(
                "=============================");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Exportdatum: " +
                $"{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PLCs: {PlcCount}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Unified HMIs: {HmiCount}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PLC-Bausteine exportiert: " +
                $"{PlcBlocksExported}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PLC-Bausteinfehler: " +
                $"{PlcBlocksFailed}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Scriptdateien exportiert: " +
                $"{HmiScriptFilesExported}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Scriptexporte fehlgeschlagen: " +
                $"{HmiScriptExportsFailed}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Tagtabellen exportiert: " +
                $"{HmiTagTablesExported}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Tagtabellenfehler: " +
                $"{HmiTagTablesFailed}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Tagdateien exportiert: " +
                $"{HmiTagFilesExported}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Tags dokumentiert: " +
                $"{HmiTagsDocumented}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Verbindungen dokumentiert: " +

            text.AppendLine(

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(

                $"{HmiScreensDocumented}");

            text.AppendLine(

                $"{HmiScreenItemsDocumented}");

            text.AppendLine(

            text.AppendLine(

            File.WriteAllText(

            Console.WriteLine(

            Console.WriteLine();

            Console.WriteLine(

            Console.WriteLine();

            Console.WriteLine(

            Console.WriteLine(

        // ============================================================
        // GENERAL HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "\"\"";

            return "\"" +
                   value.Replace(
                       "\"",
                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

        private class ReportEntry
        {
            public string Category
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string Device
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            {

                set;
            }

            public string ObjectType
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string Status
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string Details
            {
                get;
                set;
            }
        }
    }
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;

using Siemens.Engineering;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW.Features;

using Siemens.Engineering.SW;
using Siemens.Engineering.SW.Blocks;

using Siemens.Engineering.HmiUnified;

namespace TiaOpennessTest
{
    internal class Program
    {
        private static readonly List<ReportEntry> ReportEntries =
            new List<ReportEntry>();

        private static int PlcCount = 0;
        private static int HmiCount = 0;

        private static int PlcBlocksExported = 0;
        private static int PlcBlocksFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiScriptFilesExported = 0;
        private static int HmiScriptExportsFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiTagTablesExported = 0;
        private static int HmiTagTablesFailed = 0;
        private static int HmiTagFilesExported = 0;
        private static int HmiTagsDocumented = 0;

        private static int HmiConnectionsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiConnectionsFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiScreensDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiScreenItemsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiScreenEventsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiDynamizationsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiPropertyEventsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiScreenDocumentationFailed = 0;

        private static int HardwareDevicesDocumented = 0;
        private static int HardwareItemsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HardwareErrors = 0;

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            try
            {
                RunExport();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("SCHWERER FEHLER:");
                Console.WriteLine(ex.GetType().FullName);
                Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                   processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project =
                    tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"Projekt: {project.Name}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(
                        project.Name);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Archivziel:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    archiveRoot);

                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                ExportHardware(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                foreach (
                    Device device
                    in project.Devices)
                {
                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            plcSoftware);
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            hmiSoftware);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteSummary(
                    archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // ARCHIVE
        // ============================================================

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(
            string projectName)
        {
            string safeProjectName =
                MakeSafeName(
                    projectName);

            string timestamp =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

            string archiveRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    @"C:\TiaProjectArchive",
                    safeProjectName +
                    "_" +
                    timestamp);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                archiveRoot);

            return archiveRoot;
        }

        private static void CreateBaseDirectories(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report"));
        }

        private static void WriteProjectInfo(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project",
                    "ProjectInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA Project Archive");

            text.AppendLine(
                "===================");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Projektname: {project.Name}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Projektpfad: {project.Path}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "Projektpfad: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Exportdatum: " +
                $"{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA-Version: V21");

            text.AppendLine(
                ".NET Framework: 4.8");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HARDWARE
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHardware(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "HARDWARE");

            string hardwareRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware");

            string devicesFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "Devices.csv");

            string treeFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "HardwareTree.txt");

            StringBuilder devicesCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder tree =
                new StringBuilder();

            devicesCsv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TypeIdentifier;IsGsd;" +
                "TypeName;OrderNumber;FirmwareVersion;" +
                "Author;Comment;PlantDesignation;" +
                "LocationIdentifier;GsdName;GsdType;GsdId");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "TIA HARDWARE TREE");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "=================");

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                try
                {
                    ExportHardwareDevice(
                        hardwareRoot,
                        device,
                        devicesCsv,
                        tree);

                    HardwareDevicesDocumented++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HardwareErrors++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"  Gerät {device.Name}: FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"    {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                        device.Name,
                        device.Name,
                        "Device",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                devicesFile,
                devicesCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                treeFile,
                tree.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Geräte dokumentiert: " +
                $"{HardwareDevicesDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Hardwareobjekte: " +
                $"{HardwareItemsDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                deviceItem.Name;

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string isPlugged =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged");

            string isBuiltIn =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn");

            string classification =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification");

            string typeName =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            string author =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author");

            string comment =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment");

            string plantDesignation =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation");

            string locationIdentifier =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier");

            string gsdName =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName");

            string gsdType =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType");

            string gsdId =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId");

            string isGsd =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd");

            string isProfinet =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet");

            string isProfibus =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfibus");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(path));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(level.ToString()));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(name));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(typeIdentifier));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(position));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(isPlugged));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(isBuiltIn));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(classification));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(typeName));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(orderNumber));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(firmware));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(author));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(comment));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(plantDesignation));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(locationIdentifier));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(gsdName));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(gsdType));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(gsdId));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(isGsd));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(isProfinet));

            csv.Append(";");

            csv.Append(
                Csv(isProfibus));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");

            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                if (value == null)
                    return "";

                return SafeToString(
                    value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftware.Name}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftware.Name));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{ex.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                string safeGroupName =
                    MakeSafeName(
                        group.Name);

                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        safeGroupName);

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupPath))
                {
                    currentGroupPath =
                        group.Name;
                }
                else
                {
                    currentGroupPath =
                        groupPath +
                        "\\" +
                        group.Name;
                }
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile +
                    "; ProtectionProvider=" +
                    providerAvailable);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    ex.Message);
            }
        }
```
