```csharp
        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                object tagTables =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables");

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    tagTables,
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                object childGroups =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups");

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    childGroups,
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition der " +
                            "Tagtabelle nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "UnifiedTagTable",
                        "OK",
                        "Gruppe=" +
                        groupPath +
                        "; Ziel=" +
                        tableDirectory +
                        "; Dateien=" +
                        files.Count);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "UnifiedTagTable",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI TAGS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagsCsv(
            string tagsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    tagsDirectory,
                    "Tags.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TagTable;DataType;Connection;" +
                "PlcTag;Address;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "AccessMode;AcquisitionCycle;" +
                "AcquisitionMode;ReadOnly");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "DataType"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AccessMode"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionCycle"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionMode"));

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "ReadOnly")));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiTagsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tags dokumentiert: {count}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_TAGS",
                device.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "Tags.csv",
                "OK",
                $"{count} Tags dokumentiert; " +
                $"Datei={file}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI CONNECTIONS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteConnections(
            string connectionsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string csvFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    connectionsDirectory,
                    "Connections.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;Type;Properties");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object connection
                    in connections)
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    string name =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            connection,
                            "Name");

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        name))
                    {
                        name =
                            "UnnamedConnection";
                    }

                    string properties =
                        GetSimplePropertiesText(
                            connection);

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .FullName));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(properties));

                    csv.AppendLine();

                    string nativeDirectory =
                        Path.Combine(
                            connectionsDirectory,
                            "Native",
                            MakeSafeName(
                                name));

                    try
                    {
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(
                            nativeDirectory);

                        List<string> exported =
                            InvokeNativeExport(
                                connection,
                                nativeDirectory,
                                name);

                        if (exported.Count > 0)
                        {
                            AddReport(
                                "HMI_CONNECTION_NATIVE",
                                device.Name,
                                name,
                                connection
                                    .GetType()
                                    .Name,
                                "OK",
                                exported.Count +
                                " native Datei(en) exportiert");
                        }
                    }
                    catch (NotSupportedException)
                    {
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        HmiConnectionsFailed++;

                        Exception actual =
                            UnwrapException(
                                ex);

                        AddReport(
                            "HMI_CONNECTION_NATIVE",
                            device.Name,
                            name,
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .Name,
                            "WARNING",
                            actual.GetType().Name +
                            ": " +
                            actual.Message);
                    }
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                csvFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiConnectionsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: {count}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_CONNECTIONS",
                device.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "Connections.csv",
                "OK",
                $"{count} Verbindung(en) dokumentiert; " +
                $"Datei={csvFile}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI SCREENS
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiScreens(
            string screensDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens: {hmiSoftware.Screens.Count}");

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenName,-30}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        screensDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            screenName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;
                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented += itemCount;
                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented += eventCount;
                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented += dynamizationCount;
                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented += propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        device.Name,
                        screenName,
                        screen.GetType().Name,
                        "OK",
                        $"Items={itemCount}; " +
                        $"Events={eventCount}; " +
                        $"Dynamizations={dynamizationCount}; " +
                        $"PropertyEvents={propertyEventCount}; " +
                        $"Ziel={screenDirectory}");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        device.Name,
                        screenName,
                        screen.GetType().Name,
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        private static void WriteScreenInfo(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Name: " +
                $"{GetStringProperty(screen, "Name")}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $".NET-Typ: " +
                $"{screen.GetType().FullName}");

            text.AppendLine();

            string[] properties =
            {
                "DisplayName",
                "Width",
                "Height",
                "Enabled",
                "Visible",
                "BackgroundFillMode",
                "BackGraphicStretchMode"
            };

            foreach (
                string propertyName
                in properties)
            {
                object value =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        propertyName);

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{propertyName}: " +
                    $"{SafeToString(value)}");
            }

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"ScreenItems: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "ScreenItems"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"EventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "EventHandlers"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Dynamizations: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "Dynamizations"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PropertyEventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "PropertyEventHandlers"))}");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static int WriteScreenItemsCsv(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenItems.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Index;Name;Type;FullType;" +
                "Left;Top;Width;Height;" +
                "Visible;Enabled;Text;" +
                "ProcessValue;Tag;Screen;ScreenName;" +
                "EventHandlers;Dynamizations;" +
                "PropertyEventHandlers");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            int count =
                0;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        count.ToString());

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        item.GetType().Name);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        item.GetType().FullName);

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Left");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Top");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Width");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Height");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Visible");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Enabled");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Text");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ProcessValue");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Tag");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Screen");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ScreenName");

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            GetPropertyValue(
                                item,
                                "EventHandlers"))
                        .ToString());

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            GetPropertyValue(
                                item,
                                "Dynamizations"))
                        .ToString());

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetCollectionCount(
                                GetPropertyValue(
                                    item,
                                    "PropertyEventHandlers"))
                            .ToString()));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            text.AppendLine(
                "SCREEN EVENTS");

            text.AppendLine(
                "=============");

            text.AppendLine();

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "EventHandlers"),
                    "Screen");

            text.AppendLine();
            text.AppendLine(
                "SCREEN ITEM EVENTS");

            text.AppendLine(
                "==================");

            text.AppendLine();

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (GetCollectionCount(
                            events) == 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        "--------------------------------------------------");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Objekt: {itemName}");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Typ: {item.GetType().FullName}");

                    text.AppendLine();

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            events,
                            itemName);

                    text.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectCollection(
            StringBuilder text,
            object collection,
            string ownerName)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] {obj.GetType().Name}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: {obj.GetType().FullName}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);

                text.AppendLine();
            }

            if (count == 0)
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "<keine>");
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead)
                    continue;

                if (property
                    .GetIndexParameters()
                    .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: {actual.GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                Type valueType =
                    value.GetType();

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    int collectionCount =
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            value);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({collectionCount})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        int index =
                            0;

                        foreach (
                            object child
                            in enumerable)
                        {
                            index++;

                            if (child == null)
                                continue;

                            if (IsSimpleType(
                                child.GetType()))
                            {
                                text.AppendLine(
                                    $"{indent}  [{index}] " +
                                    $"{SafeToString(child)}");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                text.AppendLine(
                                    $"{indent}  [{index}] " +
                                    $"{child.GetType().FullName}");

                                DumpObjectProperties(
                                    text,
                                    child,
                                    indent + "    ",
                                    depth + 1,
                                    maxDepth);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{valueType.FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    valueType) &&
                    depth + 1 < maxDepth)
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string property =
                propertyName
                    .ToLowerInvariant();

            if (property.Contains("script") ||
                property.Contains("trigger") ||
                property.Contains("tag") ||
                property.Contains("action") ||
                property.Contains("parameter") ||
                property.Contains("converter") ||
                property.Contains("mapping") ||
                property.Contains("reference"))
            {
                return true;
            }

            string typeName =
                valueType.FullName
                ?? valueType.Name;

            typeName =
                typeName.ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                typeName.Contains("script") ||
                typeName.Contains("trigger") ||
                typeName.Contains("tag") ||
                typeName.Contains("action") ||
                typeName.Contains("converter") ||
                typeName.Contains("mapping");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // GENERIC NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            List<string> beforeFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo[] methods =
                exportObject
                    .GetType()
                    .GetMethods(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in methods)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(
                    method.Name,
                    "Export",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            object returnValue;

            if (twoParameters != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    twoParameters.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else if (oneParameter != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    oneParameter.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte native " +
                    "Export(DirectoryInfo...) " +
                    "Methode gefunden auf Typ " +
                    exportObject
                        .GetType()
                        .FullName);
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable files =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (files != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in files)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file != null &&
                        !result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            List<string> afterFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            foreach (
                string file
                in afterFiles)
            {
                if (!beforeFiles.Contains(
                        file) &&
                    !result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                files.Add(
                    file);
            }

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION / HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                name)
                ? name
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null ||
                    !IsSimpleType(
                        value.GetType()))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                {
                    text.Append(
                        " | ");
                }

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(
                        value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo countProperty =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (countProperty != null)
                {
                    object countValue =
                        countProperty.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (countValue != null)
                    {
                        return Convert.ToInt32(
                            countValue);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "<ToString nicht verfügbar>";
            }
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(
                        value));
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category = category,
                    Device = device,
                    ObjectName = objectName,
                    ObjectType = objectType,
                    Status = status,
                    Details = details
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Category));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Device));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.ObjectName));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.ObjectType));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Status));

                csv.Append(";");

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "\"\"";

            return "\"" +
                   value.Replace(
                       "\"",
                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

        private class ReportEntry

            public string Category { get; set; }
            public string Device { get; set; }
            public string ObjectName { get; set; }
            public string ObjectType { get; set; }

            public string Details { get; set; }
        }
```

Die verwendeten Hardwareinformationen entsprechen den von Siemens für V21 dokumentierten Device-/DeviceItem-Zugriffen. Insbesondere werden `TypeIdentifier`, Steckposition sowie die dynamischen Identifikationsattribute ausgelesen; dynamische Attribute sind nicht zwingend bei jedem Hardwareobjekt vorhanden, deshalb behandelt der Exporter fehlende Werte bewusst als leere Felder statt als Fehler. Gut. Ich baue jetzt den ersten **Beziehungs-Export** ein: HMI-Tag → Connection → PLC-Referenz sowie Fundstellen in Screens/Dynamisierungen. Unklare Zuordnungen werden ausdrücklich als „nicht aufgelöst“ markiert, statt geraten.

Die Siemens-V21-Doku bestätigt dabei die entscheidenden Felder: Unified-Tags tragen `Connection`, `PlcTag`, `SymbolicAddress` und `Address`; Connections sind eigene HMI-Objekte. Das reicht für eine belastbare erste Querverknüpfung, ohne Zuordnungen zu erfinden.

Wir ergänzen jetzt den bestehenden Exporter um eine zusätzliche Ebene:

```text
20_HMI\
└─ <HMI>\
   └─ Relationships\
      └─ HmiTagToPlc.csv
```

Die Datei enthält pro HMI-Tag:

```text
HMI-Tag
Tagtabelle
Datentyp
Connection
PLC-Tag
SymbolicAddress
Address
AccessMode
zugeordnete PLC
Auflösungsstatus
Verwendung in ScreenItems
Verwendung in Dynamisierungen
Verwendung in Events
Connection-Eigenschaften
```

Wichtig: Eine PLC wird nur dann eingetragen, wenn sie aus den Connection-Daten tatsächlich identifizierbar ist. Andernfalls steht dort `UNRESOLVED`. Das ist für ein technisches Archiv wesentlich besser als eine vermutete Zuordnung. Siemens bestätigt für Unified-Tags genau die Felder `Connection`, `PlcTag`, `SymbolicAddress` und `Address`; symbolische PLC-Verknüpfungen werden über diese Beziehung geführt. ([Siemens TIA](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/functions-for-accessing-the-data-of-an-hmi-unified-device/hmisoftware/tagtables/exporting-and-importing-tag-tables?contentId=c~Q5ydoG0Zy2i5dOG8rGrQ&utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;

using Siemens.Engineering;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW.Features;

using Siemens.Engineering.SW;
using Siemens.Engineering.SW.Blocks;

using Siemens.Engineering.HmiUnified;

namespace TiaOpennessTest
{
    internal class Program
    {
        private static readonly List<ReportEntry> ReportEntries =
            new List<ReportEntry>();

        private static int PlcCount = 0;
        private static int HmiCount = 0;

        private static int PlcBlocksExported = 0;
        private static int PlcBlocksFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiScriptFilesExported = 0;
        private static int HmiScriptExportsFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiTagTablesExported = 0;
        private static int HmiTagTablesFailed = 0;
        private static int HmiTagFilesExported = 0;

        private static int HmiConnectionsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiConnectionsFailed = 0;

        private static int HmiScreensDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiScreenItemsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiScreenEventsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiDynamizationsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiPropertyEventsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HmiScreenDocumentationFailed = 0;

        private static int HardwareDevicesDocumented = 0;
        private static int HardwareItemsDocumented = 0;
        private static int HardwareErrors = 0;

        private static int RelationshipsDocumented = 0;
        private static int RelationshipsResolvedToPlc = 0;
        private static int RelationshipsUnresolved = 0;
        private static int RelationshipScreenUsages = 0;

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            try
            {
                RunExport();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("SCHWERER FEHLER:");
                Console.WriteLine(ex.GetType().FullName);
                Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                   processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project =
                    tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"Projekt: {project.Name}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(
                        project.Name);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("Archivziel:");
                Console.WriteLine(archiveRoot);
                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                ExportHardware(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                List<PlcReference> plcReferences =
                    BuildPlcReferences(
                        project);

                foreach (
                    Device device
                    in project.Devices)
                {
                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            plcSoftware);
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            hmiSoftware,
                            plcReferences);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteSummary(
                    archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // ARCHIVE
        // ============================================================

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(
            string projectName)
        {
            string safeProjectName =
                MakeSafeName(
                    projectName);

            string timestamp =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

            string archiveRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    @"C:\TiaProjectArchive",
                    safeProjectName +
                    "_" +
                    timestamp);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                archiveRoot);

            return archiveRoot;
        }

        private static void CreateBaseDirectories(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report"));
        }

        private static void WriteProjectInfo(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project",
                    "ProjectInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine("TIA Project Archive");
            text.AppendLine("===================");
            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Projektname: {project.Name}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Projektpfad: {project.Path}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "Projektpfad: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Exportdatum: {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA-Version: V21");

            text.AppendLine(
                ".NET Framework: 4.8");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

        // ============================================================
        // HARDWARE
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHardware(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "HARDWARE");

            string hardwareRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware");

            string devicesFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "Devices.csv");

            string treeFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "HardwareTree.txt");

            StringBuilder devicesCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder tree =
                new StringBuilder();

            devicesCsv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TypeIdentifier;IsGsd;" +
                "TypeName;OrderNumber;FirmwareVersion;" +
                "Author;Comment;PlantDesignation;" +
                "LocationIdentifier;GsdName;GsdType;GsdId");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "TIA HARDWARE TREE");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "=================");

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                try
                {
                    ExportHardwareDevice(
                        hardwareRoot,
                        device,
                        devicesCsv,
                        tree);

                    HardwareDevicesDocumented++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HardwareErrors++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"  Gerät {device.Name}: FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"    {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                        device.Name,
                        device.Name,
                        "Device",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                devicesFile,
                devicesCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                treeFile,
                tree.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Geräte dokumentiert: " +
                $"{HardwareDevicesDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Hardwareobjekte: " +
                $"{HardwareItemsDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportHardwareDevice(
            string hardwareRoot,
            Device device,
            StringBuilder devicesCsv,
            StringBuilder tree)
        {
            string deviceName =
                device.Name;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gerät: {deviceName}");

            string deviceDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        deviceName));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                deviceDirectory);

            string itemsFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    deviceDirectory,
                    "DeviceItems.csv");

            StringBuilder itemsCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            itemsCsv.AppendLine(
                "Path;Level;Name;TypeIdentifier;" +
                "PositionNumber;IsPlugged;IsBuiltIn;" +
                "Classification;TypeName;OrderNumber;" +
                "FirmwareVersion;Author;Comment;" +
                "PlantDesignation;LocationIdentifier;" +
                "GsdName;GsdType;GsdId;" +
                "IsGsd;IsProfinet;IsProfibus");

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                deviceName);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                typeIdentifier);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "FirmwareVersion"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdType"));

            devicesCsv.Append(
                Csv(
                    GetDynamicAttribute(
                        device,
                        "GsdId")));

            devicesCsv.AppendLine();

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"DEVICE: {deviceName}");

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"  TypeIdentifier: {typeIdentifier}");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.AppendLine(
                    $"  OrderNumber: {orderNumber}");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                DeviceItem deviceItem
                in device.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    deviceItem,
                    itemsCsv,
                    tree,
                    deviceName,
                    0);
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            File.WriteAllText(
                itemsFile,
                itemsCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                deviceName,
                deviceName,
                "Device",
                "OK",
                "TypeIdentifier=" +
                typeIdentifier +
                "; Datei=" +
                itemsFile);
        }

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                deviceItem.Name;

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            AppendCsvValue(csv, path);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, level.ToString());
            AppendCsvValue(csv, name);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, typeIdentifier);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, position);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                orderNumber);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                firmware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet"));

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    SafeProperty(
                        deviceItem,
                        "IsProfibus")));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");
            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC REFERENCES FOR RELATIONSHIP RESOLUTION
        // ============================================================

        private static List<PlcReference> BuildPlcReferences(
            Project project)
        {
            List<PlcReference> result =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(
                        device);

                if (plcSoftware == null)
                    continue;

                PlcReference reference =
                    new PlcReference();

                reference.DeviceName =
                    device.Name;

                reference.SoftwareName =
                    plcSoftware.Name;

                result.Add(
                    reference);
            }

            return result;
        }
```
