        // PLC EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftware.Name}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftware.Name));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{ex.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            group.Name));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                currentGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? group.Name
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      group.Name;
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;
                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // TAG LIST
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagsCsv(
            string tagsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    tagsDirectory,
                    "Tags.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TagTable;DataType;Connection;" +
                "PlcTag;Address;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "AccessMode;AcquisitionCycle;" +
                "AcquisitionMode;ReadOnly");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "DataType"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AccessMode"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionCycle"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionMode"));

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "ReadOnly")));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiTagsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tags dokumentiert: {count}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // CONNECTIONS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteConnections(
            string connectionsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string csvFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    connectionsDirectory,
                    "Connections.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;Type;Properties");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object connection
                    in connections)
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    string name =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            connection,
                            "Name");

                    string properties =
                        GetSimplePropertiesText(
                            connection);

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .FullName));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(properties));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                csvFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiConnectionsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: {count}");
        }

        private static void ExportHmiScreens(
            string screensDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens: {hmiSoftware.Screens.Count}");

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenName,-30}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        screensDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            screenName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;
                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static void WriteScreenInfo(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Name: " +
                $"{GetStringProperty(screen, "Name")}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $".NET-Typ: " +
                $"{screen.GetType().FullName}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"ScreenItems: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "ScreenItems"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"EventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "EventHandlers"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Dynamizations: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "Dynamizations"))}");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

                        csv,

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,

                        "Visible");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Enabled");

                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Text");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,

        private static void WriteHmiTagRelationships(
            string relationshipsDirectory,
            Device hmiDevice,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "HmiTagToPlc.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "HmiDevice;HmiSoftware;HmiTag;TagTable;" +
                "DataType;Connection;PlcTag;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "Address;AccessMode;ResolvedPlcDevice;" +
                "ResolvedPlcSoftware;ResolutionStatus;" +
                "ScreenUsage;DynamizationUsage;EventUsage;" +
                "ConnectionProperties");

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            int localCount =
                0;

            int localResolved =
                0;

            int localUnresolved =
                0;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    localCount++;
                    RelationshipsDocumented++;

                    string tagName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name");

                    string connectionName =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection");

                    string plcTag =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag");

                    string symbolicAddress =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress");

                    object connection =
                        FindNamedObject(
                            hmiSoftware.Connections,
                            connectionName);

                    string connectionProperties =
                        "";

                    string resolvedDevice =
                        "";

                    string resolvedSoftware =
                        "";

                    string resolutionStatus =
                        "";

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        connectionName))
                    {
                        resolutionStatus =
                            "INTERNAL_OR_NO_CONNECTION";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (connection != null)
                        {
                            connectionProperties =
                                GetDeepReadableText(
                                    connection,
                                    0,
                                    2);
                        }

                        PlcReference resolved =
                            ResolvePlcReference(
                                connectionProperties,
                                plcReferences);

                        if (resolved != null)
                        {
                            resolvedDevice =
                                resolved.DeviceName;

                            resolvedSoftware =
                                resolved.SoftwareName;

                            resolutionStatus =
                                "RESOLVED_FROM_CONNECTION";

                            RelationshipsResolvedToPlc++;
                            localResolved++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            resolutionStatus =
                                "UNRESOLVED";

                            RelationshipsUnresolved++;
                            localUnresolved++;
                        }
                    }

                    UsageResult usage =
                        FindHmiTagUsage(
                            hmiSoftware,
                            tagName);

                    RelationshipScreenUsages +=
                        usage.TotalUsageCount;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        hmiDevice.Name);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        hmiSoftware.Name);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        tagName);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "DataType"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        connectionName);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        plcTag);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        symbolicAddress);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AccessMode"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        resolvedDevice);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        resolvedSoftware);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        resolutionStatus);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        string.Join(
                            " | ",
                            usage.ScreenItems));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        string.Join(
                            " | ",
                            usage.Dynamizations));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        string.Join(
                            " | ",
                            usage.Events));

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            NormalizeSingleLine(
                                connectionProperties)));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Beziehungen dokumentiert: {localCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    PLC aufgelöst: {localResolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    nicht aufgelöst: {localUnresolved}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_RELATIONSHIPS",
                hmiDevice.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "HmiTagToPlc.csv",
                "OK",
                "Tags=" +
                localCount +
                "; Resolved=" +
                localResolved +
                "; Unresolved=" +
                localUnresolved +
                "; Datei=" +
                file);
        }

        private static object FindNamedObject(
            object collection,
            string name)
        {
            if (collection == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
            {
                return null;
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return null;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                string candidate =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        obj,
                        "Name");

                if (string.Equals(
                    candidate,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return obj;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static PlcReference ResolvePlcReference(
            string connectionText,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connectionText) ||
                plcReferences == null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            List<PlcReference> matches =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                PlcReference plc
                in plcReferences)
            {
                bool match =
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.DeviceName) ||
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.SoftwareName);

                if (match)
                {
                    matches.Add(
                        plc);
                }
            }

            if (matches.Count == 1)
            {
                return matches[0];
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static UsageResult FindHmiTagUsage(
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            string tagName)
        {
            UsageResult result =
                new UsageResult();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                tagName))
            {
                return result;
            }

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                IEnumerable items =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "ScreenItems")
                    as IEnumerable;

                if (items == null)
                    continue;

                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    string reference =
                        screenName +
                        "/" +
                        itemName;

                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        item,
                        tagName,
                        0,
                        1))
                    {
                        AddUnique(
                            result.ScreenItems,
                            reference);
                    }

                    object dynamizations =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "Dynamizations");

                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        dynamizations,
                        tagName,
                        0,
                        4))
                    {
                        AddUnique(
                            result.Dynamizations,
                            reference);
                    }

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        events,
                        tagName,
                        0,
                        4))
                    {
                        AddUnique(
                            result.Events,
                            reference);
                    }
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static bool ObjectContainsTagReference(
            object obj,
            string tagName,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return false;
            }

            string textValue =
                obj as string;

            if (textValue != null)
            {
                return ContainsTagText(
                    textValue,
                    tagName);
            }

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return ContainsTagText(
                    SafeToString(
                        obj),
                    tagName);
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                obj as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable != null &&
                !(obj is string))
            {
                foreach (
                    object child
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        child,
                        tagName,
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth))
                    {
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                return false;
            }

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return false;

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                    value,
                    tagName,
                    depth + 1,
                    maxDepth))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
            string name)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems"
            };

            foreach (
                string value
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    value,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ContainsTagText(
            string value,
            string tagName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    value) ||
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    tagName))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (string.Equals(
                value,
                tagName,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (value.IndexOf(
                    "\"" + tagName + "\"",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (value.IndexOf(
                    "'" + tagName + "'",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0)
            {
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string GetDeepReadableText(
            object obj,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return "";
            }

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return SafeToString(
                    obj);
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType =
                    value.GetType();

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.Append(
                        property.Name);

                    text.Append("=");

                    text.Append(
                        SafeToString(
                            value));

                    text.Append(" | ");
                }
                else if (depth < maxDepth)
                {
                    string nested =
                        GetDeepReadableText(
                            value,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        nested))
                    {
                        text.Append(
                            property.Name);

                        text.Append("={");
                        text.Append(nested);
                        text.Append("} | ");
                    }
                }
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static void AddUnique(
            List<string> list,
            string value)
        {
            if (list == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!list.Contains(
                value))
            {
                list.Add(
                    value);
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsText(
            string source,
            string search)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    source) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    search))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return source.IndexOf(
                search,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectCollection(
            StringBuilder text,
            object collection,
            string ownerName)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine();
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] {obj.GetType().Name}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: {obj.GetType().FullName}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: {UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({GetCollectionCount(value)})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        foreach (
                            object child
                            in enumerable)
                        {
                            if (child == null)
                                continue;

                            DumpObjectProperties(
                                text,
                                child,
                                indent + "  ",
                                depth + 1,
                                maxDepth);
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{value.GetType().FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string value =
                (propertyName +
                 " " +
                 valueType.FullName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                value.Contains("script") ||
                value.Contains("trigger") ||
                value.Contains("tag") ||
                value.Contains("action") ||
                value.Contains("parameter") ||
                value.Contains("converter") ||
                value.Contains("mapping") ||
                value.Contains("reference");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            List<string> beforeFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in exportObject
                    .GetType()
                    .GetMethods(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (method.Name !=
                    "Export")
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            object returnValue;

            if (twoParameters != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    twoParameters.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(baseName)
                        });
            }
            else if (oneParameter != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    oneParameter.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte Export-Methode gefunden.");
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable files =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (files != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in files)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file != null &&
                        !result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in GetAllFiles(directory))
            {
                if (!beforeFiles.Contains(
                        file) &&
                    !result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            files.AddRange(
                Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories));

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                                return plcSoftware;
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                                return hmiSoftware;
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION / HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                return value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null ||
                    !IsSimpleType(
                        value.GetType()))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                    text.Append(" | ");

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (property != null)
                {
                    object value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (value != null)
                        return Convert.ToInt32(value);
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object item
                in enumerable)
            {
                count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeSingleLine(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Replace("\t", " ");
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetStringProperty(
                    obj,
                    propertyName));
        }

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,

            string details)
        {

                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category = category,

                    ObjectName = objectName,
                    ObjectType = objectType,
                    Status = status,
                    Details = details

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Category);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Device);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectName);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Status);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,

                Encoding.UTF8);

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

`.csproj` und `App.config` bleiben unverändert.

Dann:

```powershell
dotnet build
dotnet run
```

Am Ende kommen vier neue Kennzahlen:

```text
Beziehungen:              ...
PLC aufgelöst:            ...
PLC nicht aufgelöst:      ...
Screen-Verwendungen:      ...
```

Ein wichtiger Punkt zur Interpretation: `UNRESOLVED` ist **kein Exportfehler**. Es bedeutet lediglich, dass sich aus den öffentlich erreichbaren Connection-Eigenschaften keine eindeutige PLC ableiten ließ. Das HMI-Tag behält trotzdem `Connection`, `PlcTag`, `SymbolicAddress` und `Address`, sodass die technische Beziehung im Archiv erhalten bleibt. Siemens' V21-API behandelt Connections als eigene Objekte, während das HMI-Tag über seine Connection- und PLC-Tag-Eigenschaften darauf verweist. ([Siemens TIA](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/functions-for-accessing-the-data-of-an-hmi-unified-device/hmisoftware/connections?contentId=8PDPEbtCTgnTnePz7McAZQ&utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Wenn dieser Lauf funktioniert, sehen wir erstmals, **wie gut sich dein reales Projekt automatisch semantisch zusammenführen lässt**. Das Ergebnis ist wichtiger als noch ein weiterer Rohdatenexport.

            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("SCHWERER FEHLER:");
                Console.WriteLine(ex.GetType().FullName);
                Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                   processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project =
                    tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"Projekt: {project.Name}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(
                        project.Name);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("Archivziel:");
                Console.WriteLine(archiveRoot);
                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                ExportHardware(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                List<PlcReference> plcReferences =
                    BuildPlcReferences(
                        project);

                foreach (
                    Device device
                    in project.Devices)
                {
                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            plcSoftware);
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            hmiSoftware,
                            plcReferences);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteSummary(
                    archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(
            string projectName)
        {
            string safeProjectName =
                MakeSafeName(
                    projectName);

            string timestamp =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

            string archiveRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    @"C:\TiaProjectArchive",
                    safeProjectName +
                    "_" +
                    timestamp);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                archiveRoot);

            return archiveRoot;
        }

        private static void CreateBaseDirectories(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report"));
        }

        private static void WriteProjectInfo(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project",
                    "ProjectInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine("TIA Project Archive");
            text.AppendLine("===================");
            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Projektname: {project.Name}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Projektpfad: {project.Path}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "Projektpfad: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Exportdatum: {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA-Version: V21");

            text.AppendLine(
                ".NET Framework: 4.8");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }
