        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHardware(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "HARDWARE");

            string hardwareRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware");

            string devicesFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "Devices.csv");

            string treeFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "HardwareTree.txt");

            StringBuilder devicesCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder tree =
                new StringBuilder();

            devicesCsv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TypeIdentifier;IsGsd;" +
                "TypeName;OrderNumber;FirmwareVersion;" +
                "Author;Comment;PlantDesignation;" +
                "LocationIdentifier;GsdName;GsdType;GsdId");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "TIA HARDWARE TREE");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "=================");

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                try
                {
                    ExportHardwareDevice(
                        hardwareRoot,
                        device,
                        devicesCsv,
                        tree);

                    HardwareDevicesDocumented++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HardwareErrors++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"  Gerät {device.Name}: FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"    {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                        device.Name,
                        device.Name,
                        "Device",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                devicesFile,
                devicesCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                treeFile,
                tree.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Geräte dokumentiert: " +
                $"{HardwareDevicesDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Hardwareobjekte: " +
                $"{HardwareItemsDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportHardwareDevice(
            string hardwareRoot,
            Device device,
            StringBuilder devicesCsv,
            StringBuilder tree)
        {
            string deviceName =
                device.Name;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gerät: {deviceName}");

            string deviceDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        deviceName));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                deviceDirectory);

            string itemsFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    deviceDirectory,
                    "DeviceItems.csv");

            StringBuilder itemsCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            itemsCsv.AppendLine(
                "Path;Level;Name;TypeIdentifier;" +
                "PositionNumber;IsPlugged;IsBuiltIn;" +
                "Classification;TypeName;OrderNumber;" +
                "FirmwareVersion;Author;Comment;" +
                "PlantDesignation;LocationIdentifier;" +
                "GsdName;GsdType;GsdId;" +
                "IsGsd;IsProfinet;IsProfibus");

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                deviceName);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                typeIdentifier);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "FirmwareVersion"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdType"));

            devicesCsv.Append(
                Csv(
                    GetDynamicAttribute(
                        device,
                        "GsdId")));

            devicesCsv.AppendLine();

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"DEVICE: {deviceName}");

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"  TypeIdentifier: {typeIdentifier}");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.AppendLine(
                    $"  OrderNumber: {orderNumber}");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                DeviceItem deviceItem
                in device.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    deviceItem,
                    itemsCsv,
                    tree,
                    deviceName,
                    0);
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            File.WriteAllText(
                itemsFile,
                itemsCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                deviceName,
                deviceName,
                "Device",
                "OK",
                "TypeIdentifier=" +
                typeIdentifier +
                "; Datei=" +
                itemsFile);
        }

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                deviceItem.Name;

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            AppendCsvValue(csv, path);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, level.ToString());
            AppendCsvValue(csv, name);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, typeIdentifier);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, position);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                orderNumber);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                firmware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet"));

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    SafeProperty(
                        deviceItem,
                        "IsProfibus")));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");
            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC REFERENCES
        // ============================================================

        private static List<PlcReference> BuildPlcReferences(
            Project project)
        {
            List<PlcReference> result =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(
                        device);

                if (plcSoftware == null)
                    continue;

                PlcReference reference =
                    new PlcReference();

                reference.DeviceName =
                    device.Name;

                reference.SoftwareName =
                    plcSoftware.Name;

                result.Add(
                    reference);
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftware.Name}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftware.Name));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{ex.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            group.Name));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                currentGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? group.Name
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      group.Name;
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static void ExportHmiScreens(
            string screensDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens: {hmiSoftware.Screens.Count}");

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenName,-30}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        screensDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            screenName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;

                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "EventHandlers"),
                    "Screen");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (GetCollectionCount(
                            events) == 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    text.AppendLine();
                    text.AppendLine(
                        "--------------------------------------------------");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Objekt: {itemName}");

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            events,
                            itemName);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIPS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagRelationships(
            string relationshipsDirectory,
            Device hmiDevice,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            string fullFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "HmiTagToPlc.csv");

            string unresolvedFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "UnresolvedRelationships.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder unresolvedCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            string header =
                "HmiDevice;HmiSoftware;HmiTag;TagTable;" +
                "DataType;Connection;PlcTag;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "Address;AccessMode;ResolvedPlcDevice;" +
                "ResolvedPlcSoftware;ResolutionStatus;" +
                "Classification;ScreenUsage;" +
                "DynamizationUsage;EventUsage;" +
                "ConnectionProperties";

            csv.AppendLine(
                header);

            unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                header);

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            int localCount =
                0;

            int localResolved =
                0;

            int localUnresolved =
                0;

            int localSystem =
                0;

            int localInternal =
                0;

            int localPlcReferenceUnresolved =
                0;

            int localConnectionUnresolved =
                0;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    localCount++;
                    RelationshipsDocumented++;

                    string tagName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name");

                    string tagTable =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable");

                    string connectionName =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection");

                    string plcTag =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag");

                    string symbolicAddress =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress");

                    string address =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address");

                    object connection =
                        FindNamedObject(
                            hmiSoftware.Connections,
                            connectionName);

                    string connectionProperties =
                        "";

                    if (connection != null)
                    {
                        connectionProperties =
                            GetDeepReadableText(
                                connection,
                                0,
                                2);
                    }

                    string resolvedDevice =
                        "";

                    string resolvedSoftware =
                        "";

                    string resolutionStatus;
                    string classification;

                    PlcReference resolved =
                        ResolvePlcReference(
                            connectionProperties,
                            plcReferences);

                    if (resolved != null)
                    {
                        resolvedDevice =
                            resolved.DeviceName;

                        resolvedSoftware =
                            resolved.SoftwareName;

                        resolutionStatus =
                            "RESOLVED_FROM_CONNECTION";

                        classification =
                            "PLC_TAG";

                        RelationshipsResolvedToPlc++;
                        localResolved++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        classification =
                            ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
                                tagName,
                                tagTable,
                                connectionName,
                                plcTag,
                                symbolicAddress,
                                address);

                        resolutionStatus =
                            classification;

                        RelationshipsUnresolved++;
                        localUnresolved++;

                        if (classification ==
                            "SYSTEM_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipSystemTags++;
                            localSystem++;
                        }
                        else if (classification ==
                                 "INTERNAL_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipInternalTags++;
                            localInternal++;
                        }
                        else if (classification ==
                                 "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE")
                        {
                            RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                            localPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            RelationshipConnectionUnresolved++;
                            localConnectionUnresolved++;
                        }
                    }

                    UsageResult usage =
                        FindHmiTagUsage(
                            hmiSoftware,
                            tagName);

                    RelationshipScreenUsages +=
                        usage.TotalUsageCount;

                    string row =
                        BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
                            hmiDevice.Name,
                            hmiSoftware.Name,
                            tagName,
                            tagTable,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "DataType"),
                            connectionName,
                            plcTag,
                            symbolicAddress,
                            address,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "AccessMode"),
                            resolvedDevice,
                            resolvedSoftware,
                            resolutionStatus,
                            classification,
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.ScreenItems),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Dynamizations),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Events),
                            NormalizeSingleLine(
                                connectionProperties));

                    csv.AppendLine(
                        row);

                    if (resolved == null)
                    {
                        unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                            row);
                    }
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                fullFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                unresolvedFile,
                unresolvedCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Beziehungen dokumentiert: {localCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    PLC aufgelöst: {localResolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    offen gesamt: {localUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      System-Tags: {localSystem}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      interne Tags: {localInternal}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      PLC-Referenz, Connection unklar: " +
                $"{localPlcReferenceUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      Connection nicht identifizierbar: " +
                $"{localConnectionUnresolved}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_RELATIONSHIPS",
                hmiDevice.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "HmiTagToPlc.csv",
                "OK",
                "Tags=" +
                localCount +
                "; Resolved=" +
                localResolved +
                "; Unresolved=" +
                localUnresolved +
                "; System=" +
                localSystem +
                "; Internal=" +
                localInternal +
                "; PlcRefUnresolved=" +
                localPlcReferenceUnresolved +
                "; ConnectionUnresolved=" +
                localConnectionUnresolved);
        }

        private static string ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable,
            string connectionName,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address)
        {
            if (IsSystemTag(
                tagName,
                tagTable))
            {
                return "SYSTEM_TAG";
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                connectionName))
            {
                return "INTERNAL_TAG";
            }

            bool hasPlcReference =
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    plcTag) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    symbolicAddress) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    address);

            if (hasPlcReference)
            {
                return
                    "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
            }

            return
                "CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
        }

        private static bool IsSystemTag(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagName) &&
                tagName.StartsWith(
                    "@",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagTable))
            {
                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "HMISystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "PLCSystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "System",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
            string hmiDevice,
            string hmiSoftware,
            string hmiTag,
            string tagTable,
            string dataType,
            string connection,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address,
            string accessMode,
            string resolvedPlcDevice,
            string resolvedPlcSoftware,
            string resolutionStatus,
            string classification,
            string screenUsage,
            string dynamizationUsage,
            string eventUsage,
            string connectionProperties)
        {
            StringBuilder row =
                new StringBuilder();

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                hmiDevice);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                hmiSoftware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                hmiTag);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                tagTable);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                dataType);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                connection);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                plcTag);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                symbolicAddress);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                address);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                accessMode);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                resolvedPlcDevice);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                resolvedPlcSoftware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                resolutionStatus);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                classification);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                screenUsage);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                dynamizationUsage);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                eventUsage);

            row.Append(
                Csv(
                    connectionProperties));

            return row.ToString();
        }

        private static object FindNamedObject(
            object collection,
            string name)
        {
            if (collection == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
            {
                return null;
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return null;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                string candidate =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        obj,
                        "Name");

                if (string.Equals(
                    candidate,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return obj;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static PlcReference ResolvePlcReference(
            string connectionText,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connectionText) ||
                plcReferences == null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            List<PlcReference> matches =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                PlcReference plc
                in plcReferences)
            {
                bool match =
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.DeviceName) ||
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.SoftwareName);

                if (match)
                {
                    matches.Add(
                        plc);
                }
            }

            if (matches.Count == 1)
            {
                return matches[0];
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static UsageResult FindHmiTagUsage(
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            string tagName)
        {
            UsageResult result =
                new UsageResult();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                tagName))
            {
                return result;
            }

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                IEnumerable items =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "ScreenItems")
                    as IEnumerable;

                if (items == null)
                    continue;

                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    string reference =
                        screenName +
                        "/" +
                        itemName;

                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        item,
                        tagName,
                        0,
                        1))
                    {
                        AddUnique(
                            result.ScreenItems,
                            reference);
                    }

                    object dynamizations =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "Dynamizations");

                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        dynamizations,
                        tagName,
                        0,
                        4))
                    {
                        AddUnique(
                            result.Dynamizations,
                            reference);
                    }

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        events,
                        tagName,
                        0,
                        4))
                    {
                        AddUnique(
                            result.Events,
                            reference);
                    }
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static bool ObjectContainsTagReference(
            object obj,
            string tagName,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return false;
            }

            string textValue =
                obj as string;

            if (textValue != null)
            {
                return ContainsTagText(
                    textValue,
                    tagName);
            }

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return ContainsTagText(
                    SafeToString(
                        obj),
                    tagName);
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                obj as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable != null &&
                !(obj is string))
            {
                foreach (
                    object child
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                        child,
                        tagName,
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth))
                    {
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                return false;
            }

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return false;

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ObjectContainsTagReference(
                    value,
                    tagName,
                    depth + 1,
                    maxDepth))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
            string name)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems"
            };

            foreach (
                string value
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    value,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ContainsTagText(
            string value,
            string tagName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    value) ||
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    tagName))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (string.Equals(
                value,
                tagName,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (value.IndexOf(
                    "\"" + tagName + "\"",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (value.IndexOf(
                    "'" + tagName + "'",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0)
            {
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string GetDeepReadableText(
            object obj,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return "";
            }

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return SafeToString(
                    obj);
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType =
                    value.GetType();

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.Append(
                        property.Name);

                    text.Append("=");

                    text.Append(
                        SafeToString(
                            value));

                    text.Append(" | ");
                }
                else if (depth < maxDepth)
                {
                    string nested =
                        GetDeepReadableText(
                            value,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        nested))
                    {
                        text.Append(
                            property.Name);

                        text.Append("={");
                        text.Append(nested);
                        text.Append("} | ");
                    }
                }
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static void AddUnique(
            List<string> list,
            string value)
        {
            if (list == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!list.Contains(
                value))
            {
                list.Add(
                    value);
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsText(
            string source,
            string search)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    source) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    search))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return source.IndexOf(
                search,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectCollection(
            StringBuilder text,
            object collection,
            string ownerName)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine();
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] {obj.GetType().Name}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: {obj.GetType().FullName}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: {UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({GetCollectionCount(value)})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        foreach (
                            object child
                            in enumerable)
                        {
                            if (child == null)
                                continue;

                            DumpObjectProperties(
                                text,
                                child,
                                indent + "  ",
                                depth + 1,
                                maxDepth);
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{value.GetType().FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string value =
                (propertyName +
                 " " +
                 valueType.FullName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                value.Contains("script") ||
                value.Contains("trigger") ||
                value.Contains("tag") ||
                value.Contains("action") ||
                value.Contains("parameter") ||
                value.Contains("converter") ||
                value.Contains("mapping") ||
                value.Contains("reference");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            List<string> beforeFiles =
                GetAllFiles(
                    directory);

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in exportObject
                    .GetType()
                    .GetMethods(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (method.Name !=
                    "Export")
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            object returnValue;

            if (twoParameters != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    twoParameters.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(baseName)
                        });
            }
            else if (oneParameter != null)
            {
                returnValue =
                    oneParameter.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte Export-Methode gefunden.");
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable files =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (files != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in files)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file != null &&
                        !result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in GetAllFiles(directory))
            {
                if (!beforeFiles.Contains(
                        file) &&
                    !result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            files.AddRange(
                Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories));

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                                return plcSoftware;
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                                return hmiSoftware;
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION / HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                return value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null ||
                    !IsSimpleType(
                        value.GetType()))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                    text.Append(" | ");

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (property != null)
                {
                    object value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (value != null)
                        return Convert.ToInt32(value);
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object item
                in enumerable)
            {
                count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeSingleLine(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Replace("\t", " ");
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetStringProperty(
                    obj,
                    propertyName));
        }

        // REPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category = category,
                    Device = device,
                    ObjectName = objectName,
                    ObjectType = objectType,
                    Status = status,
                    Details = details
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Category);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Device);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectName);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Status);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

            Console.WriteLine(

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI-Tags dokumentiert:    {HmiTagsDocumented}");
