            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI-Screens:              {HmiScreensDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI-ScreenItems:          {HmiScreenItemsDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI-Dynamisierungen:      {HmiDynamizationsDocumented}");

                $"HMI-Screenfehler:         {HmiScreenDocumentationFailed}");

            Console.WriteLine();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Beziehungen:              {RelationshipsDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC aufgelöst:            {RelationshipsResolvedToPlc}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Offen gesamt:             {RelationshipsUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  System-Tags:            {RelationshipSystemTags}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Interne Tags:           {RelationshipInternalTags}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  PLC-Ref. unklar:        {RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Connection unklar:      {RelationshipConnectionUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Screen-Verwendungen:      {RelationshipScreenUsages}");

            Console.WriteLine();

            Console.WriteLine("Archiv:");
            Console.WriteLine(archiveRoot);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // GENERAL
        // ============================================================

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "\"\"";

            return "\"" +
                   value.Replace(
                       "\"",
                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

        private class PlcReference
        {
            public string DeviceName
            {
                get;
                set;
            }

            public string SoftwareName
            {
                get;
                set;
            }
        }

        private class UsageResult
        {
            public List<string> ScreenItems =
                new List<string>();

            public List<string> Dynamizations =
                new List<string>();

            public List<string> Events =
                new List<string>();

            public int TotalUsageCount
            {
                get
                {
                    return
                        ScreenItems.Count +
                        Dynamizations.Count +
                        Events.Count;
                }
            }
        }

        private class ReportEntry
        {
            public string Category { get; set; }
            public string Device { get; set; }
            public string ObjectName { get; set; }
            public string ObjectType { get; set; }
            public string Status { get; set; }
            public string Details { get; set; }
        }
    }
}

# chatgpt response

Ja — und der Grund ist ziemlich eindeutig: **die aktuelle Beziehungsauswertung ist algorithmisch unnötig teuer**.

Im Moment machen wir für **jeden einzelnen der 543 HMI-Tags** erneut eine Suche durch alle Screens, ScreenItems, Dynamisierungen und Events. Dabei läuft zusätzlich viel Reflection über die Unified-Objekte. Vereinfacht:

```text
543 Tags
 × alle Screens
 × alle ScreenItems
 × Events/Dynamisierungen
 × rekursive Reflection
```

Das funktioniert, skaliert aber schlecht. Zusätzlich lesen wir dieselbe Connection für viele Tags immer wieder neu aus.

Ich würde diesen Stand deshalb **nicht so lassen**. Die richtige Lösung ist ein einmaliger Index:

```text
1. Connections einmal analysieren
   → ConnectionName -> PLC

2. Screens einmal komplett durchlaufen
   → TagName -> Liste der Verwendungen

3. Danach die 543 Tags nur noch gegen diese Dictionaries nachschlagen
```

Dann wird aus:

```text
Tag 1 -> alle Screens durchsuchen
Tag 2 -> alle Screens durchsuchen
Tag 3 -> alle Screens durchsuchen
...
Tag 543 -> alle Screens durchsuchen
```

ein:

```text
Alle Screens genau einmal durchsuchen
        ↓
Usage-Index aufbauen

Alle Connections genau einmal analysieren
        ↓
Connection-Index aufbauen

543 Tags
        ↓
nur noch schnelle Nachschläge
```

Das dürfte die Beziehungsauswertung **massiv beschleunigen** und ist auch die richtige Architektur für größere Kundenprojekte mit mehreren Tausend Tags.

Den aktuell laufenden Export kannst du noch fertiglaufen lassen bzw. abbrechen, wenn er wirklich zu lange braucht — am bisherigen Projekt ändern wir dadurch nichts.

**Bevor wir weitere Funktionen hinzufügen, würde ich jetzt genau diese Performance-Bremse beseitigen.** Danach können wir die Klassifizierung der offenen Beziehungen praktisch ohne den jetzigen Zeitaufwand mitnehmen.

            string devicesFile =

        private static void ExportHardwareDevice(

        {
            string deviceName =

            Console.WriteLine(

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                deviceItem.Name;

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            AppendCsvValue(csv, path);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, level.ToString());
            AppendCsvValue(csv, name);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, typeIdentifier);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, position);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                orderNumber);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                firmware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet"));

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    SafeProperty(
                        deviceItem,
                        "IsProfibus")));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");
            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC REFERENCES
        // ============================================================

        private static List<PlcReference> BuildPlcReferences(
            Project project)
        {
            List<PlcReference> result =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(
                        device);

                if (plcSoftware == null)
                    continue;

                PlcReference reference =
                    new PlcReference();

                reference.DeviceName =
                    device.Name;

                reference.SoftwareName =
                    plcSoftware.Name;

                result.Add(
                    reference);
            }

            return result;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftware.Name}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftware.Name));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{ex.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            group.Name));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                currentGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? group.Name
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      group.Name;
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportHmi(

        {
            HmiCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI: {device.Name}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Software: {hmiSoftware.Name}");

            string hmiRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        device.Name));

            string inventoryDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Inventory");

            string scriptsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Scripts");

            string tagTablesDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "TagTables");

            string tagsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Tags");

            string connectionsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Connections");

            string screensDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Screens");

            string relationshipsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Relationships");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                inventoryDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                scriptsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagTablesDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                connectionsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                screensDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                relationshipsDirectory);

            WriteHmiInventory(
                inventoryDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            ExportHmiScripts(
                scriptsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            ExportHmiTagTables(
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            WriteHmiTagsCsv(
                tagsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            WriteConnections(
                connectionsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            ExportHmiScreens(
                screensDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
                relationshipsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware,
                plcReferences);

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =

                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

            if (screens == null)

            foreach (

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenName,-30}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        screensDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;

                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "EventHandlers"),
                    "Screen");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (GetCollectionCount(
                            events) == 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    text.AppendLine();
                    text.AppendLine(
                        "--------------------------------------------------");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Objekt: {itemName}");

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            events,
                            itemName);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }
