        // HMI
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmi(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            HmiCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI: {device.Name}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Software: {hmiSoftware.Name}");

            string hmiRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        device.Name));

            string inventoryDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Inventory");

            string scriptsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Scripts");

            string tagTablesDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "TagTables");

            string tagsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Tags");

            string connectionsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Connections");

            string screensDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Screens");

            string relationshipsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Relationships");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                inventoryDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                scriptsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagTablesDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                connectionsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                screensDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                relationshipsDirectory);

            WriteHmiInventory(
                inventoryDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            Stopwatch watch;

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiScripts(
                scriptsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScriptsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Scripts: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiTagTables(
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagTablesDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit TagTables: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagsCsv(
                tagsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Tags: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteConnections(
                connectionsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiConnectionsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Connections: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiScreens(
                screensDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScreensDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Screens: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
                relationshipsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware,
                plcReferences);

            watch.Stop();

            RelationshipsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Relationships gesamt: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,

                            "Connection"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionCycle"));

                    AppendCsvValue(

                    csv.Append(

                            GetStringProperty(

                    csv.AppendLine();

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,

            HmiTagsDocumented +=

                    string name =
                        GetStringProperty(

                    string properties =

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(

                                .FullName));

            File.WriteAllText(

                count;

                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: {count}");

        private static void ExportHmiScreens(
            string screensDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens: {hmiSoftware.Screens.Count}");

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenName,-30}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        screensDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            screenName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;

                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static int WriteScreenItemsCsv(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenItems.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =

            csv.AppendLine(

                "EventHandlers;Dynamizations;" +
                "PropertyEventHandlers");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            int count =
                0;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        count.ToString());

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        item.GetType().Name);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        item.GetType().FullName);

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Left");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Top");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Width");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Height");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Visible");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Enabled");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Text");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ProcessValue");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Tag");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Screen");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ScreenName");

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            GetPropertyValue(
                                item,
                                "EventHandlers"))
                        .ToString());

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            GetPropertyValue(
                                item,
                                "Dynamizations"))
                        .ToString());

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetCollectionCount(
                                GetPropertyValue(
                                    item,
                                    "PropertyEventHandlers"))
                            .ToString()));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "EventHandlers"),
                    "Screen");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (GetCollectionCount(
                            events) == 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    text.AppendLine();
                    text.AppendLine(
                        "--------------------------------------------------");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Objekt: {itemName}");

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            events,
                            itemName);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        private static int WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
