        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "PropertyEventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers"),
                    "Screen");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object propertyEvents =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "PropertyEventHandlers");

                    if (GetCollectionCount(
                            propertyEvents) == 0)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            propertyEvents,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                item,
                                "Name"));
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIPS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
            string relationshipsDirectory,
            Device hmiDevice,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            string fullFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "HmiTagToPlc.csv");

            string unresolvedFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "UnresolvedRelationships.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder unresolvedCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            string header =
                "HmiDevice;HmiSoftware;HmiTag;TagTable;" +
                "DataType;Connection;PlcTag;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "Address;AccessMode;ResolvedPlcDevice;" +
                "ResolvedPlcSoftware;ResolutionStatus;" +
                "Classification;ScreenUsage;" +
                "DynamizationUsage;EventUsage;" +
                "ConnectionProperties";

            csv.AppendLine(
                header);

            unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                header);

            Console.WriteLine(
                "  Beziehungsindex wird aufgebaut...");

            HashSet<string> knownTagNames =
                BuildKnownTagNameSet(
                    hmiSoftware);

            Stopwatch connectionWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo> connectionIndex =
                BuildConnectionIndex(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    plcReferences);

            connectionWatch.Stop();

            ConnectionIndexDuration +=
                connectionWatch.Elapsed;

            Stopwatch usageWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex =
                BuildUsageIndex(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    knownTagNames);

            usageWatch.Stop();

            UsageIndexDuration +=
                usageWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    bekannte Tags im Index: " +
                $"{knownTagNames.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Connections im Index: " +
                $"{connectionIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Tags mit Screen-Verwendung: " +
                $"{usageIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Connection-Index: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(connectionWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Usage-Index: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(usageWatch.Elapsed)}");

            int localCount =
                0;

            int localResolved =
                0;

            int localUnresolved =
                0;

            int localSystem =
                0;

            int localInternal =
                0;

            int localPlcReferenceUnresolved =
                0;

            int localConnectionUnresolved =
                0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    localCount++;

                    RelationshipsDocumented++;

                    string tagName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name");

                    string tagTable =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable");

                    string connectionName =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection");

                    string plcTag =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag");

                    string symbolicAddress =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress");

                    string address =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address");

                    ConnectionInfo connectionInfo =
                        null;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            connectionName))
                    {
                        connectionIndex.TryGetValue(
                            connectionName,
                            out connectionInfo);
                    }

                    string connectionProperties =
                        connectionInfo == null
                        ? ""
                        : connectionInfo.Properties;

                    string resolvedDevice =
                        "";

                    string resolvedSoftware =
                        "";

                    string resolutionStatus;
                    string classification;

                    PlcReference resolved =
                        connectionInfo == null
                        ? null
                        : connectionInfo.ResolvedPlc;

                    if (resolved != null)
                    {
                        resolvedDevice =
                            resolved.DeviceName;

                        resolvedSoftware =
                            resolved.SoftwareName;

                        resolutionStatus =
                            "RESOLVED_FROM_CONNECTION";

                        classification =
                            "PLC_TAG";

                        RelationshipsResolvedToPlc++;

                        localResolved++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        classification =
                            ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
                                tagName,
                                tagTable,
                                connectionName,
                                plcTag,
                                symbolicAddress,
                                address);

                        resolutionStatus =
                            classification;

                        RelationshipsUnresolved++;

                        localUnresolved++;

                        if (classification ==
                            "SYSTEM_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipSystemTags++;

                            localSystem++;
                        }
                        else if (classification ==
                                 "INTERNAL_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipInternalTags++;

                            localInternal++;
                        }
                        else if (classification ==
                                 "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE")
                        {
                            RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved++;

                            localPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            RelationshipConnectionUnresolved++;

                            localConnectionUnresolved++;
                        }
                    }

                    UsageResult usage =
                        null;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            tagName))
                    {
                        usageIndex.TryGetValue(
                            tagName,
                            out usage);
                    }

                    if (usage == null)
                    {
                        usage =
                            new UsageResult();
                    }

                    RelationshipScreenUsages +=
                        usage.TotalUsageCount;

                    string row =
                        BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
                            hmiDevice.Name,
                            hmiSoftware.Name,
                            tagName,
                            tagTable,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "DataType"),
                            connectionName,
                            plcTag,
                            symbolicAddress,
                            address,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "AccessMode"),
                            resolvedDevice,
                            resolvedSoftware,
                            resolutionStatus,
                            classification,
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.ScreenItems),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Dynamizations),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Events),
                            NormalizeSingleLine(
                                connectionProperties));

                    csv.AppendLine(
                        row);

                    if (resolved == null)
                    {
                        unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                            row);
                    }
                }
            }

            Stopwatch writeWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            File.WriteAllText(
                fullFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                unresolvedFile,
                unresolvedCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            writeWatch.Stop();

            RelationshipWriteDuration +=
                writeWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Relationship-Dateien: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(writeWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Beziehungen dokumentiert: {localCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    PLC aufgelöst: {localResolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    offen gesamt: {localUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      System-Tags: {localSystem}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      interne Tags: {localInternal}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      PLC-Referenz, Connection unklar: " +
                $"{localPlcReferenceUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      Connection nicht identifizierbar: " +
                $"{localConnectionUnresolved}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_RELATIONSHIPS",
                hmiDevice.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "HmiTagToPlc.csv",
                "OK",
                "Tags=" +
                localCount +
                "; Resolved=" +
                localResolved +
                "; Unresolved=" +
                localUnresolved +
                "; System=" +
                localSystem +
                "; Internal=" +
                localInternal +
                "; PlcRefUnresolved=" +
                localPlcReferenceUnresolved +
                "; ConnectionUnresolved=" +
                localConnectionUnresolved +
                "; ConnectionIndexTime=" +
                FormatDuration(
                    connectionWatch.Elapsed) +
                "; UsageIndexTime=" +
                FormatDuration(
                    usageWatch.Elapsed));
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIP INDEX
        // ============================================================

        private static HashSet<string> BuildKnownTagNameSet(
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            HashSet<string> result =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object tag
                in tags)
            {
                if (tag == null)
                    continue;

                string name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "Name");

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        name);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>
            BuildConnectionIndex(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
                List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo> result =
                new Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>(
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object connection
                in connections)
            {
                if (connection == null)
                    continue;

                string name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        connection,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string properties =
                    GetDeepReadableText(
                        connection,
                        0,
                        2);

                ConnectionInfo info =
                    new ConnectionInfo();

                info.Name =
                    name;

                info.Properties =
                    properties;

                info.ResolvedPlc =
                    ResolvePlcReference(
                        properties,
                        plcReferences);

                result[name] =
                    info;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, UsageResult>
            BuildUsageIndex(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
                HashSet<string> knownTagNames)
        {
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> result =
                new Dictionary<string, UsageResult>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            IEnumerable screens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens
                as IEnumerable;

            if (screens == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in screens)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                IEnumerable items =
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "ScreenItems")
                    as IEnumerable;

                if (items == null)
                    continue;

                foreach (
                    object item
                    in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    string reference =
                        screenName +
                        "/" +
                        itemName;

                    HashSet<string> itemTags =
                        new HashSet<string>(
                            StringComparer.Ordinal);

                    ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                        item,
                        knownTagNames,
                        itemTags,
                        0,
                        1,
                        true);

                    foreach (
                        string tagName
                        in itemTags)
                    {
                        UsageResult usage =
                            GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                                result,
                                tagName);

                        AddUnique(
                            usage.ScreenItems,
                            reference);
                    }

                    object dynamizations =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "Dynamizations");

                    HashSet<string> dynamizationTags =
                        new HashSet<string>(
                            StringComparer.Ordinal);

                    ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                        dynamizations,
                        knownTagNames,
                        dynamizationTags,
                        0,
                        4,
                        false);

                    foreach (
                        string tagName
                        in dynamizationTags)
                    {
                        UsageResult usage =
                            GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                                result,
                                tagName);

                        AddUnique(
                            usage.Dynamizations,
                            reference);
                    }

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    HashSet<string> eventTags =
                        new HashSet<string>(
                            StringComparer.Ordinal);

                    ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                        events,
                        knownTagNames,
                        eventTags,
                        0,
                        4,
                        false);

                    foreach (
                        string tagName
                        in eventTags)
                    {
                        UsageResult usage =
                            GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                                result,
                                tagName);

                        AddUnique(
                            usage.Events,
                            reference);
                    }
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static UsageResult GetOrCreateUsageResult(
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> index,
            string tagName)
        {
            UsageResult result;

            if (!index.TryGetValue(
                    tagName,
                    out result))
            {
                result =
                    new UsageResult();

                index[tagName] =
                    result;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void ScanObjectForKnownTags(
            object obj,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            string text =
                obj as string;

            if (text != null)
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    text,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    SafeToString(
                        obj),
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return;

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                obj as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object child
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                        child,
                        knownTagNames,
                        foundTags,
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth,
                        skipBehaviorContainers);
                }

                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    skipBehaviorContainers))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    value,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags,
                    depth + 1,
                    maxDepth,
                    skipBehaviorContainers);
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
            string propertyName,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            string[] structuralSkip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in structuralSkip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            if (skipBehaviorContainers)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "EventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "Dynamizations",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddKnownTagsFromText(
            string text,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    text))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                text))
            {
                foundTags.Add(
                    text);
            }

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '"',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '\'',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);
        }

        private static void ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
            string text,
            char quote,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            int start =
                0;

            while (start <
                   text.Length)
            {
                int open =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        start);

                if (open < 0)
                    break;

                int close =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        open + 1);

                if (close < 0)
                    break;

                if (close >
                    open + 1)
                {
                    string candidate =
                        text.Substring(
                            open + 1,
                            close - open - 1);

                    if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                        candidate))
                    {
                        foundTags.Add(
                            candidate);
                    }
                }

                start =
                    close + 1;
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIP CLASSIFICATION
        // ============================================================

        private static string ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable,
            string connectionName,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address)
        {
            if (IsSystemTag(
                tagName,
                tagTable))
            {
                return "SYSTEM_TAG";
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                connectionName))
            {
                return "INTERNAL_TAG";
            }

            bool hasPlcReference =
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    plcTag) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    symbolicAddress) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    address);

            if (hasPlcReference)
            {
                return
                    "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
            }

            return
                "CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
        }

        private static bool IsSystemTag(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagName) &&
                tagName.StartsWith(
                    "@",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagTable))
            {
                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "HMISystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "PLCSystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "System",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
            string hmiDevice,
            string hmiSoftware,
            string hmiTag,
            string tagTable,
            string dataType,
            string connection,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address,
            string accessMode,
            string resolvedPlcDevice,
            string resolvedPlcSoftware,
            string resolutionStatus,
            string classification,
            string screenUsage,
            string dynamizationUsage,
            string eventUsage,
            string connectionProperties)
        {
            StringBuilder row =
                new StringBuilder();

            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiDevice);
            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiSoftware);
            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiTag);
            AppendCsvValue(row, tagTable);
            AppendCsvValue(row, dataType);
            AppendCsvValue(row, connection);
            AppendCsvValue(row, plcTag);
            AppendCsvValue(row, symbolicAddress);
            AppendCsvValue(row, address);
            AppendCsvValue(row, accessMode);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolvedPlcDevice);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolvedPlcSoftware);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolutionStatus);
            AppendCsvValue(row, classification);
            AppendCsvValue(row, screenUsage);
            AppendCsvValue(row, dynamizationUsage);
            AppendCsvValue(row, eventUsage);

            row.Append(
                Csv(
                    connectionProperties));

            return row.ToString();
        }

        private static PlcReference ResolvePlcReference(
            string connectionText,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connectionText) ||
                plcReferences == null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            List<PlcReference> matches =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                PlcReference plc
                in plcReferences)
            {
                bool match =
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.DeviceName) ||
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.SoftwareName);

                if (match)
                {
                    matches.Add(
                        plc);
                }
            }

            if (matches.Count == 1)
            {
                return matches[0];
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string GetDeepReadableText(
            object obj,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return "";
            }

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return SafeToString(
                    obj);
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType =
                    value.GetType();

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.Append(
                        property.Name);

                    text.Append("=");

                    text.Append(
                        SafeToString(
                            value));

                    text.Append(" | ");
                }
                else if (depth < maxDepth)
                {
                    string nested =
                        GetDeepReadableText(
                            value,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        nested))
                    {
                        text.Append(
                            property.Name);

                        text.Append("={");

                        text.Append(
                            nested);

                        text.Append("} | ");
                    }
                }
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
            string name)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems"
            };

            foreach (
                string value
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    value,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddUnique(
            List<string> list,
            string value)
        {
            if (list == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!list.Contains(
                value))
            {
                list.Add(
                    value);
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsText(
            string source,
            string search)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    source) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    search))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return source.IndexOf(
                search,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectCollection(
            StringBuilder text,
            object collection,
            string ownerName)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine();

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] {obj.GetType().Name}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: {obj.GetType().FullName}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: " +
                        $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection " +
                        $"({GetCollectionCount(value)})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        foreach (
                            object child
                            in enumerable)
                        {
                            if (child == null)
                                continue;

                            DumpObjectProperties(
                                text,
                                child,
                                indent + "  ",
                                depth + 1,
                                maxDepth);
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{value.GetType().FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string value =
                (propertyName +
                 " " +
                 valueType.FullName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                value.Contains("script") ||
                value.Contains("trigger") ||
                value.Contains("tag") ||
                value.Contains("action") ||
                value.Contains("parameter") ||
                value.Contains("converter") ||
                value.Contains("mapping") ||
                value.Contains("reference");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OPTIMIZED NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo exportMethod =
                GetNativeExportMethod(
                    exportObject.GetType());

            if (exportMethod == null)
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte Export-Methode gefunden.");
            }

            object returnValue;

            ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                exportMethod.GetParameters();

            if (parameters.Length == 2)
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable returnedFiles =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (returnedFiles != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in returnedFiles)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file == null)
                        continue;

                    if (!result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            /*
             * Das Verzeichnis liegt in einem neu erzeugten Archiv.
             * Daher reicht ein einziger Dateiscan nach dem Export.
             *
             * Dadurch werden auch Dateien erfasst, die Siemens erzeugt,
             * aber eventuell nicht über den Rückgabewert meldet.
             */
            foreach (
                string file
                in GetAllFiles(
                    directory))
            {
                if (!result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static MethodInfo GetNativeExportMethod(
            Type exportType)
        {
            MethodInfo cachedMethod;

            if (NativeExportMethodCache.TryGetValue(
                    exportType,
                    out cachedMethod))
            {
                return cachedMethod;
            }

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in exportType.GetMethods(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (method.Name !=
                    "Export")
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            MethodInfo selectedMethod =
                twoParameters ??
                oneParameter;

            if (selectedMethod != null)
            {
                NativeExportMethodCache[
                    exportType] =
                    selectedMethod;
            }

            return selectedMethod;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            files.AddRange(
                Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories));

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION / HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                return value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(
                        value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null ||
                    !IsSimpleType(
                        value.GetType()))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                {
                    text.Append(
                        " | ");
                }

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(
                        value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (property != null)
                {
                    object value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (value != null)
                    {
                        return Convert.ToInt32(
                            value);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object item
                in enumerable)
            {
                count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeSingleLine(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Replace("\t", " ");
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetStringProperty(
                    obj,
                    propertyName));
        }

        // ============================================================
        // TIMING
        // ============================================================

        private static string FormatDuration(
            TimeSpan duration)
        {
            if (duration.TotalSeconds <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalMilliseconds
                    .ToString("0") +
                    " ms";
            }

            if (duration.TotalMinutes <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalSeconds
                    .ToString("0.000") +
                    " s";
            }

            return
                duration.ToString(
                    @"hh\:mm\:ss\.fff");
        }

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category = category,
                    Device = device,
                    ObjectName = objectName,
                    ObjectType = objectType,
                    Status = status,
                    Details = details
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Category);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Device);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectName);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Status);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {

Dann gehe ich jetzt an den nächsten großen Funktionsblock: **rekursive Unified-ScreenGroups**. Ziel ist, nicht mehr nur `MainView`, sondern alle gruppierten Screens zu archivieren und gleichzeitig den Usage-Index darauf auszudehnen.

Die V21-Dokumentation bestätigt genau die Struktur, die wir brauchen: `HmiSoftware.ScreenGroups` enthält Gruppen; jede Gruppe besitzt wiederum `Groups` und `Screens`. Damit können wir beliebig tief rekursiv laufen.

Wir erweitern jetzt den bestehenden Exporter um **rekursive Unified-ScreenGroups**. Wichtig: Die Screen-Hierarchie wird dabei nur einmal aus TIA gelesen und anschließend sowohl für den Screen-Export als auch für den Usage-Index verwendet. Das vermeidet zugleich unnötige Doppelzugriffe.

Siemens dokumentiert für V21, dass jede Bildgruppe sowohl eine `Screens`- als auch eine `Groups`-Collection besitzt; damit ist eine beliebig tiefe rekursive Traversierung vorgesehen. ([docs.tia.siemens.cloud](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/de-de/v21/funktionen-fur-den-zugriff-auf-die-daten-eines-hmi-unified-gerates/hmisoftware/bildgruppen/auf-eigenschaften-von-bildgruppen-zugreifen?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) Root-Screens liegen weiterhin direkt unter `HmiSoftware.Screens`, während gruppierte Screens über `ScreenGroups` erreichbar sind. ([docs.tia.siemens.cloud](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/de-de/v21/funktionen-fur-den-zugriff-auf-die-daten-eines-hmi-unified-gerates/hmisoftware/bildgruppen/screengroups.create?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Hier ist die **vollständige `Program.cs`**:

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            catch (Exception ex)

                Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);
            }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            Stopwatch totalWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            var processes = TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (TiaPortal tiaPortal = processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project = tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine($"Projekt: {project.Name}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(project.Name);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("Archivziel:");
                Console.WriteLine(archiveRoot);
                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                Stopwatch watch =
                    Stopwatch.StartNew();

                ExportHardware(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                watch.Stop();

                HardwareDuration += watch.Elapsed;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"  [Zeit Hardware: {FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                Console.WriteLine();

                List<PlcReference> plcReferences =
                    BuildPlcReferences(project);

                foreach (Device device in project.Devices)
                {
                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        watch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            plcSoftware);

                        watch.Stop();

                        PlcDuration += watch.Elapsed;

                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"  [Zeit PLC {plcSoftware.Name}: " +
                            $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                        Console.WriteLine();
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            device,
                            hmiSoftware,
                            plcReferences);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(archiveRoot);

                totalWatch.Stop();

                TotalDuration =
                    totalWatch.Elapsed;

                WriteSummary(archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // ARCHIVE

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(

        {

        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHardware(

        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "HARDWARE");

            string hardwareRoot =
                Path.Combine(

            string devicesFile =

        private static void ExportHardwareDevice(
            string hardwareRoot,
            Device device,

        {
            string deviceName =
                device.Name;

            Console.WriteLine(

            string deviceDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,

                Path.Combine(

                "Classification;TypeName;OrderNumber;" +
                "FirmwareVersion;Author;Comment;" +
                "PlantDesignation;LocationIdentifier;" +
                "GsdName;GsdType;GsdId;" +
                "IsGsd;IsProfinet;IsProfibus");

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                deviceName);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                typeIdentifier);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(

                    "OrderNumber"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "FirmwareVersion"));

            AppendCsvValue(

                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(

                GetDynamicAttribute(

                    "Comment"));

                    "PlantDesignation"));

                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(

                GetDynamicAttribute(

                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(

            devicesCsv.Append(

                    GetDynamicAttribute(

                        "GsdId")));

            devicesCsv.AppendLine();

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"DEVICE: {deviceName}");

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"  TypeIdentifier: {typeIdentifier}");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(

            }

            foreach (

                in device.DeviceItems)
            {
