            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                deviceName,
                deviceName,
                "Device",
                "OK",
                "TypeIdentifier=" +
                typeIdentifier +
                "; Datei=" +
                itemsFile);
        }

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                deviceItem.Name;

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            AppendCsvValue(csv, path);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, level.ToString());
            AppendCsvValue(csv, name);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, typeIdentifier);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, position);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                orderNumber);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                firmware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet"));

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    SafeProperty(
                        deviceItem,
                        "IsProfibus")));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");
            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC REFERENCES
        // ============================================================

        private static List<PlcReference> BuildPlcReferences(
            Project project)
        {
            List<PlcReference> result =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (Device device in project.Devices)
            {
                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(device);

                if (plcSoftware == null)
                    continue;

                result.Add(
                    new PlcReference
                    {
                        DeviceName =
                            device.Name,

                        SoftwareName =
                            plcSoftware.Name
                    });
            }

            return result;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftware.Name}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftware.Name));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftware.Name,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{ex.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                group.Name))
            {
                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(group.Name));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                currentGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? group.Name
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      group.Name;
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            bool protectedBlock = false;
            bool providerAvailable = false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(block.Name) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{block.Name,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    block.Name,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    ex.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    ex.Message);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmi(
            string archiveRoot,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            HmiCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI: {device.Name}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Software: {hmiSoftware.Name}");

            string hmiRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI",
                    MakeSafeName(device.Name));

            string inventoryDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Inventory");

            string scriptsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Scripts");

            string tagTablesDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "TagTables");

            string tagsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Tags");

            string connectionsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Connections");

            string screensDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Screens");

            string relationshipsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Relationships");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                inventoryDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                scriptsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagTablesDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                connectionsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                screensDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                relationshipsDirectory);

            WriteHmiInventory(
                inventoryDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            Stopwatch watch;

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCRIPTS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiScripts(
                scriptsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScriptsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Scripts: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // TAG TABLES
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiTagTables(
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagTablesDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit TagTables: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // TAGS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagsCsv(
                tagsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Tags: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // CONNECTIONS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteConnections(
                connectionsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiConnectionsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Connections: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCREENS + SCREEN GROUPS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            List<HmiScreenEntry> allScreens =
                CollectAllHmiScreens(
                    hmiSoftware);

            ExportHmiScreens(
                screensDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware,
                allScreens);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScreensDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Screens: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // RELATIONSHIPS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
                relationshipsDirectory,
                device,
                hmiSoftware,
                plcReferences,
                allScreens);

            watch.Stop();

            RelationshipsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Relationships gesamt: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

            TryAppendCount(

        // HMI SCRIPTS
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiScripts(
            string scriptsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Script-Module: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.Scripts.Count}");

            try
            {
                IEnumerable<FileInfo> files =
                    hmiSoftware.Scripts.Export(
                        new DirectoryInfo(
                            scriptsDirectory));

                if (files != null)
                {
                    foreach (
                        FileInfo file
                        in files)
                    {
                        if (file == null)
                            continue;

                        HmiScriptFilesExported++;

                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"    {file.Name}");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                HmiScriptExportsFailed++;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    "  Script-Export FEHLER:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI TAG TABLES
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                device.Name,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (object group in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (object table in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (string file in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      {Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI TAGS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagsCsv(
            string tagsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    tagsDirectory,
                    "Tags.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TagTable;DataType;Connection;" +
                "PlcTag;Address;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "AccessMode;AcquisitionCycle;" +
                "AcquisitionMode;ReadOnly");

            int count = 0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (object tag in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "DataType"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AccessMode"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionCycle"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionMode"));

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "ReadOnly")));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiTagsDocumented += count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tags dokumentiert: {count}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // CONNECTIONS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteConnections(
            string connectionsDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string csvFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    connectionsDirectory,
                    "Connections.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;Type;Properties");

            int count = 0;

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object connection
                    in connections)
                {
                    if (connection == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    string name =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            connection,
                            "Name");

                    string properties =
                        GetSimplePropertiesText(
                            connection);

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(name));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            connection
                                .GetType()
                                .FullName));

                    csv.Append(";");

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(properties));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                csvFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiConnectionsDocumented += count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: {count}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SCREEN COLLECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static List<HmiScreenEntry>
            CollectAllHmiScreens(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            List<HmiScreenEntry> result =
                new List<HmiScreenEntry>();

            HashSet<object> visitedScreens =
                new HashSet<object>();

            // Root screens
            AddScreensFromCollection(
                hmiSoftware.Screens,
                "",
                false,
                result,
                visitedScreens);

            // Screen groups
            object rootGroups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "ScreenGroups");

            CollectScreenGroupsRecursive(
                rootGroups,
                "",
                result,
                visitedScreens);

            return result;
        }

        private static void CollectScreenGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentPath,
            List<HmiScreenEntry> screens,
            HashSet<object> visitedScreens)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (object group in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                HmiScreenGroupsDocumented++;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedScreenGroup";
                }

                string currentPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        parentPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : parentPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                AddScreensFromCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Screens"),
                    currentPath,
                    true,
                    screens,
                    visitedScreens);

                CollectScreenGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    currentPath,
                    screens,
                    visitedScreens);
            }
        }

        private static void AddScreensFromCollection(
            object collection,
            string groupPath,
            bool grouped,
            List<HmiScreenEntry> result,
            HashSet<object> visitedScreens)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (object screen in enumerable)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                /*
                 * Schutz gegen mögliche doppelte Enumeration desselben
                 * Openness-Objekts.
                 */
                if (visitedScreens.Contains(
                    screen))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                visitedScreens.Add(
                    screen);

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                HmiScreenEntry entry =
                    new HmiScreenEntry();

                entry.Screen =
                    screen;

                entry.ScreenName =
                    screenName;

                entry.GroupPath =
                    groupPath;

                entry.IsGrouped =
                    grouped;

                entry.FullPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? screenName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      screenName;

                result.Add(entry);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SCREEN EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiScreens(
            string screensDirectory,
            Device device,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<HmiScreenEntry> screens)
        {
            int rootCount = 0;
            int groupedCount = 0;

            foreach (HmiScreenEntry entry in screens)
            {
                if (entry.IsGrouped)
                    groupedCount++;
                else
                    rootCount++;
            }

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Root-Screens: {rootCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gruppierte Screens: {groupedCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens gesamt (rekursiv): {screens.Count}");

            foreach (HmiScreenEntry entry in screens)
            {
                object screen =
                    entry.Screen;

                string screenName =
                    entry.ScreenName;

                string displayName =
                    entry.FullPath;

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: {displayName,-45}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    BuildScreenArchiveDirectory(
                        screensDirectory,
                        entry);

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        screen,
                        entry);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            screen);

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;

                    if (entry.IsGrouped)
                    {
                        HmiGroupedScreensDocumented++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        HmiRootScreensDocumented++;
                    }

                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        device.Name,
                        entry.FullPath,
                        screen.GetType().FullName,
                        "OK",
                        "GroupPath=" +
                        entry.GroupPath +
                        "; Items=" +
                        itemCount +
                        "; Events=" +
                        eventCount +
                        "; Dynamizations=" +
                        dynamizationCount);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        device.Name,
                        entry.FullPath,
                        screen.GetType().FullName,
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        private static string BuildScreenArchiveDirectory(
            string screensDirectory,
            HmiScreenEntry entry)
        {
            if (!entry.IsGrouped ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    entry.GroupPath))
            {
                return Path.Combine(
                    screensDirectory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        entry.ScreenName));
            }

            string directory =
                Path.Combine(
                    screensDirectory,
                    "Groups");

            string[] pathParts =
                entry.GroupPath.Split(
                    new[] { '\\' },
                    StringSplitOptions
                        .RemoveEmptyEntries);

            foreach (string part in pathParts)
            {
                directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        directory,
                        MakeSafeName(part));
            }

            directory =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        entry.ScreenName));

            return directory;
        }

        private static void WriteScreenInfo(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen,
            HmiScreenEntry entry)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Name: {entry.ScreenName}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"GroupPath: {entry.GroupPath}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"FullPath: {entry.FullPath}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Grouped: {entry.IsGrouped}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $".NET-Typ: " +
                $"{screen.GetType().FullName}");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"ScreenItems: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "ScreenItems"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"EventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "EventHandlers"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Dynamizations: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "Dynamizations"))}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PropertyEventHandlers: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(GetPropertyValue(screen, "PropertyEventHandlers"))}");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static int WriteScreenItemsCsv(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenItems.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Index;Name;Type;FullType;" +
                "Left;Top;Width;Height;" +
                "Visible;Enabled;Text;" +
                "ProcessValue;Tag;Screen;ScreenName;" +
                "EventHandlers;Dynamizations;" +
                "PropertyEventHandlers");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            int count = 0;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (object item in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        count.ToString());

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        item.GetType().Name);

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        item.GetType().FullName);

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Left");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Top");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Width");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Height");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Visible");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Enabled");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Text");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ProcessValue");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Tag");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "Screen");

                    AppendCsvProperty(
                        csv,
                        item,
                        "ScreenName");

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            GetPropertyValue(
                                item,
                                "EventHandlers"))
                        .ToString());

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            GetPropertyValue(
                                item,
                                "Dynamizations"))
                        .ToString());

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetCollectionCount(
                                GetPropertyValue(
                                    item,
                                    "PropertyEventHandlers"))
                            .ToString()));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            object screen)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count = 0;

            count +=
                WriteObjectCollection(
                    text,
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        screen,
                        "EventHandlers"),
                    "Screen");

            IEnumerable items =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    screen,
                    "ScreenItems")
                as IEnumerable;

            if (items != null)
            {
                foreach (object item in items)
                {
                    if (item == null)
                        continue;

                    object events =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers");

                    if (GetCollectionCount(events) == 0)
                        continue;

                    string itemName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            item,
                            "Name");

                    text.AppendLine();

                    text.AppendLine(
                        "--------------------------------------------------");

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"Objekt: {itemName}");

                    count +=
                        WriteObjectCollection(
                            text,
                            events,
                            itemName);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }
