        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIPS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
            string relationshipsDirectory,
            Device hmiDevice,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences,
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex,
            int screenCount)
        {
            string fullFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "HmiTagToPlc.csv");

            string unresolvedFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "UnresolvedRelationships.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder unresolvedCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            string header =
                "HmiDevice;HmiSoftware;HmiTag;TagTable;" +
                "DataType;Connection;PlcTag;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "Address;AccessMode;ResolvedPlcDevice;" +
                "ResolvedPlcSoftware;ResolutionStatus;" +
                "Classification;ScreenUsage;" +
                "DynamizationUsage;EventUsage;" +
                "ConnectionProperties";

            csv.AppendLine(
                header);

            unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                header);

            Console.WriteLine(
                "  Beziehungsindex wird ausgewertet...");

            Stopwatch connectionWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>
                connectionIndex =
                    BuildConnectionIndex(
                        hmiSoftware,
                        plcReferences);

            connectionWatch.Stop();

            ConnectionIndexDuration +=
                connectionWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Connections im Index: " +
                $"{connectionIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Screens im Usage-Index: " +
                $"{screenCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Tags mit Screen-Verwendung: " +
                $"{usageIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Connection-Index: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(connectionWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Usage-Index wurde beim Screen-Export aufgebaut");

            int localCount =
                0;

            int localResolved =
                0;

            int localUnresolved =
                0;

            int localSystem =
                0;

            int localInternal =
                0;

            int localPlcReferenceUnresolved =
                0;

            int localConnectionUnresolved =
                0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    localCount++;

                    RelationshipsDocumented++;

                    string tagName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name");

                    string tagTable =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable");

                    string connectionName =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection");

                    string plcTag =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag");

                    string symbolicAddress =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress");

                    string address =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address");

                    ConnectionInfo connectionInfo =
                        null;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            connectionName))
                    {
                        connectionIndex.TryGetValue(
                            connectionName,
                            out connectionInfo);
                    }

                    string connectionProperties =
                        connectionInfo == null
                        ? ""
                        : connectionInfo.Properties;

                    string resolvedDevice =
                        "";

                    string resolvedSoftware =
                        "";

                    string resolutionStatus;
                    string classification;

                    PlcReference resolved =
                        connectionInfo == null
                        ? null
                        : connectionInfo.ResolvedPlc;

                    if (resolved != null)
                    {
                        resolvedDevice =
                            resolved.DeviceName;

                        resolvedSoftware =
                            resolved.SoftwareName;

                        resolutionStatus =
                            "RESOLVED_FROM_CONNECTION";

                        classification =
                            "PLC_TAG";

                        RelationshipsResolvedToPlc++;

                        localResolved++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        classification =
                            ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
                                tagName,
                                tagTable,
                                connectionName,
                                plcTag,
                                symbolicAddress,
                                address);

                        resolutionStatus =
                            classification;

                        RelationshipsUnresolved++;

                        localUnresolved++;

                        if (classification ==
                            "SYSTEM_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipSystemTags++;
                            localSystem++;
                        }
                        else if (classification ==
                                 "INTERNAL_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipInternalTags++;
                            localInternal++;
                        }
                        else if (
                            classification ==
                            "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE")
                        {
                            RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                            localPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            RelationshipConnectionUnresolved++;
                            localConnectionUnresolved++;
                        }
                    }

                    UsageResult usage =
                        null;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            tagName))
                    {
                        usageIndex.TryGetValue(
                            tagName,
                            out usage);
                    }

                    if (usage == null)
                    {
                        usage =
                            new UsageResult();
                    }

                    RelationshipScreenUsages +=
                        usage.TotalUsageCount;

                    string row =
                        BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
                            hmiDevice.Name,
                            hmiSoftware.Name,
                            tagName,
                            tagTable,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "DataType"),
                            connectionName,
                            plcTag,
                            symbolicAddress,
                            address,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "AccessMode"),
                            resolvedDevice,
                            resolvedSoftware,
                            resolutionStatus,
                            classification,
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.ScreenItems),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Dynamizations),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Events),
                            NormalizeSingleLine(
                                connectionProperties));

                    csv.AppendLine(
                        row);

                    if (resolved == null)
                    {
                        unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                            row);
                    }
                }
            }

            Stopwatch writeWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            File.WriteAllText(
                fullFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                unresolvedFile,
                unresolvedCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            writeWatch.Stop();

            RelationshipWriteDuration +=
                writeWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Relationship-Dateien: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(writeWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Beziehungen dokumentiert: " +
                $"{localCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    PLC aufgelöst: " +
                $"{localResolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    offen gesamt: " +
                $"{localUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      System-Tags: " +
                $"{localSystem}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      interne Tags: " +
                $"{localInternal}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      PLC-Referenz, Connection unklar: " +
                $"{localPlcReferenceUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      Connection nicht identifizierbar: " +
                $"{localConnectionUnresolved}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_RELATIONSHIPS",
                hmiDevice.Name,
                hmiSoftware.Name,
                "HmiTagToPlc.csv",
                "OK",
                "Tags=" +
                localCount +
                "; Screens=" +
                screenCount +
                "; Resolved=" +
                localResolved +
                "; Unresolved=" +
                localUnresolved +
                "; System=" +
                localSystem +
                "; Internal=" +
                localInternal +
                "; PlcRefUnresolved=" +
                localPlcReferenceUnresolved +
                "; ConnectionUnresolved=" +
                localConnectionUnresolved);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIP INDEX
        // ============================================================

        private static HashSet<string>
            BuildKnownTagNameSet(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            HashSet<string> result =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object tag
                in tags)
            {
                if (tag == null)
                    continue;

                string name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "Name");

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        name);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>
            BuildConnectionIndex(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
                List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo> result =
                new Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>(
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object connection
                in connections)
            {
                if (connection == null)
                    continue;

                string name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        connection,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string properties =
                    GetDeepReadableText(
                        connection,
                        0,
                        2);

                ConnectionInfo info =
                    new ConnectionInfo();

                info.Name =
                    name;

                info.Properties =
                    properties;

                info.ResolvedPlc =
                    ResolvePlcReference(
                        properties,
                        plcReferences);

                result[name] =
                    info;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static UsageResult
            GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                Dictionary<string, UsageResult> index,
                string tagName)
        {
            UsageResult result;

            if (!index.TryGetValue(
                    tagName,
                    out result))
            {
                result =
                    new UsageResult();

                index[tagName] =
                    result;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void ScanObjectForKnownTags(
            object obj,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            string text =
                obj as string;

            if (text != null)
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    text,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    SafeToString(
                        obj),
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return;

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                obj as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object child
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                        child,
                        knownTagNames,
                        foundTags,
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth,
                        skipBehaviorContainers);
                }

                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    skipBehaviorContainers))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    value,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags,
                    depth + 1,
                    maxDepth,
                    skipBehaviorContainers);
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
            string propertyName,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            string[] structuralSkip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in structuralSkip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            if (skipBehaviorContainers)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "EventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "Dynamizations",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddKnownTagsFromText(
            string text,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    text))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                text))
            {
                foundTags.Add(
                    text);
            }

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '"',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '\'',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);
        }

        private static void ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
            string text,
            char quote,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            int start =
                0;

            while (start <
                   text.Length)
            {
                int open =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        start);

                if (open < 0)
                    break;

                int close =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        open + 1);

                if (close < 0)
                    break;

                if (close >
                    open + 1)
                {
                    string candidate =
                        text.Substring(
                            open + 1,
                            close - open - 1);

                    if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                        candidate))
                    {
                        foundTags.Add(
                            candidate);
                    }
                }

                start =
                    close + 1;
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIP CLASSIFICATION
        // ============================================================

        private static string ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable,
            string connectionName,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address)
        {
            if (IsSystemTag(
                tagName,
                tagTable))
            {
                return "SYSTEM_TAG";
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                connectionName))
            {
                return "INTERNAL_TAG";
            }

            bool hasPlcReference =
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    plcTag) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    symbolicAddress) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    address);

            if (hasPlcReference)
            {
                return
                    "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
            }

            return
                "CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
        }

        private static bool IsSystemTag(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagName) &&
                tagName.StartsWith(
                    "@",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagTable))
            {
                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "HMISystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "PLCSystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "System",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
            string hmiDevice,
            string hmiSoftware,
            string hmiTag,
            string tagTable,
            string dataType,
            string connection,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address,
            string accessMode,
            string resolvedPlcDevice,
            string resolvedPlcSoftware,
            string resolutionStatus,
            string classification,
            string screenUsage,
            string dynamizationUsage,
            string eventUsage,
            string connectionProperties)
        {
            StringBuilder row =
                new StringBuilder();

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                hmiDevice);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                hmiSoftware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                hmiTag);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                tagTable);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                dataType);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                connection);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                plcTag);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                symbolicAddress);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                address);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                accessMode);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                resolvedPlcDevice);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                resolvedPlcSoftware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                resolutionStatus);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                classification);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                screenUsage);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                dynamizationUsage);

            AppendCsvValue(
                row,
                eventUsage);

            row.Append(
                Csv(
                    connectionProperties));

            return row.ToString();
        }

        private static PlcReference ResolvePlcReference(
            string connectionText,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connectionText) ||
                plcReferences == null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            List<PlcReference> matches =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                PlcReference plc
                in plcReferences)
            {
                bool match =
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.DeviceName) ||
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.SoftwareName);

                if (match)
                {
                    matches.Add(
                        plc);
                }
            }

            if (matches.Count == 1)
            {
                return matches[0];
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string GetDeepReadableText(
            object obj,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return "";
            }

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type =
                obj.GetType();

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return SafeToString(
                    obj);
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                type.GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType =
                    value.GetType();

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.Append(
                        property.Name);

                    text.Append("=");

                    text.Append(
                        SafeToString(
                            value));

                    text.Append(" | ");
                }
                else if (depth < maxDepth)
                {
                    string nested =
                        GetDeepReadableText(
                            value,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        nested))
                    {
                        text.Append(
                            property.Name);

                        text.Append("={");

                        text.Append(
                            nested);

                        text.Append("} | ");
                    }
                }
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
            string name)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems"
            };

            foreach (
                string value
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    value,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddUnique(
            List<string> list,
            string value)
        {
            if (list == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!list.Contains(
                    value))
            {
                list.Add(
                    value);
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsText(
            string source,
            string search)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    source) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    search))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return source.IndexOf(
                search,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectList(
            StringBuilder text,
            List<object> objects,
            string ownerName)
        {
            if (objects == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in objects)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine();

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] " +
                    $"{obj.GetType().Name}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: " +
                    $"{obj.GetType().FullName}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties =
                obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: " +
                        $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    int count =
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            value);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({count})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            foreach (
                                object child
                                in enumerable)
                            {
                                if (child == null)
                                    continue;

                                DumpObjectProperties(
                                    text,
                                    child,
                                    indent + "  ",
                                    depth + 1,
                                    maxDepth);
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            text.AppendLine(
                                $"{indent}  " +
                                $"<Enumeration nicht verfügbar: " +
                                $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{value.GetType().FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    value.GetType()))
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string value =
                (propertyName +
                 " " +
                 valueType.FullName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                value.Contains("script") ||
                value.Contains("trigger") ||
                value.Contains("tag") ||
                value.Contains("action") ||
                value.Contains("parameter") ||
                value.Contains("converter") ||
                value.Contains("mapping") ||
                value.Contains("reference");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OPTIMIZED NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo exportMethod =
                GetNativeExportMethod(
                    exportObject.GetType());

            if (exportMethod == null)
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte Export-Methode gefunden.");
            }

            object returnValue;

            ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                exportMethod.GetParameters();

            if (parameters.Length == 2)
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable returnedFiles =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (returnedFiles != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in returnedFiles)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file == null)
                        continue;

                    if (!result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in GetAllFiles(
                    directory))
            {
                if (!result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static MethodInfo GetNativeExportMethod(
            Type exportType)
        {
            MethodInfo cachedMethod;

            if (NativeExportMethodCache.TryGetValue(
                    exportType,
                    out cachedMethod))
            {
                return cachedMethod;
            }

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in exportType.GetMethods(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (method.Name !=
                    "Export")
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            MethodInfo selectedMethod =
                twoParameters ??
                oneParameter;

            if (selectedMethod != null)
            {
                NativeExportMethodCache[
                    exportType] =
                    selectedMethod;
            }

            return selectedMethod;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            files.AddRange(
                Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories));

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    if (!deviceItem.IsPlugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // REFLECTION / HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                return value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(
                        value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in obj.GetType().GetProperties(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null ||
                    !IsSimpleType(
                        value.GetType()))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                {
                    text.Append(
                        " | ");
                }

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(
                        value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (property != null)
                {
                    object value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (value != null)
                    {
                        return Convert.ToInt32(
                            value);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            try
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeSingleLine(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Replace("\t", " ");
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                return ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetStringProperty(
                    obj,
                    propertyName));
        }

        // ============================================================
        // TIMING
        // ============================================================

        private static string FormatDuration(
            TimeSpan duration)
        {
            if (duration.TotalSeconds <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalMilliseconds
                    .ToString("0") +
                    " ms";
            }

            if (duration.TotalMinutes <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalSeconds
                    .ToString("0.000") +
                    " s";
            }

            return
                duration.ToString(
                    @"hh\:mm\:ss\.fff");
        }

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category =
                        category,

                    Device =
                        device,

                    ObjectName =
                        objectName,

                    ObjectType =
                        objectType,

                    Status =
                        status,

                    Details =
                        details
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Category);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Device);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectName);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Status);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        // ============================================================

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "\"\"";

            return "\"" +
                   value.Replace(
                       "\"",
                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

# chatgpt response

Jetzt ist die Ursache präziser: Der Screen-Export selbst kommt bis weit in die gruppierten Screens. Der Absturz wird sehr wahrscheinlich dadurch ausgelöst, dass wir später erneut `device.Name` auf dem Siemens-`DeviceImpl` lesen; genau dieser Zugriff ist laut Stacktrace bereits disposed. Ich entferne deshalb solche späten Zugriffe auf Siemens-Proxyobjekte und arbeite ab HMI-Start nur noch mit gecachten Strings.

Der neue Lauf zeigt zwei wichtige Dinge:

1. **Die rekursive ScreenGroup-Erfassung funktioniert.** Schon beim ersten HMI werden **43 Screens statt bisher 1** gefunden.
2. Der aktuelle Absturz ist ein anderes Problem: Im Stacktrace ist ausdrücklich `Siemens.Engineering.HW.DeviceImpl` disposed. Das passiert in `ExportHmiScreensAndBuildUsageIndex`. Damit ist nicht der Screen-Enumerator das aktuelle Problem, sondern ein später Zugriff auf das Siemens-`Device`-Proxyobjekt.

Ich ändere deshalb die Architektur so, dass `device.Name` und `hmiSoftware.Name` **einmal direkt beim Start des HMI-Exports gelesen und danach nur noch als normale C#-Strings weitergegeben werden**. Damit hängen Report, Screenexport und Relationships nicht mehr unnötig von der Lebensdauer des `DeviceImpl` ab.

Zusätzlich ist der Catch-Block jetzt so gebaut, dass selbst ein Fehler beim Schreiben des Reports den eigentlichen Screenfehler **nicht mehr maskieren kann**.

## Vollständige `Program.cs`

using System;

namespace TiaOpennessTest
{
    internal class Program
    {
        private static readonly List<ReportEntry> ReportEntries =
            new List<ReportEntry>();

        private static readonly Dictionary<Type, MethodInfo>
            NativeExportMethodCache =
                new Dictionary<Type, MethodInfo>();

        // ============================================================
        // COUNTERS
        // ============================================================

        private static int PlcCount = 0;
        private static int HmiCount = 0;

        private static int RelationshipsUnresolved = 0;
        private static int RelationshipScreenUsages = 0;

        private static int RelationshipInternalTags = 0;
        private static int RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved = 0;
        private static int RelationshipConnectionUnresolved = 0;

        private static TimeSpan TotalDuration =

        private static TimeSpan HardwareDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan PlcDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiScriptsDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiTagTablesDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiTagsDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiConnectionsDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiScreensDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan RelationshipsDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan ConnectionIndexDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan UsageIndexDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan RelationshipWriteDuration =
            TimeSpan.Zero;

        // ============================================================
        // MAIN
        // ============================================================

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding =
                Encoding.UTF8;

            try
            {
                RunExport();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(ex);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "SCHWERER FEHLER:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    actual.GetType().FullName);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    actual.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    actual.StackTrace);
            }
        }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            Stopwatch totalWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (
                TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                    processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project =
                    tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                string projectName =
                    project.Name;

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"Projekt: {projectName}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(
                        projectName);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Archivziel:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    archiveRoot);

                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                Stopwatch watch =
                    Stopwatch.StartNew();

                ExportHardware(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                watch.Stop();

                HardwareDuration +=
                    watch.Elapsed;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"  [Zeit Hardware: " +
                    $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                Console.WriteLine();

                List<PlcReference> plcReferences =
                    BuildPlcReferences(
                        project);

                foreach (
                    Device device
                    in project.Devices)
                {
                    /*
                     * WICHTIG:
                     * Namen möglichst früh aus den Siemens-Proxies lesen.
                     * Danach verwenden wir für Logging/Reports normale
                     * C#-Strings und greifen nicht unnötig erneut auf
                     * DeviceImpl.Name zu.
                     */
                    string cachedDeviceName =
                        SafeEngineeringName(
                            device,
                            "<unbekanntes Gerät>");

                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        string cachedPlcName =
                            SafeEngineeringName(
                                plcSoftware,
                                "<unbekannte PLC>");

                        watch =
                            Stopwatch.StartNew();

                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            cachedDeviceName,
                            cachedPlcName,
                            plcSoftware);

                        watch.Stop();

                        PlcDuration +=
                            watch.Elapsed;

                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"  [Zeit PLC {cachedPlcName}: " +
                            $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                        Console.WriteLine();
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        string cachedHmiSoftwareName =
                            SafeEngineeringName(
                                hmiSoftware,
                                "<unbekannte HMI-Software>");

                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            cachedDeviceName,
                            cachedHmiSoftwareName,
                            hmiSoftware,
                            plcReferences);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(
                    archiveRoot);

                totalWatch.Stop();

                TotalDuration =
                    totalWatch.Elapsed;

                WriteSummary(
                    archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // ARCHIVE
        // ============================================================

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(
            string projectName)
        {
            string safeProjectName =
                MakeSafeName(
                    projectName);

            string timestamp =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

            string archiveRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    @"C:\TiaProjectArchive",
                    safeProjectName +
                    "_" +
                    timestamp);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                archiveRoot);

            return archiveRoot;
        }

        private static void CreateBaseDirectories(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report"));
        }

        private static void WriteProjectInfo(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project",
                    "ProjectInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA Project Archive");

            text.AppendLine(
                "===================");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Projektname: " +
                $"{SafeEngineeringName(project, "<unbekannt>")}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Projektpfad: {project.Path}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "Projektpfad: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Exportdatum: " +
                $"{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA-Version: V21");

            text.AppendLine(
                ".NET Framework: 4.8");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }
