        // HARDWARE
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHardware(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "HARDWARE");

            string hardwareRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware");

            string devicesFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "Devices.csv");

            string treeFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "HardwareTree.txt");

            StringBuilder devicesCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder tree =
                new StringBuilder();

            devicesCsv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TypeIdentifier;IsGsd;" +
                "TypeName;OrderNumber;FirmwareVersion;" +
                "Author;Comment;PlantDesignation;" +
                "LocationIdentifier;GsdName;GsdType;GsdId");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "TIA HARDWARE TREE");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "=================");

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                string deviceName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        device,
                        "<unbekanntes Gerät>");

                try
                {
                    ExportHardwareDevice(
                        hardwareRoot,
                        device,
                        deviceName,
                        devicesCsv,
                        tree);

                    HardwareDevicesDocumented++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HardwareErrors++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"  Gerät {deviceName}: FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"    {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                        deviceName,
                        deviceName,
                        "Device",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                devicesFile,
                devicesCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                treeFile,
                tree.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Geräte dokumentiert: " +
                $"{HardwareDevicesDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Hardwareobjekte: " +
                $"{HardwareItemsDocumented}");
        }

        private static void ExportHardwareDevice(
            string hardwareRoot,
            Device device,
            string deviceName,
            StringBuilder devicesCsv,
            StringBuilder tree)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gerät: {deviceName}");

            string deviceDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        deviceName));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                deviceDirectory);

            string itemsFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    deviceDirectory,
                    "DeviceItems.csv");

            StringBuilder itemsCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            itemsCsv.AppendLine(
                "Path;Level;Name;TypeIdentifier;" +
                "PositionNumber;IsPlugged;IsBuiltIn;" +
                "Classification;TypeName;OrderNumber;" +
                "FirmwareVersion;Author;Comment;" +
                "PlantDesignation;LocationIdentifier;" +
                "GsdName;GsdType;GsdId;" +
                "IsGsd;IsProfinet;IsProfibus");

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                deviceName);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                typeIdentifier);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "FirmwareVersion"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdType"));

            devicesCsv.Append(
                Csv(
                    GetDynamicAttribute(
                        device,
                        "GsdId")));

            devicesCsv.AppendLine();

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"DEVICE: {deviceName}");

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"  TypeIdentifier: " +
                $"{typeIdentifier}");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.AppendLine(
                    $"  OrderNumber: " +
                    $"{orderNumber}");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                DeviceItem deviceItem
                in device.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    deviceItem,
                    itemsCsv,
                    tree,
                    deviceName,
                    0);
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            File.WriteAllText(
                itemsFile,
                itemsCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                deviceName,
                deviceName,
                "Device",
                "OK",
                "TypeIdentifier=" +
                typeIdentifier +
                "; Datei=" +
                itemsFile);
        }

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    deviceItem,
                    "UnnamedDeviceItem");

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            AppendCsvValue(csv, path);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, level.ToString());
            AppendCsvValue(csv, name);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, typeIdentifier);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, position);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                orderNumber);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                firmware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet"));

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    SafeProperty(
                        deviceItem,
                        "IsProfibus")));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");
            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC REFERENCES
        // ============================================================

        private static List<PlcReference>
            BuildPlcReferences(
                Project project)
        {
            List<PlcReference> result =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                Device device
                in project.Devices)
            {
                string deviceName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        device,
                        "");

                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(
                        device);

                if (plcSoftware == null)
                    continue;

                string softwareName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        plcSoftware,
                        "");

                PlcReference reference =
                    new PlcReference();

                reference.DeviceName =
                    deviceName;

                reference.SoftwareName =
                    softwareName;

                result.Add(
                    reference);
            }

            return result;
        }

        // PLC EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            string deviceName,
            string plcSoftwareName,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftwareName}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftwareName));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftwareName,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(ex);

                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftwareName,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    actual.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    actual.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{actual.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            string groupName =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    group,
                    "");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                groupName))
            {
                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                currentGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string blockName =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    block,
                    "UnnamedBlock");

            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        blockName) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{blockName,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    blockName,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(
                        ex);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {actual.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    blockName,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    actual.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    actual.Message);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmi(
            string archiveRoot,
            string deviceName,
            string hmiSoftwareName,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            HmiCount++;

            /*
             * Ab hier kein Zugriff mehr auf Device.Name.
             * deviceName ist bereits ein normaler String.
             */

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI: {deviceName}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Software: {hmiSoftwareName}");

            string hmiRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        deviceName));

            string inventoryDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Inventory");

            string scriptsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Scripts");

            string tagTablesDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "TagTables");

            string tagsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Tags");

            string connectionsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Connections");

            string screensDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Screens");

            string relationshipsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Relationships");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                inventoryDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                scriptsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagTablesDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                connectionsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                screensDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                relationshipsDirectory);

            WriteHmiInventory(
                inventoryDirectory,
                deviceName,
                hmiSoftwareName,
                hmiSoftware);

            Stopwatch watch;

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCRIPTS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiScripts(
                scriptsDirectory,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScriptsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Scripts: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // TAG TABLES
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiTagTables(
                tagTablesDirectory,
                deviceName,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagTablesDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit TagTables: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // TAGS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagsCsv(
                tagsDirectory,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Tags: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // CONNECTIONS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteConnections(
                connectionsDirectory,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiConnectionsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Connections: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCREENS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            List<HmiScreenEntry> allScreens =
                CollectAllHmiScreens(
                    hmiSoftware);

            HashSet<string> knownTagNames =
                BuildKnownTagNameSet(
                    hmiSoftware);

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            Dictionary<string, UsageResult>
                usageIndex =
                    ExportHmiScreensAndBuildUsageIndex(
                        screensDirectory,
                        deviceName,
                        allScreens,
                        knownTagNames);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScreensDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Screens inkl. Usage-Index: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // RELATIONSHIPS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
                relationshipsDirectory,
                deviceName,
                hmiSoftwareName,
                hmiSoftware,
                plcReferences,
                usageIndex,
                allScreens.Count);

            watch.Stop();

            RelationshipsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Relationships gesamt: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void WriteHmiInventory(
            string inventoryDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string hmiSoftwareName,

        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    inventoryDirectory,

                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Gerät: {deviceName}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"HMI-Software: " +
                $"{hmiSoftwareName}");

            text.AppendLine(
                "Typ: WinCC Unified");

            text.AppendLine();

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Root-Screens",
                hmiSoftware.Screens);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "ScreenGroups",
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "ScreenGroups"));

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Tag-Tabellen",
                hmiSoftware.TagTables);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Tags",
                hmiSoftware.Tags);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "System-Tags",
                hmiSoftware.SystemTags);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Verbindungen",
                hmiSoftware.Connections);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Scripts",
                hmiSoftware.Scripts);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Bitmeldungen",
                hmiSoftware.DiscreteAlarms);

            TryAppendCount(
                text,
                "Analogmeldungen",
                hmiSoftware.AnalogAlarms);

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI SCRIPTS
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiScripts(
            string scriptsDirectory,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Script-Module: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.Scripts.Count}");

            try
            {
                IEnumerable<FileInfo> files =
                    hmiSoftware.Scripts.Export(
                        new DirectoryInfo(
                            scriptsDirectory));

                if (files != null)
                {
                    foreach (
                        FileInfo file
                        in files)
                    {
                        if (file == null)
                            continue;

                        HmiScriptFilesExported++;

                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"    {file.Name}");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                HmiScriptExportsFailed++;

                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(
                        ex);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    "  Script-Export FEHLER:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {actual.Message}");
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI TAG TABLES
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                deviceName,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                deviceName,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      " +
                            $"{Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "TagTable",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        private static void WriteHmiTagsCsv(
            string tagsDirectory,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    tagsDirectory,
                    "Tags.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TagTable;DataType;Connection;" +
                "PlcTag;Address;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "AccessMode;AcquisitionCycle;" +
                "AcquisitionMode;ReadOnly");

            int count =
                0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    count++;

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "DataType"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AccessMode"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionCycle"));

                    AppendCsvValue(
                        csv,
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "AcquisitionMode"));

                    csv.Append(
                        Csv(
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "ReadOnly")));

                    csv.AppendLine();
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            HmiTagsDocumented +=
                count;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tags dokumentiert: {count}");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SCREEN COLLECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static List<HmiScreenEntry>
            CollectAllHmiScreens(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            List<HmiScreenEntry> result =
                new List<HmiScreenEntry>();

            HashSet<object> visitedScreens =
                new HashSet<object>();

            AddScreensFromCollection(
                hmiSoftware.Screens,
                "",
                false,
                result,
                visitedScreens);

            object rootGroups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "ScreenGroups");

            CollectScreenGroupsRecursive(
                rootGroups,
                "",
                result,
                visitedScreens);

            return result;
        }

        private static void CollectScreenGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentPath,
            List<HmiScreenEntry> screens,
            HashSet<object> visitedScreens)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                HmiScreenGroupsDocumented++;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedScreenGroup";
                }

                string currentPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        parentPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : parentPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                AddScreensFromCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Screens"),
                    currentPath,
                    true,
                    screens,
                    visitedScreens);

                CollectScreenGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    currentPath,
                    screens,
                    visitedScreens);
            }
        }

        private static void AddScreensFromCollection(
            object collection,
            string groupPath,
            bool grouped,
            List<HmiScreenEntry> result,
            HashSet<object> visitedScreens)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                if (visitedScreens.Contains(
                    screen))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                visitedScreens.Add(
                    screen);

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                HmiScreenEntry entry =
                    new HmiScreenEntry();

                entry.Screen =
                    screen;

                entry.ScreenName =
                    screenName;

                entry.GroupPath =
                    groupPath;

                entry.IsGrouped =
                    grouped;

                entry.FullPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? screenName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      screenName;

                result.Add(
                    entry);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SCREEN EXPORT + USAGE INDEX
        // ============================================================

        private static Dictionary<string, UsageResult>
            ExportHmiScreensAndBuildUsageIndex(
                string screensDirectory,
                string deviceName,
                List<HmiScreenEntry> screens,
                HashSet<string> knownTagNames)
        {
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex =
                new Dictionary<string, UsageResult>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            int rootCount =
                0;

            int groupedCount =
                0;

            foreach (
                HmiScreenEntry entry
                in screens)
            {
                if (entry.IsGrouped)
                {
                    groupedCount++;
                }
                else
                {
                    rootCount++;
                }
            }

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Root-Screens: {rootCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gruppierte Screens: " +
                $"{groupedCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens gesamt (rekursiv): " +
                $"{screens.Count}");

            foreach (
                HmiScreenEntry entry
                in screens)
            {
                string screenFullPath =
                    entry.FullPath;

                string screenType =
                    "";

                try
                {
                    if (entry.Screen != null)
                    {
                        screenType =
                            entry.Screen
                                .GetType()
                                .FullName;
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                    screenType =
                        "<Typ nicht verfügbar>";
                }

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{screenFullPath,-45}");

                string screenDirectory =
                    BuildScreenArchiveDirectory(
                        screensDirectory,
                        entry);

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    screenDirectory);

                try
                {
                    HmiScreenRuntimeData runtimeData =
                        MaterializeScreenData(
                            entry);

                    WriteScreenInfo(
                        screenDirectory,
                        runtimeData);

                    int itemCount =
                        WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                            screenDirectory,
                            runtimeData);

                    int eventCount =
                        WriteScreenEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            runtimeData);

                    int dynamizationCount =
                        WriteScreenDynamizations(
                            screenDirectory,
                            runtimeData);

                    int propertyEventCount =
                        WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                            screenDirectory,
                            runtimeData);

                    Stopwatch usageWatch =
                        Stopwatch.StartNew();

                    AddScreenToUsageIndex(
                        runtimeData,
                        knownTagNames,
                        usageIndex);

                    usageWatch.Stop();

                    UsageIndexDuration +=
                        usageWatch.Elapsed;

                    HmiScreensDocumented++;

                    if (entry.IsGrouped)
                    {
                        HmiGroupedScreensDocumented++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        HmiRootScreensDocumented++;
                    }

                    HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                        itemCount;

                    HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                        eventCount;

                    HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                        dynamizationCount;

                    HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                        propertyEventCount;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                        $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                        $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]");

                    /*
                     * WICHTIG:
                     * deviceName ist nur noch ein normaler String.
                     * Kein Zugriff auf Siemens.Engineering.HW.DeviceImpl.
                     */
                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        deviceName,
                        screenFullPath,
                        screenType,
                        "OK",
                        "GroupPath=" +
                        entry.GroupPath +
                        "; Items=" +
                        itemCount +
                        "; Events=" +
                        eventCount +
                        "; Dynamizations=" +
                        dynamizationCount);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      " +
                        $"{actual.GetType().Name}: " +
                        $"{actual.Message}");

                    /*
                     * Report darf niemals den eigentlichen Fehler
                     * überdecken.
                     */
                    try
                    {
                        AddReport(
                            "HMI_SCREEN",
                            deviceName,
                            screenFullPath,
                            screenType,
                            "ERROR",
                            actual.GetType().Name +
                            ": " +
                            actual.Message);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }
                }
            }

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Usage-Index: " +
                $"{usageIndex.Count} Tags mit Verwendung");

            return usageIndex;
        }

        private static HmiScreenRuntimeData
            MaterializeScreenData(
                HmiScreenEntry entry)
        {
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data =
                new HmiScreenRuntimeData();

            data.Entry =
                entry;

            data.ScreenEventHandlers =
                ToObjectList(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        entry.Screen,
                        "EventHandlers"));

            data.ScreenDynamizations =
                ToObjectList(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        entry.Screen,
                        "Dynamizations"));

            data.ScreenPropertyEventHandlers =
                ToObjectList(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        entry.Screen,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers"));

            List<object> rawItems =
                ToObjectList(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        entry.Screen,
                        "ScreenItems"));

            foreach (
                object item
                in rawItems)
            {
                if (item == null)
                    continue;

                HmiScreenItemRuntimeData itemData =
                    new HmiScreenItemRuntimeData();

                itemData.Item =
                    item;

                itemData.Name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        item,
                        "Name");

                itemData.EventHandlers =
                    ToObjectList(
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers"));

                itemData.Dynamizations =
                    ToObjectList(
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "Dynamizations"));

                itemData.PropertyEventHandlers =
                    ToObjectList(
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            item,
                            "PropertyEventHandlers"));

                data.Items.Add(
                    itemData);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private static List<object> ToObjectList(
            object collection)
        {
            List<object> result =
                new List<object>();

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return result;

            try
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    if (item != null)
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            item);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                /*
                 * Kein harter Abbruch:
                 * Falls eine einzelne Siemens-Composition bereits
                 * ungültig ist, liefert diese Methode wenigstens die
                 * bis dahin materialisierten Objekte.
                 */
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void AddScreenToUsageIndex(
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex)
        {
            string screenReference =
                data.Entry.FullPath;

            HashSet<string> screenEventTags =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                data.ScreenEventHandlers,
                knownTagNames,
                screenEventTags,
                0,
                4,
                false);

            foreach (
                string tagName
                in screenEventTags)
            {
                UsageResult usage =
                    GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                        usageIndex,
                        tagName);

                AddUnique(
                    usage.Events,
                    screenReference +
                    "/[Screen]");
            }

            HashSet<string> screenDynamicTags =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                data.ScreenDynamizations,
                knownTagNames,
                screenDynamicTags,
                0,
                4,
                false);

            foreach (
                string tagName
                in screenDynamicTags)
            {
                UsageResult usage =
                    GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                        usageIndex,
                        tagName);

                AddUnique(
                    usage.Dynamizations,
                    screenReference +
                    "/[Screen]");
            }

            foreach (
                HmiScreenItemRuntimeData itemData
                in data.Items)
            {
                string itemName =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        itemData.Name)
                    ? "UnnamedItem"
                    : itemData.Name;

                string reference =
                    screenReference +
                    "/" +
                    itemName;

                HashSet<string> itemTags =
                    new HashSet<string>(
                        StringComparer.Ordinal);

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    itemData.Item,
                    knownTagNames,
                    itemTags,
                    0,
                    1,
                    true);

                foreach (
                    string tagName
                    in itemTags)
                {
                    UsageResult usage =
                        GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                            usageIndex,
                            tagName);

                    AddUnique(
                        usage.ScreenItems,
                        reference);
                }

                HashSet<string> dynamizationTags =
                    new HashSet<string>(
                        StringComparer.Ordinal);

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    itemData.Dynamizations,
                    knownTagNames,
                    dynamizationTags,
                    0,
                    4,
                    false);

                foreach (
                    string tagName
                    in dynamizationTags)
                {
                    UsageResult usage =
                        GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                            usageIndex,
                            tagName);

                    AddUnique(
                        usage.Dynamizations,
                        reference);
                }

                HashSet<string> eventTags =
                    new HashSet<string>(
                        StringComparer.Ordinal);

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    itemData.EventHandlers,
                    knownTagNames,
                    eventTags,
                    0,
                    4,
                    false);

                foreach (
                    string tagName
                    in eventTags)
                {
                    UsageResult usage =
                        GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                            usageIndex,
                            tagName);

                    AddUnique(
                        usage.Events,
                        reference);
                }
            }
        }

        private static string BuildScreenArchiveDirectory(
            string screensDirectory,
            HmiScreenEntry entry)
        {
            if (!entry.IsGrouped ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    entry.GroupPath))
            {
                return Path.Combine(
                    screensDirectory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        entry.ScreenName));
            }

            string directory =
                Path.Combine(
                    screensDirectory,
                    "Groups");

            string[] pathParts =
                entry.GroupPath.Split(
                    new[] { '\\' },
                    StringSplitOptions
                        .RemoveEmptyEntries);

            foreach (
                string part
                in pathParts)
            {
                directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        directory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            part));
            }

            directory =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        entry.ScreenName));

            return directory;
        }

        private static void WriteScreenInfo(
            string screenDirectory,
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Name: " +
                $"{data.Entry.ScreenName}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"GroupPath: " +
                $"{data.Entry.GroupPath}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"FullPath: " +
                $"{data.Entry.FullPath}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Grouped: " +
                $"{data.Entry.IsGrouped}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: " +
                    $"{data.Entry.Screen.GetType().FullName}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    ".NET-Typ: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"ScreenItems: " +
                $"{data.Items.Count}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"EventHandlers: " +
                $"{data.ScreenEventHandlers.Count}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Dynamizations: " +
                $"{data.ScreenDynamizations.Count}");

            text.AppendLine(
                $"PropertyEventHandlers: " +
                $"{data.ScreenPropertyEventHandlers.Count}");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static int WriteScreenItemsCsv(
            string screenDirectory,
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "ScreenItems.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Index;Name;Type;FullType;" +
                "Left;Top;Width;Height;" +
                "Visible;Enabled;Text;" +
                "ProcessValue;Tag;Screen;ScreenName;" +
                "EventHandlers;Dynamizations;" +
                "PropertyEventHandlers");

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                HmiScreenItemRuntimeData itemData
                in data.Items)
            {
                object item =
                    itemData.Item;

                count++;

                string itemType =
                    "";

                string itemFullType =
                    "";

                try
                {
                    itemType =
                        item.GetType().Name;

                    itemFullType =
                        item.GetType().FullName;
                }
                catch
                {
                }

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    count.ToString());

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    itemData.Name);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    itemType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    itemFullType);

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Left");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Top");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Width");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Height");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Visible");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Enabled");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Text");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "ProcessValue");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Tag");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "Screen");

                AppendCsvProperty(
                    csv,
                    item,
                    "ScreenName");

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    itemData
                        .EventHandlers
                        .Count
                        .ToString());

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    itemData
                        .Dynamizations
                        .Count
                        .ToString());

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        itemData
                            .PropertyEventHandlers
                            .Count
                            .ToString()));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        private static int WriteScreenEvents(
            string screenDirectory,
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    screenDirectory,
                    "EventHandlers.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            int count =
                0;

            count +=
                WriteObjectList(
                    text,
                    data.ScreenEventHandlers,
                    "Screen");

            foreach (
                HmiScreenItemRuntimeData itemData
                in data.Items)
            {
                if (itemData.EventHandlers.Count == 0)
                    continue;

                text.AppendLine();

                text.AppendLine(
                    "--------------------------------------------------");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Objekt: " +
                    $"{itemData.Name}");

                count +=
                    WriteObjectList(
                        text,
                        itemData.EventHandlers,
                        itemData.Name);
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            return count;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIPS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagRelationshipsOptimized(
            string relationshipsDirectory,
            string hmiDeviceName,
            string hmiSoftwareName,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences,
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex,
            int screenCount)
        {
            string fullFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "HmiTagToPlc.csv");

            string unresolvedFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "UnresolvedRelationships.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder unresolvedCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            string header =
                "HmiDevice;HmiSoftware;HmiTag;TagTable;" +
                "DataType;Connection;PlcTag;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "Address;AccessMode;ResolvedPlcDevice;" +
                "ResolvedPlcSoftware;ResolutionStatus;" +
                "Classification;ScreenUsage;" +
                "DynamizationUsage;EventUsage;" +
                "ConnectionProperties";

            csv.AppendLine(
                header);

            unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                header);

            Console.WriteLine(
                "  Beziehungsindex wird ausgewertet...");

            Stopwatch connectionWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>
                connectionIndex =
                    BuildConnectionIndex(
                        hmiSoftware,
                        plcReferences);

            connectionWatch.Stop();

            ConnectionIndexDuration +=
                connectionWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Connections im Index: " +
                $"{connectionIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Screens im Usage-Index: " +
                $"{screenCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Tags mit Screen-Verwendung: " +
                $"{usageIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Connection-Index: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(connectionWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "    Usage-Index wurde beim Screen-Export aufgebaut");

            int localCount =
                0;

            int localResolved =
                0;

            int localUnresolved =
                0;

            int localSystem =
                0;

            int localInternal =
                0;

            int localPlcReferenceUnresolved =
                0;

            int localConnectionUnresolved =
                0;

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object tag
                    in tags)
                {
                    if (tag == null)
                        continue;

                    localCount++;

                    RelationshipsDocumented++;

                    string tagName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Name");

                    string tagTable =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "TagTable");

                    string connectionName =
                        GetObjectNameProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Connection");

                    string plcTag =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "PlcTag");

                    string symbolicAddress =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "SymbolicAddress");

                    string address =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            tag,
                            "Address");

                    ConnectionInfo connectionInfo =
                        null;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            connectionName))
                    {
                        connectionIndex.TryGetValue(
                            connectionName,
                            out connectionInfo);
                    }

                    string connectionProperties =
                        connectionInfo == null
                        ? ""
                        : connectionInfo.Properties;

                    string resolvedDevice =
                        "";

                    string resolvedSoftware =
                        "";

                    string resolutionStatus;
                    string classification;

                    PlcReference resolved =
                        connectionInfo == null
                        ? null
                        : connectionInfo.ResolvedPlc;

                    if (resolved != null)
                    {
                        resolvedDevice =
                            resolved.DeviceName;

                        resolvedSoftware =
                            resolved.SoftwareName;

                        resolutionStatus =
                            "RESOLVED_FROM_CONNECTION";

                        classification =
                            "PLC_TAG";

                        RelationshipsResolvedToPlc++;

                        localResolved++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        classification =
                            ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
                                tagName,
                                tagTable,
                                connectionName,
                                plcTag,
                                symbolicAddress,
                                address);

                        resolutionStatus =
                            classification;

                        RelationshipsUnresolved++;

                        localUnresolved++;

                        if (classification ==
                            "SYSTEM_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipSystemTags++;

                            localSystem++;
                        }
                        else if (classification ==
                                 "INTERNAL_TAG")
                        {
                            RelationshipInternalTags++;

                            localInternal++;
                        }
                        else if (
                            classification ==
                            "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE")
                        {
                            RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved++;

                            localPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            RelationshipConnectionUnresolved++;

                            localConnectionUnresolved++;
                        }
                    }

                    UsageResult usage =
                        null;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            tagName))
                    {
                        usageIndex.TryGetValue(
                            tagName,
                            out usage);
                    }

                    if (usage == null)
                    {
                        usage =
                            new UsageResult();
                    }

                    RelationshipScreenUsages +=
                        usage.TotalUsageCount;

                    string row =
                        BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
                            hmiDeviceName,
                            hmiSoftwareName,
                            tagName,
                            tagTable,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "DataType"),
                            connectionName,
                            plcTag,
                            symbolicAddress,
                            address,
                            GetStringProperty(
                                tag,
                                "AccessMode"),
                            resolvedDevice,
                            resolvedSoftware,
                            resolutionStatus,
                            classification,
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.ScreenItems),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Dynamizations),
                            string.Join(
                                " | ",
                                usage.Events),
                            NormalizeSingleLine(
                                connectionProperties));

                    csv.AppendLine(
                        row);

                    if (resolved == null)
                    {
                        unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                            row);
                    }
                }
            }

            Stopwatch writeWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            File.WriteAllText(
                fullFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                unresolvedFile,
                unresolvedCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            writeWatch.Stop();

            RelationshipWriteDuration +=
                writeWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Relationship-Dateien: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(writeWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Beziehungen dokumentiert: " +
                $"{localCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    PLC aufgelöst: " +
                $"{localResolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    offen gesamt: " +
                $"{localUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      System-Tags: " +
                $"{localSystem}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      interne Tags: " +
                $"{localInternal}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      PLC-Referenz, Connection unklar: " +
                $"{localPlcReferenceUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      Connection nicht identifizierbar: " +
                $"{localConnectionUnresolved}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_RELATIONSHIPS",
                hmiDeviceName,
                hmiSoftwareName,
                "HmiTagToPlc.csv",
                "OK",
                "Tags=" +
                localCount +
                "; Screens=" +
                screenCount +
                "; Resolved=" +
                localResolved +
                "; Unresolved=" +
                localUnresolved +
                "; System=" +
                localSystem +
                "; Internal=" +
                localInternal +
                "; PlcRefUnresolved=" +
                localPlcReferenceUnresolved +
                "; ConnectionUnresolved=" +
                localConnectionUnresolved);
        }
