        private static HashSet<string>
            BuildKnownTagNameSet(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            HashSet<string> result =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object tag
                in tags)
            {
                if (tag == null)
                    continue;

                string name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "Name");

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        name);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>
            BuildConnectionIndex(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
                List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo> result =
                new Dictionary<string, ConnectionInfo>(
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object connection
                in connections)
            {
                if (connection == null)
                    continue;

                string name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        connection,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string properties =
                    GetDeepReadableText(
                        connection,
                        0,
                        2);

                ConnectionInfo info =
                    new ConnectionInfo();

                info.Name =
                    name;

                info.Properties =
                    properties;

                info.ResolvedPlc =
                    ResolvePlcReference(
                        properties,
                        plcReferences);

                result[name] =
                    info;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static UsageResult
            GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                Dictionary<string, UsageResult> index,
                string tagName)
        {
            UsageResult result;

            if (!index.TryGetValue(
                    tagName,
                    out result))
            {
                result =
                    new UsageResult();

                index[tagName] =
                    result;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void ScanObjectForKnownTags(
            object obj,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            string text =
                obj as string;

            if (text != null)
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    text,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            Type type;

            try
            {
                type =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    SafeToString(
                        obj),
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return;

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                obj as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    foreach (
                        object child
                        in enumerable)
                    {
                        ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                            child,
                            knownTagNames,
                            foundTags,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth,
                            skipBehaviorContainers);
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                }

                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    type.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property
                        .GetIndexParameters()
                        .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    skipBehaviorContainers))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    value,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags,
                    depth + 1,
                    maxDepth,
                    skipBehaviorContainers);
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
            string propertyName,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            string[] structuralSkip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "Device",
                "DeviceItem",
                "Hardware",
                "Project",
                "TiaPortal"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in structuralSkip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            if (skipBehaviorContainers)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "EventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "Dynamizations",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddKnownTagsFromText(
            string text,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    text))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                text))
            {
                foundTags.Add(
                    text);
            }

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '"',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '\'',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);
        }

        private static void ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
            string text,
            char quote,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            int start =
                0;

            while (start <
                   text.Length)
            {
                int open =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        start);

                if (open < 0)
                    break;

                int close =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        open + 1);

                if (close < 0)
                    break;

                if (close >
                    open + 1)
                {
                    string candidate =
                        text.Substring(
                            open + 1,
                            close - open - 1);

                    if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                        candidate))
                    {
                        foundTags.Add(
                            candidate);
                    }
                }

                start =
                    close + 1;
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIP CLASSIFICATION
        // ============================================================

        private static string ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable,
            string connectionName,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address)
        {
            if (IsSystemTag(
                tagName,
                tagTable))
            {
                return "SYSTEM_TAG";
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                connectionName))
            {
                return "INTERNAL_TAG";
            }

            bool hasPlcReference =
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    plcTag) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    symbolicAddress) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    address);

            if (hasPlcReference)
            {
                return
                    "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
            }

            return
                "CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
        }

        private static bool IsSystemTag(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagName) &&
                tagName.StartsWith(
                    "@",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagTable))
            {
                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "HMISystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "PLCSystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "System",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
            string hmiDevice,
            string hmiSoftware,
            string hmiTag,
            string tagTable,
            string dataType,
            string connection,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address,
            string accessMode,
            string resolvedPlcDevice,
            string resolvedPlcSoftware,
            string resolutionStatus,
            string classification,
            string screenUsage,
            string dynamizationUsage,
            string eventUsage,
            string connectionProperties)
        {
            StringBuilder row =
                new StringBuilder();

            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiDevice);
            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiSoftware);
            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiTag);
            AppendCsvValue(row, tagTable);
            AppendCsvValue(row, dataType);
            AppendCsvValue(row, connection);
            AppendCsvValue(row, plcTag);
            AppendCsvValue(row, symbolicAddress);
            AppendCsvValue(row, address);
            AppendCsvValue(row, accessMode);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolvedPlcDevice);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolvedPlcSoftware);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolutionStatus);
            AppendCsvValue(row, classification);
            AppendCsvValue(row, screenUsage);
            AppendCsvValue(row, dynamizationUsage);
            AppendCsvValue(row, eventUsage);

            row.Append(
                Csv(
                    connectionProperties));

            return row.ToString();
        }

        private static PlcReference ResolvePlcReference(
            string connectionText,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connectionText) ||
                plcReferences == null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            List<PlcReference> matches =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                PlcReference plc
                in plcReferences)
            {
                bool match =
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.DeviceName) ||
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.SoftwareName);

                if (match)
                {
                    matches.Add(
                        plc);
                }
            }

            if (matches.Count == 1)
            {
                return matches[0];
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string GetDeepReadableText(
            object obj,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return "";
            }

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type;

            try
            {
                type =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return SafeToString(
                    obj);
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    type.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property
                        .GetIndexParameters()
                        .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType;

                try
                {
                    valueType =
                        value.GetType();
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.Append(
                        property.Name);

                    text.Append("=");

                    text.Append(
                        SafeToString(
                            value));

                    text.Append(" | ");
                }
                else if (depth < maxDepth)
                {
                    string nested =
                        GetDeepReadableText(
                            value,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        nested))
                    {
                        text.Append(
                            property.Name);

                        text.Append("={");

                        text.Append(
                            nested);

                        text.Append("} | ");
                    }
                }
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
            string name)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "Device",
                "DeviceItem",
                "Hardware",
                "Project",
                "TiaPortal"
            };

            foreach (
                string value
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    value,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddUnique(
            List<string> list,
            string value)
        {
            if (list == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!list.Contains(
                    value))
            {
                list.Add(
                    value);
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsText(
            string source,
            string search)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    source) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    search))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return source.IndexOf(
                search,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectList(
            StringBuilder text,
            List<object> objects,
            string ownerName)
        {
            if (objects == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in objects)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                Type type =
                    null;

                try
                {
                    type =
                        obj.GetType();
                }
                catch
                {
                }

                text.AppendLine();

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] " +
                    $"{(type == null ? "<unbekannt>" : type.Name)}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: " +
                    $"{(type == null ? "<nicht verfügbar>" : type.FullName)}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            Type objectType;

            try
            {
                objectType =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    objectType.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property
                        .GetIndexParameters()
                        .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: " +
                        $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                Type valueType;

                try
                {
                    valueType =
                        value.GetType();
                }
                catch
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        "<Typ nicht verfügbar>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    int collectionCount =
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            value);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({collectionCount})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            foreach (
                                object child
                                in enumerable)
                            {
                                if (child == null)
                                    continue;

                                DumpObjectProperties(
                                    text,
                                    child,
                                    indent + "  ",
                                    depth + 1,
                                    maxDepth);
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            text.AppendLine(
                                $"{indent}  " +
                                $"<Enumeration nicht verfügbar: " +
                                $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{valueType.FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    valueType))
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers",
                "Device",
                "DeviceItem",
                "Hardware",
                "Project",
                "TiaPortal"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string value =
                (propertyName +
                 " " +
                 valueType.FullName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                value.Contains("script") ||
                value.Contains("trigger") ||
                value.Contains("tag") ||
                value.Contains("action") ||
                value.Contains("parameter") ||
                value.Contains("converter") ||
                value.Contains("mapping") ||
                value.Contains("reference");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo exportMethod =
                GetNativeExportMethod(
                    exportObject.GetType());

            if (exportMethod == null)
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte Export-Methode gefunden.");
            }

            object returnValue;

            ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                exportMethod.GetParameters();

            if (parameters.Length == 2)
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable returnedFiles =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (returnedFiles != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in returnedFiles)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file == null)
                        continue;

                    if (!result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in GetAllFiles(
                    directory))
            {
                if (!result.Contains(
                        file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static MethodInfo GetNativeExportMethod(
            Type exportType)
        {
            MethodInfo cachedMethod;

            if (NativeExportMethodCache.TryGetValue(
                    exportType,
                    out cachedMethod))
            {
                return cachedMethod;
            }

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in exportType.GetMethods(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (method.Name !=
                    "Export")
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            MethodInfo selectedMethod =
                twoParameters ??
                oneParameter;

            if (selectedMethod != null)
            {
                NativeExportMethodCache[
                    exportType] =
                    selectedMethod;
            }

            return selectedMethod;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            files.AddRange(
                Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories));

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    bool plugged =
                        false;

                    try
                    {
                        plugged =
                            deviceItem.IsPlugged;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    if (!plugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    bool plugged =
                        false;

                    try
                    {
                        plugged =
                            deviceItem.IsPlugged;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    if (!plugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string SafeEngineeringName(
            object obj,
            string fallback)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return fallback;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        "Name",
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return fallback;
                }

                object value =
                    property.GetValue(
                        obj,
                        null);

                if (value == null)
                    return fallback;

                string text =
                    value.ToString();

                return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    text)
                    ? fallback
                    : text;
            }
            catch
            {
                return fallback;
            }
        }

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                return value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(
                        value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetSimplePropertiesText(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type;

            try
            {
                type =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    type.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property
                        .GetIndexParameters()
                        .Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType;

                try
                {
                    valueType =
                        value.GetType();
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (!IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (text.Length > 0)
                {
                    text.Append(
                        " | ");
                }

                text.Append(
                    property.Name);

                text.Append("=");

                text.Append(
                    SafeToString(
                        value));
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (property != null)
                {
                    object value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (value != null)
                    {
                        return Convert.ToInt32(
                            value);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            try
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeSingleLine(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Replace("\t", " ");
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            while (
                ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                ex =
                    ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetStringProperty(
                    obj,
                    propertyName));
        }

        // ============================================================
        // TIMING
        // ============================================================

        private static string FormatDuration(
            TimeSpan duration)
        {
            if (duration.TotalSeconds <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalMilliseconds
                    .ToString("0") +
                    " ms";
            }

            if (duration.TotalMinutes <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalSeconds
                    .ToString("0.000") +
                    " s";
            }

            return
                duration.ToString(
                    @"hh\:mm\:ss\.fff");
        }

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category =
                        category ?? "",

                    Device =
                        device ?? "",

                    ObjectName =
                        objectName ?? "",

                    ObjectType =
                        objectType ?? "",

                    Status =
                        status ?? "",

                    Details =
                        details ?? ""
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Category);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Device);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectName);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Status);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,

            }

            return result;

                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

# chatgpt response

Jetzt ist die Ursache ziemlich eindeutig: Wir halten **Openness-Screenobjekte zu lange im Speicher** und greifen später weiter auf `HmiSoftware` zu. Das ist bei diesen Siemens-Lifetime-Proxies zu fragil.

Ich stelle deshalb auf ein robusteres Muster um: **Connections und Tags zuerst vollständig als normale C#-Snapshots lesen; danach Screens sofort beim Traversieren verarbeiten; anschließend Relationships nur noch aus Snapshots berechnen.** Dadurch gibt es nach dem Screen-Durchlauf keinen Zugriff mehr auf `HmiSoftware`.

Der neue Lauf bestätigt zwei Dinge:

- Die **rekursive ScreenGroup-Struktur funktioniert**: `HMI_RT_1` liefert 43 Screens statt 1.
- Die bisherige Lösung hält Siemens-Openness-Objekte noch zu lange fest. Nach der Screen-Verarbeitung ist jetzt sogar das `HmiSoftware`-Proxy bereits ungültig; der Absturz passiert exakt beim erneuten Zugriff auf `hmiSoftware.Connections` in `BuildConnectionIndex()`.

Außerdem sehe ich einen Qualitätsindikator, den wir nicht ignorieren dürfen: Einige Screens, die im vorherigen Lauf noch Items hatten, werden jetzt plötzlich mit `0 Items` ausgegeben, z. B. `403_System_MeldungsArchiv`, `402_System_SystemInfo` und `301_Parameter_1`. Das heißt: Das Abfangen von Enumerator-Fehlern war zu tolerant und könnte Informationen verschlucken. Das ändern wir wieder.

## Richtige Lösung

Wir drehen die Reihenfolge um:

```text
HMI-Software
   │
   ├─ Tags sofort → normale C# Snapshots
   ├─ Connections sofort → normale C# Snapshots
   │
   └─ Screens
       └─ ScreenGroups direkt rekursiv traversieren
           └─ jeden Screen SOFORT auswerten
              nicht erst Screen-Proxy speichern
                 │
                 └─ Usage-Index in normalen Strings speichern

danach:
Relationships nur aus normalen C# Daten
```

Damit werden weder `HmiSoftware` noch Screen-Proxies später erneut benötigt.

Da du ausdrücklich immer den **gesamten Code** möchtest, würde die vollständige nächste `Program.cs` sehr umfangreich. Ich will dabei aber nicht die funktionierenden PLC-, Hardware- und TagTable-Bereiche durch eine unabsichtliche Rekonstruktion verändern.

Für den nächsten Stand ändere ich deshalb genau diese Teile innerhalb der vollständigen Datei:

- `HmiTagSnapshot`
- Connection-Snapshot vor dem Screenexport
- keine `List<HmiScreenEntry>` mit Siemens-Screenobjekten mehr
- ScreenGroups werden direkt rekursiv verarbeitet
- jeder Screen wird innerhalb seiner aktuellen Collection sofort exportiert
- keine still geschluckten Screen-Enumerator-Fehler
- Relationships verwenden danach ausschließlich Snapshots
- `HmiSoftware` wird nach Beginn des Screenexports nicht mehr benötigt
