        private static TimeSpan TotalDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HardwareDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan PlcDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiScriptsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiTagTablesDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiTagsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiConnectionsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiScreensDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan RelationshipsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan ConnectionIndexDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan UsageIndexDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan RelationshipWriteDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;

        // ============================================================
        // MAIN
        // ============================================================

        private static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            try
            {
                RunExport();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(ex);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("SCHWERER FEHLER:");
                Console.WriteLine(actual.GetType().FullName);
                Console.WriteLine(actual.Message);
                Console.WriteLine(actual.StackTrace);
            }
        }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            Stopwatch totalWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            using (TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                   processes[0].Attach())
            {
                if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                    return;
                }

                Project project =
                    tiaPortal.Projects[0];

                string projectName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        project,
                        "UnnamedProject");

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"Projekt: {projectName}");

                string archiveRoot =
                    CreateArchiveRoot(
                        projectName);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("Archivziel:");
                Console.WriteLine(archiveRoot);
                Console.WriteLine();

                CreateBaseDirectories(
                    archiveRoot);

                WriteProjectInfo(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                Stopwatch watch =
                    Stopwatch.StartNew();

                ExportHardware(
                    archiveRoot,
                    project);

                watch.Stop();

                HardwareDuration +=
                    watch.Elapsed;

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"  [Zeit Hardware: " +
                    $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                Console.WriteLine();

                List<PlcReference> plcReferences =
                    BuildPlcReferences(
                        project);

                foreach (Device device in project.Devices)
                {
                    string deviceName =
                        SafeEngineeringName(
                            device,
                            "<unbekanntes Gerät>");

                    PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                        GetPlcSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (plcSoftware != null)
                    {
                        string plcSoftwareName =
                            SafeEngineeringName(
                                plcSoftware,
                                "<unbekannte PLC>");

                        watch =
                            Stopwatch.StartNew();

                        ExportPlc(
                            archiveRoot,
                            plcSoftwareName,
                            plcSoftware);

                        watch.Stop();

                        PlcDuration +=
                            watch.Elapsed;

                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"  [Zeit PLC {plcSoftwareName}: " +
                            $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                        Console.WriteLine();
                    }

                    HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                        GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                            device);

                    if (hmiSoftware != null)
                    {
                        string hmiSoftwareName =
                            SafeEngineeringName(
                                hmiSoftware,
                                "<unbekannte HMI-Software>");

                        ExportHmi(
                            archiveRoot,
                            deviceName,
                            hmiSoftwareName,
                            hmiSoftware,
                            plcReferences);
                    }
                }

                WriteReport(
                    archiveRoot);

                totalWatch.Stop();

                TotalDuration =
                    totalWatch.Elapsed;

                WriteSummary(
                    archiveRoot);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // ARCHIVE
        // ============================================================

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(
            string projectName)
        {
            string safeProjectName =
                MakeSafeName(
                    projectName);

            string timestamp =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");

            string archiveRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    @"C:\TiaProjectArchive",
                    safeProjectName +
                    "_" +
                    timestamp);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                archiveRoot);

            return archiveRoot;
        }

        private static void CreateBaseDirectories(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware"));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report"));
        }

        private static void WriteProjectInfo(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project",
                    "ProjectInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA Project Archive");

            text.AppendLine(
                "===================");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Projektname: " +
                $"{SafeEngineeringName(project, "<unbekannt>")}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Projektpfad: {project.Path}");
            }
            catch
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    "Projektpfad: <nicht verfügbar>");
            }

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Exportdatum: " +
                $"{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}");

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA-Version: V21");

            text.AppendLine(
                ".NET Framework: 4.8");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HARDWARE
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHardware(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                "HARDWARE");

            string hardwareRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "30_Hardware");

            string devicesFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "Devices.csv");

            string treeFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    "HardwareTree.txt");

            StringBuilder devicesCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder tree =
                new StringBuilder();

            devicesCsv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TypeIdentifier;IsGsd;" +
                "TypeName;OrderNumber;FirmwareVersion;" +
                "Author;Comment;PlantDesignation;" +
                "LocationIdentifier;GsdName;GsdType;GsdId");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "TIA HARDWARE TREE");

            tree.AppendLine(
                "=================");

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (Device device in project.Devices)
            {
                string deviceName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        device,
                        "<unbekanntes Gerät>");

                try
                {
                    ExportHardwareDevice(
                        hardwareRoot,
                        device,
                        deviceName,
                        devicesCsv,
                        tree);

                    HardwareDevicesDocumented++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HardwareErrors++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"  Gerät {deviceName}: FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"    {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                        deviceName,
                        deviceName,
                        "Device",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                devicesFile,
                devicesCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                treeFile,
                tree.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Geräte dokumentiert: " +
                $"{HardwareDevicesDocumented}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Hardwareobjekte: " +
                $"{HardwareItemsDocumented}");
        }

        private static void ExportHardwareDevice(
            string hardwareRoot,
            Device device,
            string deviceName,
            StringBuilder devicesCsv,
            StringBuilder tree)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gerät: {deviceName}");

            string deviceDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hardwareRoot,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        deviceName));

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                deviceDirectory);

            string itemsFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    deviceDirectory,
                    "DeviceItems.csv");

            StringBuilder itemsCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            itemsCsv.AppendLine(
                "Path;Level;Name;TypeIdentifier;" +
                "PositionNumber;IsPlugged;IsBuiltIn;" +
                "Classification;TypeName;OrderNumber;" +
                "FirmwareVersion;Author;Comment;" +
                "PlantDesignation;LocationIdentifier;" +
                "GsdName;GsdType;GsdId;" +
                "IsGsd;IsProfinet;IsProfibus");

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                deviceName);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                typeIdentifier);

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                SafeProperty(
                    device,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "FirmwareVersion"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                devicesCsv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "GsdType"));

            devicesCsv.Append(
                Csv(
                    GetDynamicAttribute(
                        device,
                        "GsdId")));

            devicesCsv.AppendLine();

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"DEVICE: {deviceName}");

            tree.AppendLine(
                $"  TypeIdentifier: " +
                $"{typeIdentifier}");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    device,
                    "OrderNumber");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.AppendLine(
                    $"  OrderNumber: " +
                    $"{orderNumber}");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            foreach (
                DeviceItem deviceItem
                in device.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    deviceItem,
                    itemsCsv,
                    tree,
                    deviceName,
                    0);
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            File.WriteAllText(
                itemsFile,
                itemsCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_DEVICE",
                deviceName,
                deviceName,
                "Device",
                "OK",
                "TypeIdentifier=" +
                typeIdentifier +
                "; Datei=" +
                itemsFile);
        }

        private static void ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
            DeviceItem deviceItem,
            StringBuilder csv,
            StringBuilder tree,
            string parentPath,
            int level)
        {
            if (deviceItem == null)
                return;

            HardwareItemsDocumented++;

            string name =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    deviceItem,
                    "UnnamedDeviceItem");

            string path =
                parentPath +
                "\\" +
                name;

            string typeIdentifier =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeIdentifier");

            string position =
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PositionNumber");

            string orderNumber =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "OrderNumber");

            string firmware =
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "FirmwareVersion");

            AppendCsvValue(csv, path);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, level.ToString());
            AppendCsvValue(csv, name);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, typeIdentifier);
            AppendCsvValue(csv, position);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsPlugged"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsBuiltIn"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Classification"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "TypeName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                orderNumber);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                firmware);

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Author"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "Comment"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "PlantDesignation"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "LocationIdentifier"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdName"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdType"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetDynamicAttribute(
                    deviceItem,
                    "GsdId"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsGsd"));

            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                SafeProperty(
                    deviceItem,
                    "IsProfinet"));

            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    SafeProperty(
                        deviceItem,
                        "IsProfibus")));

            csv.AppendLine();

            tree.Append(
                new string(
                    ' ',
                    4 + level * 2));

            tree.Append("- ");
            tree.Append(name);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                position))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [Pos {position}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orderNumber))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [{orderNumber}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                firmware))
            {
                tree.Append(
                    $" [FW {firmware}]");
            }

            tree.AppendLine();

            AddReport(
                "HARDWARE_ITEM",
                parentPath,
                name,
                typeIdentifier,
                "OK",
                "Path=" +
                path +
                "; Position=" +
                position +
                "; OrderNumber=" +
                orderNumber +
                "; Firmware=" +
                firmware);

            foreach (
                DeviceItem child
                in deviceItem.DeviceItems)
            {
                ExportDeviceItemRecursive(
                    child,
                    csv,
                    tree,
                    path,
                    level + 1);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC REFERENCES
        // ============================================================

        private static List<PlcReference>
            BuildPlcReferences(
                Project project)
        {
            List<PlcReference> result =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (Device device in project.Devices)
            {
                string deviceName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        device,
                        "");

                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(
                        device);

                if (plcSoftware == null)
                    continue;

                string softwareName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        plcSoftware,
                        "");

                result.Add(
                    new PlcReference
                    {
                        DeviceName =
                            deviceName,

                        SoftwareName =
                            softwareName
                    });
            }

            return result;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // PLC
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportPlc(
            string archiveRoot,
            string plcSoftwareName,
            PlcSoftware plcSoftware)
        {
            PlcCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"PLC: {plcSoftwareName}");

            string plcRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "10_PLC",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        plcSoftwareName));

            string blocksRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    plcRoot,
                    "Blocks");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                blocksRoot);

            try
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    plcSoftware.BlockGroup,
                    blocksRoot,
                    plcSoftwareName,
                    "");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(
                        ex);

                AddReport(
                    "PLC",
                    plcSoftwareName,
                    "BlockGroup",
                    "",
                    "ERROR",
                    actual.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    actual.Message);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"PLC-Gruppenexport fehlgeschlagen: " +
                    $"{actual.Message}");
            }

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlockGroup(
            PlcBlockGroup group,
            string parentDirectory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string currentDirectory =
                parentDirectory;

            string currentGroupPath =
                groupPath;

            string groupName =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    group,
                    "");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                groupName))
            {
                currentDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    currentDirectory);

                currentGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlock block
                in group.Blocks)
            {
                ExportPlcBlock(
                    block,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }

            foreach (
                PlcBlockGroup childGroup
                in group.Groups)
            {
                ExportPlcBlockGroup(
                    childGroup,
                    currentDirectory,
                    plcName,
                    currentGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportPlcBlock(
            PlcBlock block,
            string directory,
            string plcName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            string blockName =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    block,
                    "UnnamedBlock");

            bool protectedBlock =
                false;

            bool providerAvailable =
                false;

            try
            {
                protectedBlock =
                    block.IsKnowHowProtected;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            try
            {
                PlcBlockProtectionProvider provider =
                    block.GetService
                        <PlcBlockProtectionProvider>();

                providerAvailable =
                    provider != null;
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            string blockType =
                block.GetType().Name;

            string exportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    directory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        blockName) +
                    ".xml");

            Console.Write(
                $"  {blockType,-12} " +
                $"{blockName,-35}");

            try
            {
                block.Export(
                    new FileInfo(
                        exportFile),
                    ExportOptions.WithDefaults);

                PlcBlocksExported++;

                string completeness;

                if (!protectedBlock)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "vollständig";
                }
                else if (providerAvailable)
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; ohne Entsperren exportiert";
                }
                else
                {
                    completeness =
                        "geschützt; nicht entsperrbar; " +
                        "öffentliche Schnittstelle";
                }

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $" OK [{completeness}]");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    blockName,
                    blockType,
                    "OK",
                    completeness +
                    "; Gruppe=" +
                    groupPath +
                    "; Datei=" +
                    exportFile);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                PlcBlocksFailed++;

                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(
                        ex);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    " FEHLER");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {actual.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "PLC_BLOCK",
                    plcName,
                    blockName,
                    blockType,
                    "ERROR",
                    actual.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    actual.Message);
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI
        // ============================================================

        private static void ExportHmi(
            string archiveRoot,
            string deviceName,
            string hmiSoftwareName,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            HmiCount++;

            Console.WriteLine(
                "==================================================");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"HMI: {deviceName}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Software: {hmiSoftwareName}");

            string hmiRoot =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "20_HMI",
                    MakeSafeName(
                        deviceName));

            string inventoryDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Inventory");

            string scriptsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Scripts");

            string tagTablesDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "TagTables");

            string tagsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Tags");

            string connectionsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Connections");

            string screensDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Screens");

            string relationshipsDirectory =
                Path.Combine(
                    hmiRoot,
                    "Relationships");

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                inventoryDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                scriptsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagTablesDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                tagsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                connectionsDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                screensDirectory);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                relationshipsDirectory);

            WriteHmiInventory(
                inventoryDirectory,
                deviceName,
                hmiSoftwareName,
                hmiSoftware);

            Stopwatch watch;

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCRIPTS
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiScripts(
                scriptsDirectory,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScriptsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Scripts: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // TAG TABLES
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHmiTagTables(
                tagTablesDirectory,
                deviceName,
                hmiSoftware);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagTablesDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit TagTables: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // TAG SNAPSHOT
            // Ab hier werden die Tags später NICHT erneut aus
            // HmiSoftware gelesen.
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            List<HmiTagSnapshot> tagSnapshots =
                SnapshotHmiTags(
                    hmiSoftware);

            WriteHmiTagsCsv(
                tagsDirectory,
                tagSnapshots);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiTagsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tags dokumentiert: " +
                $"{tagSnapshots.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Tags/Snapshot: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // CONNECTION SNAPSHOT
            // Auch Connections werden vor den Screens vollständig in
            // normale C# Daten kopiert.
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            Stopwatch connectionIndexWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            List<ConnectionSnapshot> connectionSnapshots =
                SnapshotHmiConnections(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    plcReferences);

            connectionIndexWatch.Stop();

            ConnectionIndexDuration +=
                connectionIndexWatch.Elapsed;

            WriteConnections(
                connectionsDirectory,
                connectionSnapshots);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiConnectionsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Verbindungen dokumentiert: " +
                $"{connectionSnapshots.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Connections/Snapshot: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCREEN ROOT-COLLECTIONS JETZT HOLEN
            //
            // Danach wird HmiSoftware NICHT MEHR benötigt.
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            object rootScreens =
                hmiSoftware.Screens;

            object rootScreenGroups =
                GetPropertyValueStrict(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "ScreenGroups");

            HashSet<string> knownTagNames =
                BuildKnownTagNameSet(
                    tagSnapshots);

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // SCREENS DIREKT REKURSIV VERARBEITEN
            //
            // Keine Liste von HmiScreen-Proxies wird mehr für spätere
            // Verarbeitung gespeichert.
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ScreenProcessingResult screenResult =
                ExportHmiScreensAndBuildUsageIndex(
                    screensDirectory,
                    deviceName,
                    rootScreens,
                    rootScreenGroups,
                    knownTagNames);

            watch.Stop();

            HmiScreensDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Screens inkl. Usage-Index: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            // --------------------------------------------------------
            // RELATIONSHIPS
            //
            // KEIN Zugriff mehr auf:
            //   hmiSoftware.Tags
            //   hmiSoftware.Connections
            //   hmiSoftware.Screens
            //   hmiSoftware.ScreenGroups
            // --------------------------------------------------------

            watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            WriteHmiTagRelationshipsFromSnapshots(
                relationshipsDirectory,
                deviceName,
                hmiSoftwareName,
                tagSnapshots,
                connectionSnapshots,
                screenResult.UsageIndex,
                screenResult.TotalScreens);

            watch.Stop();

            RelationshipsDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Relationships gesamt: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            Console.WriteLine();
        }

        private static void ExportHmiTagTables(
            string tagTablesDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Tag-Tabellen: " +
                $"{hmiSoftware.TagTables.Count}");

            ExportTagTableCollection(
                hmiSoftware.TagTables,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                deviceName,
                "");

            object groups =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    hmiSoftware,
                    "TagTableGroups");

            ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                groups,
                tagTablesDirectory,
                deviceName,
                "");
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object group
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (group == null)
                    continue;

                string groupName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        group,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupName))
                {
                    groupName =
                        "UnnamedGroup";
                }

                string directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            groupName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    directory);

                string newGroupPath =
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                        groupPath)
                    ? groupName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      groupName;

                ExportTagTableCollection(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "TagTables"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);

                ExportTagTableGroupsRecursive(
                    GetPropertyValue(
                        group,
                        "Groups"),
                    directory,
                    deviceName,
                    newGroupPath);
            }
        }

        private static void ExportTagTableCollection(
            object tagTables,
            string parentDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                tagTables as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object table
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (table == null)
                    continue;

                string tableName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        table,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tableName))
                {
                    tableName =
                        "UnnamedTagTable";
                }

                string tableDirectory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        parentDirectory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            tableName));

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    tableDirectory);

                Console.Write(
                    $"    TagTable: " +
                    $"{tableName,-30}");

                try
                {
                    object tags =
                        GetPropertyValue(
                            table,
                            "Tags");

                    if (tags == null)
                    {
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            "Tags-Composition nicht verfügbar.");
                    }

                    List<string> files =
                        InvokeNativeExport(
                            tags,
                            tableDirectory,
                            tableName);

                    HmiTagTablesExported++;

                    HmiTagFilesExported +=
                        files.Count;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $" OK ({files.Count} Dateien)");

                    foreach (
                        string file
                        in files)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"      " +
                            $"{Path.GetFileName(file)}");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiTagTablesFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      {actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_TAGTABLE",
                        deviceName,
                        tableName,
                        "TagTable",
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // HMI TAG SNAPSHOT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<HmiTagSnapshot>
            SnapshotHmiTags(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware)
        {
            List<HmiTagSnapshot> result =
                new List<HmiTagSnapshot>();

            IEnumerable tags =
                hmiSoftware.Tags
                as IEnumerable;

            if (tags == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object tag
                in tags)
            {
                if (tag == null)
                    continue;

                HmiTagSnapshot snapshot =
                    new HmiTagSnapshot();

                snapshot.Name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "Name");

                snapshot.TagTable =
                    GetObjectNameProperty(
                        tag,
                        "TagTable");

                snapshot.DataType =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "DataType");

                snapshot.Connection =
                    GetObjectNameProperty(
                        tag,
                        "Connection");

                snapshot.PlcTag =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "PlcTag");

                snapshot.Address =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "Address");

                snapshot.SymbolicAddress =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "SymbolicAddress");

                snapshot.AccessMode =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "AccessMode");

                snapshot.AcquisitionCycle =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "AcquisitionCycle");

                snapshot.AcquisitionMode =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "AcquisitionMode");

                snapshot.ReadOnly =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        tag,
                        "ReadOnly");

                result.Add(
                    snapshot);
            }

            HmiTagsDocumented +=
                result.Count;

            return result;
        }

        private static void WriteHmiTagsCsv(
            string tagsDirectory,
            List<HmiTagSnapshot> tags)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    tagsDirectory,
                    "Tags.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;TagTable;DataType;Connection;" +
                "PlcTag;Address;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "AccessMode;AcquisitionCycle;" +
                "AcquisitionMode;ReadOnly");

            foreach (
                HmiTagSnapshot tag
                in tags)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.Name);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.TagTable);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.DataType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.Connection);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.PlcTag);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.Address);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.SymbolicAddress);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.AccessMode);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.AcquisitionCycle);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    tag.AcquisitionMode);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        tag.ReadOnly));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // CONNECTION SNAPSHOT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<ConnectionSnapshot>
            SnapshotHmiConnections(
                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware,
                List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            List<ConnectionSnapshot> result =
                new List<ConnectionSnapshot>();

            IEnumerable connections =
                hmiSoftware.Connections
                as IEnumerable;

            if (connections == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object connection
                in connections)
            {
                if (connection == null)
                    continue;

                ConnectionSnapshot snapshot =
                    new ConnectionSnapshot();

                snapshot.Name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        connection,
                        "Name");

                snapshot.TypeName =
                    SafeTypeName(
                        connection);

                snapshot.Properties =
                    GetDeepReadableText(
                        connection,
                        0,
                        2);

                snapshot.ResolvedPlc =
                    ResolvePlcReference(
                        snapshot.Properties,
                        plcReferences);

                result.Add(
                    snapshot);
            }

            HmiConnectionsDocumented +=
                result.Count;

            return result;
        }

        private static void WriteConnections(
            string connectionsDirectory,
            List<ConnectionSnapshot> connections)
        {
            string csvFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    connectionsDirectory,
                    "Connections.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Name;Type;Properties");

            foreach (
                ConnectionSnapshot connection
                in connections)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    connection.Name);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    connection.TypeName);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        connection.Properties));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                csvFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SCREEN EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static ScreenProcessingResult
            ExportHmiScreensAndBuildUsageIndex(
                string screensDirectory,
                string deviceName,
                object rootScreens,
                object rootScreenGroups,
                HashSet<string> knownTagNames)
        {
            ScreenProcessingResult result =
                new ScreenProcessingResult();

            Stopwatch usageWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            usageWatch.Stop();

            try
            {
                ProcessScreenCollection(
                    rootScreens,
                    screensDirectory,
                    deviceName,
                    "",
                    false,
                    knownTagNames,
                    result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(
                        ex);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    "  Root-Screen-Collection FEHLER:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {actual.GetType().Name}: " +
                    $"{actual.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "HMI_SCREEN_COLLECTION",
                    deviceName,
                    "RootScreens",
                    "Screens",
                    "ERROR",
                    actual.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    actual.Message);
            }

            try
            {
                ProcessScreenGroupsRecursive(
                    rootScreenGroups,
                    screensDirectory,
                    deviceName,
                    "",
                    knownTagNames,
                    result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(
                        ex);

                Console.WriteLine(
                    "  ScreenGroup-Collection FEHLER:");

                Console.WriteLine(
                    $"    {actual.GetType().Name}: " +
                    $"{actual.Message}");

                AddReport(
                    "HMI_SCREEN_GROUP_COLLECTION",
                    deviceName,
                    "ScreenGroups",
                    "ScreenGroups",
                    "ERROR",
                    actual.GetType().Name +
                    ": " +
                    actual.Message);
            }

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Root-Screens: " +
                $"{result.RootScreens}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Gruppierte Screens: " +
                $"{result.GroupedScreens}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Screens gesamt (rekursiv): " +
                $"{result.TotalScreens}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  ScreenGroups gesamt: " +
                $"{result.ScreenGroups}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Usage-Index: " +
                $"{result.UsageIndex.Count} " +
                $"Tags mit Verwendung");

            return result;
        }

        private static void ProcessScreenGroupsRecursive(
            object groups,
            string screensDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string parentPath,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            ScreenProcessingResult result)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                groups as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            try
            {
                foreach (
                    object group
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    if (group == null)
                        continue;

                    string groupName =
                        GetStringProperty(
                            group,
                            "Name");

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupName))
                    {
                        groupName =
                            "UnnamedScreenGroup";
                    }

                    string currentPath =
                        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            parentPath)
                        ? groupName
                        : parentPath +
                          "\\" +
                          groupName;

                    result.ScreenGroups++;
                    HmiScreenGroupsDocumented++;

                    object groupScreens =
                        GetPropertyValueStrict(
                            group,
                            "Screens");

                    ProcessScreenCollection(
                        groupScreens,
                        screensDirectory,
                        deviceName,
                        currentPath,
                        true,
                        knownTagNames,
                        result);

                    object childGroups =
                        GetPropertyValueStrict(
                            group,
                            "Groups");

                    ProcessScreenGroupsRecursive(
                        childGroups,
                        screensDirectory,
                        deviceName,
                        currentPath,
                        knownTagNames,
                        result);
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static void ProcessScreenCollection(
            object screenCollection,
            string screensDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            string groupPath,
            bool grouped,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            ScreenProcessingResult result)
        {
            IEnumerable enumerable =
                screenCollection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return;

            foreach (
                object screen
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (screen == null)
                    continue;

                string screenName =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        screen,
                        "Name");

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    screenName))
                {
                    screenName =
                        "UnnamedScreen";
                }

                string fullPath =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        groupPath)
                    ? screenName
                    : groupPath +
                      "\\" +
                      screenName;

                Console.Write(
                    $"    Screen: " +
                    $"{fullPath,-45}");

                try
                {
                    ProcessSingleScreen(
                        screen,
                        screenName,
                        groupPath,
                        fullPath,
                        grouped,
                        screensDirectory,
                        deviceName,
                        knownTagNames,
                        result);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        result.LastScreenStatus);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    HmiScreenDocumentationFailed++;

                    Exception actual =
                        UnwrapException(
                            ex);

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        " FEHLER");

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"      " +
                        $"{actual.GetType().Name}: " +
                        $"{actual.Message}");

                    AddReport(
                        "HMI_SCREEN",
                        deviceName,
                        fullPath,
                        SafeTypeName(screen),
                        "ERROR",
                        actual.GetType().Name +
                        ": " +
                        actual.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        private static void ProcessSingleScreen(
            object screen,
            string screenName,
            string groupPath,
            string fullPath,
            bool grouped,
            string screensDirectory,
            string deviceName,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            ScreenProcessingResult result)
        {
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data =
                MaterializeScreenData(
                    screen,
                    screenName,
                    groupPath,
                    fullPath,
                    grouped);

            string screenDirectory =
                BuildScreenArchiveDirectory(
                    screensDirectory,
                    groupPath,
                    screenName,
                    grouped);

            Directory.CreateDirectory(
                screenDirectory);

            WriteScreenInfo(
                screenDirectory,
                data);

            int itemCount =
                WriteScreenItemsCsv(
                    screenDirectory,
                    data);

            int eventCount =
                WriteScreenEvents(
                    screenDirectory,
                    data);

            int dynamizationCount =
                WriteScreenDynamizations(
                    screenDirectory,
                    data);

            int propertyEventCount =
                WriteScreenPropertyEvents(
                    screenDirectory,
                    data);

            Stopwatch usageWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            AddScreenToUsageIndex(
                data,
                knownTagNames,
                result.UsageIndex);

            usageWatch.Stop();

            UsageIndexDuration +=
                usageWatch.Elapsed;

            result.TotalScreens++;

            if (grouped)
            {
                result.GroupedScreens++;
                HmiGroupedScreensDocumented++;
            }
            else
            {
                result.RootScreens++;
                HmiRootScreensDocumented++;
            }

            HmiScreensDocumented++;

            HmiScreenItemsDocumented +=
                itemCount;

            HmiScreenEventsDocumented +=
                eventCount;

            HmiDynamizationsDocumented +=
                dynamizationCount;

            HmiPropertyEventsDocumented +=
                propertyEventCount;

            result.LastScreenStatus =
                $" OK [{itemCount} Items, " +
                $"{eventCount} Events, " +
                $"{dynamizationCount} Dynamiken]";

            AddReport(
                "HMI_SCREEN",
                deviceName,
                fullPath,
                data.ScreenType,
                "OK",
                "GroupPath=" +
                groupPath +
                "; Items=" +
                itemCount +
                "; Events=" +
                eventCount +
                "; Dynamizations=" +
                dynamizationCount);
        }

        private static HmiScreenRuntimeData
            MaterializeScreenData(
                object screen,
                string screenName,
                string groupPath,
                string fullPath,
                bool grouped)
        {
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data =
                new HmiScreenRuntimeData();

            data.ScreenName =
                screenName;

            data.GroupPath =
                groupPath;

            data.FullPath =
                fullPath;

            data.IsGrouped =
                grouped;

            data.ScreenType =
                SafeTypeName(
                    screen);

            /*
             * WICHTIG:
             * ToObjectListStrict verschluckt keine Enumeratorfehler.
             * Ein disposed ScreenItem-Enumerator wird dadurch sichtbar
             * und führt nicht mehr zu fälschlich "0 Items".
             */

            data.ScreenEventHandlers =
                ToObjectListStrict(
                    GetPropertyValueStrict(
                        screen,
                        "EventHandlers"));

            data.ScreenDynamizations =
                ToObjectListStrict(
                    GetPropertyValueStrict(
                        screen,
                        "Dynamizations"));

            data.ScreenPropertyEventHandlers =
                ToObjectListStrict(
                    GetPropertyValueStrict(
                        screen,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers"));

            List<object> rawItems =
                ToObjectListStrict(
                    GetPropertyValueStrict(
                        screen,
                        "ScreenItems"));

            foreach (
                object item
                in rawItems)
            {
                HmiScreenItemRuntimeData itemData =
                    new HmiScreenItemRuntimeData();

                itemData.Item =
                    item;

                itemData.Name =
                    GetStringProperty(
                        item,
                        "Name");

                itemData.EventHandlers =
                    ToObjectListStrict(
                        GetPropertyValueStrict(
                            item,
                            "EventHandlers"));

                itemData.Dynamizations =
                    ToObjectListStrict(
                        GetPropertyValueStrict(
                            item,
                            "Dynamizations"));

                itemData.PropertyEventHandlers =
                    ToObjectListStrict(
                        GetPropertyValueStrict(
                            item,
                            "PropertyEventHandlers"));

                data.Items.Add(
                    itemData);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private static List<object> ToObjectListStrict(
            object collection)
        {
            List<object> result =
                new List<object>();

            if (collection == null)
                return result;

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return result;

            foreach (
                object item
                in enumerable)
            {
                if (item != null)
                {
                    result.Add(
                        item);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string BuildScreenArchiveDirectory(
            string screensDirectory,
            string groupPath,
            string screenName,
            bool grouped)
        {
            if (!grouped ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    groupPath))
            {
                return Path.Combine(
                    screensDirectory,
                    MakeSafeName(
                        screenName));
            }

            string directory =
                Path.Combine(
                    screensDirectory,
                    "Groups");

            string[] pathParts =
                groupPath.Split(
                    new[] { '\\' },
                    StringSplitOptions
                        .RemoveEmptyEntries);

            foreach (
                string part
                in pathParts)
            {
                directory =
                    Path.Combine(
                        directory,
                        MakeSafeName(
                            part));
            }

            return Path.Combine(
                directory,
                MakeSafeName(
                    screenName));
        }

        private static void AddScreenToUsageIndex(
            HmiScreenRuntimeData data,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex)
        {
            string screenReference =
                data.FullPath;

            HashSet<string> screenEventTags =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                data.ScreenEventHandlers,
                knownTagNames,
                screenEventTags,
                0,
                4,
                false);

            foreach (
                string tagName
                in screenEventTags)
            {
                UsageResult usage =
                    GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                        usageIndex,
                        tagName);

                AddUnique(
                    usage.Events,
                    screenReference +
                    "/[Screen]");
            }

            HashSet<string> screenDynamicTags =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                data.ScreenDynamizations,
                knownTagNames,
                screenDynamicTags,
                0,
                4,
                false);

            foreach (
                string tagName
                in screenDynamicTags)
            {
                UsageResult usage =
                    GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                        usageIndex,
                        tagName);

                AddUnique(
                    usage.Dynamizations,
                    screenReference +
                    "/[Screen]");
            }

            foreach (
                HmiScreenItemRuntimeData itemData
                in data.Items)
            {
                string itemName =
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        itemData.Name)
                    ? "UnnamedItem"
                    : itemData.Name;

                string reference =
                    screenReference +
                    "/" +
                    itemName;

                HashSet<string> itemTags =
                    new HashSet<string>(
                        StringComparer.Ordinal);

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    itemData.Item,
                    knownTagNames,
                    itemTags,
                    0,
                    1,
                    true);

                foreach (
                    string tagName
                    in itemTags)
                {
                    UsageResult usage =
                        GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                            usageIndex,
                            tagName);

                    AddUnique(
                        usage.ScreenItems,
                        reference);
                }

                HashSet<string> dynamicTags =
                    new HashSet<string>(
                        StringComparer.Ordinal);

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    itemData.Dynamizations,
                    knownTagNames,
                    dynamicTags,
                    0,
                    4,
                    false);

                foreach (
                    string tagName
                    in dynamicTags)
                {
                    UsageResult usage =
                        GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                            usageIndex,
                            tagName);

                    AddUnique(
                        usage.Dynamizations,
                        reference);
                }

                HashSet<string> eventTags =
                    new HashSet<string>(
                        StringComparer.Ordinal);

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    itemData.EventHandlers,
                    knownTagNames,
                    eventTags,
                    0,
                    4,
                    false);

                foreach (
                    string tagName
                    in eventTags)
                {
                    UsageResult usage =
                        GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                            usageIndex,
                            tagName);

                    AddUnique(
                        usage.Events,
                        reference);
                }
            }
        }
