        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIPS FROM SNAPSHOTS
        // ============================================================

        private static void WriteHmiTagRelationshipsFromSnapshots(
            string relationshipsDirectory,
            string hmiDeviceName,
            string hmiSoftwareName,
            List<HmiTagSnapshot> tags,
            List<ConnectionSnapshot> connections,
            Dictionary<string, UsageResult> usageIndex,
            int screenCount)
        {
            string fullFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "HmiTagToPlc.csv");

            string unresolvedFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    relationshipsDirectory,
                    "UnresolvedRelationships.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            StringBuilder unresolvedCsv =
                new StringBuilder();

            string header =
                "HmiDevice;HmiSoftware;HmiTag;TagTable;" +
                "DataType;Connection;PlcTag;SymbolicAddress;" +
                "Address;AccessMode;ResolvedPlcDevice;" +
                "ResolvedPlcSoftware;ResolutionStatus;" +
                "Classification;ScreenUsage;" +
                "DynamizationUsage;EventUsage;" +
                "ConnectionProperties";

            csv.AppendLine(
                header);

            unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                header);

            Dictionary<string, ConnectionSnapshot>
                connectionIndex =
                    new Dictionary<string, ConnectionSnapshot>(
                        StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            foreach (
                ConnectionSnapshot connection
                in connections)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connection.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                connectionIndex[
                    connection.Name] =
                        connection;
            }

            Console.WriteLine(
                "  Beziehungsdaten werden aus Snapshots ausgewertet...");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Connections im Snapshot: " +
                $"{connectionIndex.Count}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Screens im Usage-Index: " +
                $"{screenCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Tags mit Screen-Verwendung: " +
                $"{usageIndex.Count}");

            int localCount =
                0;

            int localResolved =
                0;

            int localUnresolved =
                0;

            int localSystem =
                0;

            int localInternal =
                0;

            int localPlcReferenceUnresolved =
                0;

            int localConnectionUnresolved =
                0;

            foreach (
                HmiTagSnapshot tag
                in tags)
            {
                localCount++;
                RelationshipsDocumented++;

                ConnectionSnapshot connection =
                    null;

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tag.Connection))
                {
                    connectionIndex.TryGetValue(
                        tag.Connection,
                        out connection);
                }

                string connectionProperties =
                    connection == null
                    ? ""
                    : connection.Properties;

                string resolvedDevice =
                    "";

                string resolvedSoftware =
                    "";

                string resolutionStatus;
                string classification;

                PlcReference resolved =
                    connection == null
                    ? null
                    : connection.ResolvedPlc;

                if (resolved != null)
                {
                    resolvedDevice =
                        resolved.DeviceName;

                    resolvedSoftware =
                        resolved.SoftwareName;

                    resolutionStatus =
                        "RESOLVED_FROM_CONNECTION";

                    classification =
                        "PLC_TAG";

                    RelationshipsResolvedToPlc++;
                    localResolved++;
                }
                else
                {
                    classification =
                        ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
                            tag.Name,
                            tag.TagTable,
                            tag.Connection,
                            tag.PlcTag,
                            tag.SymbolicAddress,
                            tag.Address);

                    resolutionStatus =
                        classification;

                    RelationshipsUnresolved++;
                    localUnresolved++;

                    if (classification ==
                        "SYSTEM_TAG")
                    {
                        RelationshipSystemTags++;
                        localSystem++;
                    }
                    else if (classification ==
                             "INTERNAL_TAG")
                    {
                        RelationshipInternalTags++;
                        localInternal++;
                    }
                    else if (
                        classification ==
                        "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE")
                    {
                        RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                        localPlcReferenceUnresolved++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        RelationshipConnectionUnresolved++;
                        localConnectionUnresolved++;
                    }
                }

                UsageResult usage =
                    null;

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tag.Name))
                {
                    usageIndex.TryGetValue(
                        tag.Name,
                        out usage);
                }

                if (usage == null)
                {
                    usage =
                        new UsageResult();
                }

                RelationshipScreenUsages +=
                    usage.TotalUsageCount;

                string row =
                    BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
                        hmiDeviceName,
                        hmiSoftwareName,
                        tag.Name,
                        tag.TagTable,
                        tag.DataType,
                        tag.Connection,
                        tag.PlcTag,
                        tag.SymbolicAddress,
                        tag.Address,
                        tag.AccessMode,
                        resolvedDevice,
                        resolvedSoftware,
                        resolutionStatus,
                        classification,
                        string.Join(
                            " | ",
                            usage.ScreenItems),
                        string.Join(
                            " | ",
                            usage.Dynamizations),
                        string.Join(
                            " | ",
                            usage.Events),
                        NormalizeSingleLine(
                            connectionProperties));

                csv.AppendLine(
                    row);

                if (resolved == null)
                {
                    unresolvedCsv.AppendLine(
                        row);
                }
            }

            Stopwatch writeWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            File.WriteAllText(
                fullFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            File.WriteAllText(
                unresolvedFile,
                unresolvedCsv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);

            writeWatch.Stop();

            RelationshipWriteDuration +=
                writeWatch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    Zeit Relationship-Dateien: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(writeWatch.Elapsed)}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  Beziehungen dokumentiert: " +
                $"{localCount}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    PLC aufgelöst: " +
                $"{localResolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"    offen gesamt: " +
                $"{localUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      System-Tags: " +
                $"{localSystem}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      interne Tags: " +
                $"{localInternal}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      PLC-Referenz, Connection unklar: " +
                $"{localPlcReferenceUnresolved}");

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"      Connection nicht identifizierbar: " +
                $"{localConnectionUnresolved}");

            AddReport(
                "HMI_RELATIONSHIPS",
                hmiDeviceName,
                hmiSoftwareName,
                "HmiTagToPlc.csv",
                "OK",
                "Tags=" +
                localCount +
                "; Screens=" +
                screenCount +
                "; Resolved=" +
                localResolved +
                "; Unresolved=" +
                localUnresolved +
                "; System=" +
                localSystem +
                "; Internal=" +
                localInternal +
                "; PlcRefUnresolved=" +
                localPlcReferenceUnresolved +
                "; ConnectionUnresolved=" +
                localConnectionUnresolved);
        }

        // ============================================================
        // USAGE INDEX
        // ============================================================

        private static HashSet<string>
            BuildKnownTagNameSet(
                List<HmiTagSnapshot> tags)
        {
            HashSet<string> result =
                new HashSet<string>(
                    StringComparer.Ordinal);

            foreach (
                HmiTagSnapshot tag
                in tags)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tag.Name))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        tag.Name);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static UsageResult
            GetOrCreateUsageResult(
                Dictionary<string, UsageResult> index,
                string tagName)
        {
            UsageResult result;

            if (!index.TryGetValue(
                    tagName,
                    out result))
            {
                result =
                    new UsageResult();

                index[tagName] =
                    result;
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void ScanObjectForKnownTags(
            object obj,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            string text =
                obj as string;

            if (text != null)
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    text,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            Type type;

            try
            {
                type =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                AddKnownTagsFromText(
                    SafeToString(
                        obj),
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags);

                return;
            }

            if (depth >= maxDepth)
                return;

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                obj as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable != null)
            {
                /*
                 * Bei bereits materialisierten List<object> ist das
                 * ungefährlich.
                 *
                 * Falls hier dennoch eine Siemens-Composition landet,
                 * lassen wir den Fehler bis zum Screen-Catch laufen.
                 */
                foreach (
                    object child
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                        child,
                        knownTagNames,
                        foundTags,
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth,
                        skipBehaviorContainers);
                }

                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    type.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    skipBehaviorContainers))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ScanObjectForKnownTags(
                    value,
                    knownTagNames,
                    foundTags,
                    depth + 1,
                    maxDepth,
                    skipBehaviorContainers);
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipUsageIndexProperty(
            string propertyName,
            bool skipBehaviorContainers)
        {
            string[] structuralSkip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "Device",
                "DeviceItem",
                "Hardware",
                "Project",
                "TiaPortal"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in structuralSkip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            if (skipBehaviorContainers)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "EventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "Dynamizations",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    string.Equals(
                        propertyName,
                        "PropertyEventHandlers",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddKnownTagsFromText(
            string text,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(
                    text))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                text))
            {
                foundTags.Add(
                    text);
            }

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '"',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);

            ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
                text,
                '\'',
                knownTagNames,
                foundTags);
        }

        private static void ExtractQuotedKnownTags(
            string text,
            char quote,
            HashSet<string> knownTagNames,
            HashSet<string> foundTags)
        {
            int start =
                0;

            while (start <
                   text.Length)
            {
                int open =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        start);

                if (open < 0)
                    break;

                int close =
                    text.IndexOf(
                        quote,
                        open + 1);

                if (close < 0)
                    break;

                if (close >
                    open + 1)
                {
                    string candidate =
                        text.Substring(
                            open + 1,
                            close - open - 1);

                    if (knownTagNames.Contains(
                        candidate))
                    {
                        foundTags.Add(
                            candidate);
                    }
                }

                start =
                    close + 1;
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // RELATIONSHIP CLASSIFICATION
        // ============================================================

        private static string ClassifyUnresolvedRelationship(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable,
            string connectionName,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address)
        {
            if (IsSystemTag(
                tagName,
                tagTable))
            {
                return "SYSTEM_TAG";
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                connectionName))
            {
                return "INTERNAL_TAG";
            }

            bool hasPlcReference =
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    plcTag) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    symbolicAddress) ||
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    address);

            if (hasPlcReference)
            {
                return
                    "PLC_REFERENCE_CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
            }

            return
                "CONNECTION_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE";
        }

        private static bool IsSystemTag(
            string tagName,
            string tagTable)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagName) &&
                tagName.StartsWith(
                    "@",
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    tagTable))
            {
                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "HMISystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "PLCSystem",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                if (tagTable.IndexOf(
                        "System",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string BuildRelationshipCsvRow(
            string hmiDevice,
            string hmiSoftware,
            string hmiTag,
            string tagTable,
            string dataType,
            string connection,
            string plcTag,
            string symbolicAddress,
            string address,
            string accessMode,
            string resolvedPlcDevice,
            string resolvedPlcSoftware,
            string resolutionStatus,
            string classification,
            string screenUsage,
            string dynamizationUsage,
            string eventUsage,
            string connectionProperties)
        {
            StringBuilder row =
                new StringBuilder();

            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiDevice);
            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiSoftware);
            AppendCsvValue(row, hmiTag);
            AppendCsvValue(row, tagTable);
            AppendCsvValue(row, dataType);
            AppendCsvValue(row, connection);
            AppendCsvValue(row, plcTag);
            AppendCsvValue(row, symbolicAddress);
            AppendCsvValue(row, address);
            AppendCsvValue(row, accessMode);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolvedPlcDevice);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolvedPlcSoftware);
            AppendCsvValue(row, resolutionStatus);
            AppendCsvValue(row, classification);
            AppendCsvValue(row, screenUsage);
            AppendCsvValue(row, dynamizationUsage);
            AppendCsvValue(row, eventUsage);

            row.Append(
                Csv(
                    connectionProperties));

            return row.ToString();
        }

        private static PlcReference ResolvePlcReference(
            string connectionText,
            List<PlcReference> plcReferences)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    connectionText) ||
                plcReferences == null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            List<PlcReference> matches =
                new List<PlcReference>();

            foreach (
                PlcReference plc
                in plcReferences)
            {
                bool match =
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.DeviceName) ||
                    ContainsText(
                        connectionText,
                        plc.SoftwareName);

                if (match)
                {
                    matches.Add(
                        plc);
                }
            }

            if (matches.Count == 1)
            {
                return matches[0];
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // OBJECT DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static int WriteObjectList(
            StringBuilder text,
            List<object> objects,
            string ownerName)
        {
            if (objects == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            foreach (
                object obj
                in objects)
            {
                if (obj == null)
                    continue;

                count++;

                text.AppendLine();

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"[{count}] " +
                    $"{SafeTypeShortName(obj)}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $".NET-Typ: " +
                    $"{SafeTypeName(obj)}");

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Owner: {ownerName}");

                DumpObjectProperties(
                    text,
                    obj,
                    "  ",
                    0,
                    4);
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void DumpObjectProperties(
            StringBuilder text,
            object obj,
            string indent,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth >= maxDepth)
            {
                return;
            }

            Type objectType;

            try
            {
                objectType =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    objectType.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"<Fehler: " +
                        $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");

                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: null");

                    continue;
                }

                Type valueType;

                try
                {
                    valueType =
                        value.GetType();
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"{SafeToString(value)}");

                    continue;
                }

                IEnumerable enumerable =
                    value as IEnumerable;

                if (enumerable != null &&
                    !(value is string))
                {
                    int collectionCount =
                        GetCollectionCount(
                            value);

                    text.AppendLine(
                        $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                        $"Collection ({collectionCount})");

                    if (depth + 1 <
                        maxDepth)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            foreach (
                                object child
                                in enumerable)
                            {
                                if (child == null)
                                    continue;

                                DumpObjectProperties(
                                    text,
                                    child,
                                    indent + "  ",
                                    depth + 1,
                                    maxDepth);
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            text.AppendLine(
                                $"{indent}  " +
                                $"<Enumeration nicht verfügbar: " +
                                $"{UnwrapException(ex).GetType().Name}>");
                        }
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                text.AppendLine(
                    $"{indent}{property.Name}: " +
                    $"{valueType.FullName}");

                if (ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
                    property.Name,
                    valueType))
                {
                    DumpObjectProperties(
                        text,
                        value,
                        indent + "  ",
                        depth + 1,
                        maxDepth);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipDumpProperty(
            string propertyName)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "EventHandlers",
                "Dynamizations",
                "PropertyEventHandlers",
                "Device",
                "DeviceItem",
                "Hardware",
                "Project",
                "TiaPortal"
            };

            foreach (
                string name
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    propertyName,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static bool ShouldExpandDumpProperty(
            string propertyName,
            Type valueType)
        {
            string value =
                (propertyName +
                 " " +
                 valueType.FullName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

            return
                value.Contains("script") ||
                value.Contains("trigger") ||
                value.Contains("tag") ||
                value.Contains("action") ||
                value.Contains("parameter") ||
                value.Contains("converter") ||
                value.Contains("mapping") ||
                value.Contains("reference");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // CONNECTION PROPERTY DUMP
        // ============================================================

        private static string GetDeepReadableText(
            object obj,
            int depth,
            int maxDepth)
        {
            if (obj == null ||
                depth > maxDepth)
            {
                return "";
            }

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            Type type;

            try
            {
                type =
                    obj.GetType();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }

            if (IsSimpleType(
                type))
            {
                return SafeToString(
                    obj);
            }

            PropertyInfo[] properties;

            try
            {
                properties =
                    type.GetProperties(
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }

            foreach (
                PropertyInfo property
                in properties)
            {
                if (!property.CanRead ||
                    property.GetIndexParameters().Length > 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
                    property.Name))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                object value;

                try
                {
                    value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            obj,
                            null);
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (value == null)
                    continue;

                Type valueType;

                try
                {
                    valueType =
                        value.GetType();
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (IsSimpleType(
                    valueType))
                {
                    text.Append(
                        property.Name);

                    text.Append("=");

                    text.Append(
                        SafeToString(
                            value));

                    text.Append(" | ");
                }
                else if (depth < maxDepth)
                {
                    string nested =
                        GetDeepReadableText(
                            value,
                            depth + 1,
                            maxDepth);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        nested))
                    {
                        text.Append(
                            property.Name);

                        text.Append("={");

                        text.Append(
                            nested);

                        text.Append("} | ");
                    }
                }
            }

            return text.ToString();
        }

        private static bool ShouldSkipRelationshipProperty(
            string name)
        {
            string[] skip =
            {
                "Parent",
                "Owner",
                "Container",
                "Composition",
                "HmiSoftware",
                "Screen",
                "ScreenItems",
                "Device",
                "DeviceItem",
                "Hardware",
                "Project",
                "TiaPortal"
            };

            foreach (
                string value
                in skip)
            {
                if (string.Equals(
                    value,
                    name,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // NATIVE EXPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static List<string> InvokeNativeExport(
            object exportObject,
            string directory,
            string baseName)
        {
            if (exportObject == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(exportObject));
            }

            DirectoryInfo destination =
                new DirectoryInfo(
                    directory);

            MethodInfo exportMethod =
                GetNativeExportMethod(
                    exportObject.GetType());

            if (exportMethod == null)
            {
                throw new NotSupportedException(
                    "Keine unterstützte Export-Methode gefunden.");
            }

            object returnValue;

            ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                exportMethod.GetParameters();

            if (parameters.Length == 2)
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination,
                            MakeSafeName(
                                baseName)
                        });
            }
            else
            {
                returnValue =
                    exportMethod.Invoke(
                        exportObject,
                        new object[]
                        {
                            destination
                        });
            }

            List<string> result =
                new List<string>();

            IEnumerable returnedFiles =
                returnValue as IEnumerable;

            if (returnedFiles != null)
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in returnedFiles)
                {
                    FileInfo file =
                        item as FileInfo;

                    if (file == null)
                        continue;

                    if (!result.Contains(
                            file.FullName))
                    {
                        result.Add(
                            file.FullName);
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach (
                string file
                in GetAllFiles(
                    directory))
            {
                if (!result.Contains(
                    file))
                {
                    result.Add(
                        file);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static MethodInfo GetNativeExportMethod(
            Type exportType)
        {
            MethodInfo cachedMethod;

            if (NativeExportMethodCache.TryGetValue(
                    exportType,
                    out cachedMethod))
            {
                return cachedMethod;
            }

            MethodInfo oneParameter =
                null;

            MethodInfo twoParameters =
                null;

            foreach (
                MethodInfo method
                in exportType.GetMethods(
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance))
            {
                if (method.Name !=
                    "Export")
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ParameterInfo[] parameters =
                    method.GetParameters();

                if (parameters.Length == 2 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo) &&
                    parameters[1].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(string))
                {
                    twoParameters =
                        method;

                    break;
                }

                if (parameters.Length == 1 &&
                    parameters[0].ParameterType ==
                    typeof(DirectoryInfo))
                {
                    oneParameter =
                        method;
                }
            }

            MethodInfo selectedMethod =
                twoParameters ??
                oneParameter;

            if (selectedMethod != null)
            {
                NativeExportMethodCache[
                    exportType] =
                    selectedMethod;
            }

            return selectedMethod;
        }

        private static List<string> GetAllFiles(
            string directory)
        {
            List<string> files =
                new List<string>();

            if (!Directory.Exists(
                directory))
            {
                return files;
            }

            files.AddRange(
                Directory.GetFiles(
                    directory,
                    "*",
                    SearchOption.AllDirectories));

            return files;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SOFTWARE DETECTION
        // ============================================================

        private static PlcSoftware GetPlcSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    bool plugged =
                        false;

                    try
                    {
                        plugged =
                            deviceItem.IsPlugged;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    if (!plugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as PlcSoftware;

                            if (plcSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return plcSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static HmiSoftware GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
            HardwareObject hardwareObject)
        {
            Queue<HardwareObject> queue =
                new Queue<HardwareObject>();

            queue.Enqueue(
                hardwareObject);

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                HardwareObject current =
                    queue.Dequeue();

                foreach (
                    DeviceItem deviceItem
                    in current.Items)
                {
                    bool plugged =
                        false;

                    try
                    {
                        plugged =
                            deviceItem.IsPlugged;
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    if (!plugged)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        SoftwareContainer container =
                            deviceItem.GetService
                                <SoftwareContainer>();

                        if (container != null)
                        {
                            HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                                container.Software
                                as HmiSoftware;

                            if (hmiSoftware != null)
                            {
                                return hmiSoftware;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }

                    queue.Enqueue(
                        deviceItem);
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        // REFLECTION / HELPERS
        // ============================================================

        private static object GetPropertyValueStrict(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(
                    nameof(obj));
            }

            PropertyInfo property =
                obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                    propertyName,
                    BindingFlags.Public |
                    BindingFlags.Instance);

            if (property == null)
            {
                throw new MissingMemberException(
                    obj.GetType().FullName,
                    propertyName);
            }

            if (!property.CanRead)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Eigenschaft {propertyName} " +
                    $"ist nicht lesbar.");
            }

            return property.GetValue(
                obj,
                null);
        }

        private static object GetPropertyValue(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return null;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        propertyName,
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return null;
                }

                return property.GetValue(
                    obj,
                    null);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string SafeEngineeringName(
            object obj,
            string fallback)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return fallback;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    obj.GetType().GetProperty(
                        "Name",
                        BindingFlags.Public |
                        BindingFlags.Instance);

                if (property == null ||
                    !property.CanRead)
                {
                    return fallback;
                }

                object value =
                    property.GetValue(
                        obj,
                        null);

                if (value == null)
                    return fallback;

                string text =
                    value.ToString();

                return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    text)
                    ? fallback
                    : text;
            }
            catch
            {
                return fallback;
            }
        }

        private static string GetStringProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string GetObjectNameProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            if (value == null)
                return "";

            string name =
                GetStringProperty(
                    value,
                    "Name");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return name;
            }

            return SafeToString(
                value);
        }

        private static string GetDynamicAttribute(
            object obj,
            string attributeName)
        {
            try
            {
                IEngineeringObject engineeringObject =
                    obj as IEngineeringObject;

                if (engineeringObject == null)
                    return "";

                object value =
                    engineeringObject.GetAttribute(
                        attributeName);

                return value == null
                    ? ""
                    : SafeToString(
                        value);
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeProperty(
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            object value =
                GetPropertyValue(
                    obj,
                    propertyName);

            return value == null
                ? ""
                : SafeToString(
                    value);
        }

        private static string SafeTypeName(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return obj.GetType().FullName;
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string SafeTypeShortName(
            object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return obj.GetType().Name;
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static int GetCollectionCount(
            object collection)
        {
            if (collection == null)
                return 0;

            try
            {
                PropertyInfo property =
                    collection
                        .GetType()
                        .GetProperty(
                            "Count");

                if (property != null)
                {
                    object value =
                        property.GetValue(
                            collection,
                            null);

                    if (value != null)
                    {
                        return Convert.ToInt32(
                            value);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            IEnumerable enumerable =
                collection as IEnumerable;

            if (enumerable == null)
                return 0;

            int count =
                0;

            try
            {
                foreach (
                    object item
                    in enumerable)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static bool IsSimpleType(
            Type type)
        {
            return
                type.IsPrimitive ||
                type.IsEnum ||
                type == typeof(string) ||
                type == typeof(decimal) ||
                type == typeof(DateTime) ||
                type == typeof(TimeSpan) ||
                type == typeof(Guid);
        }

        private static string SafeToString(
            object value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            try
            {
                return value.ToString();
            }
            catch
            {
                return "";
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeSingleLine(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "";

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Replace("\t", " ");
        }

        private static void TryAppendCount(
            StringBuilder text,
            string name,
            object collection)
        {
            text.AppendLine(
                $"{name}: " +
                $"{GetCollectionCount(collection)}");
        }

        private static Exception UnwrapException(
            Exception ex)
        {
            while (
                ex is TargetInvocationException &&
                ex.InnerException != null)
            {
                ex =
                    ex.InnerException;
            }

            return ex;
        }

        private static void AppendCsvValue(
            StringBuilder csv,
            string value)
        {
            csv.Append(
                Csv(
                    value));

            csv.Append(";");
        }

        private static void AppendCsvProperty(
            StringBuilder csv,
            object obj,
            string propertyName)
        {
            AppendCsvValue(
                csv,
                GetStringProperty(
                    obj,
                    propertyName));
        }

        private static void AddUnique(
            List<string> list,
            string value)
        {
            if (list == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!list.Contains(
                    value))
            {
                list.Add(
                    value);
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsText(
            string source,
            string search)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    source) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    search))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return source.IndexOf(
                search,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // ============================================================
        // TIMING
        // ============================================================

        private static string FormatDuration(
            TimeSpan duration)
        {
            if (duration.TotalSeconds <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalMilliseconds
                    .ToString("0") +
                    " ms";
            }

            if (duration.TotalMinutes <
                1.0)
            {
                return
                    duration.TotalSeconds
                    .ToString("0.000") +
                    " s";
            }

            return
                duration.ToString(
                    @"hh\:mm\:ss\.fff");
        }

        // REPORT
        // ============================================================

        private static void AddReport(
            string category,
            string device,
            string objectName,
            string objectType,
            string status,
            string details)
        {
            ReportEntries.Add(
                new ReportEntry
                {
                    Category =
                        category ?? "",

                    Device =
                        device ?? "",

                    ObjectName =
                        objectName ?? "",

                    ObjectType =
                        objectType ?? "",

                    Status =
                        status ?? "",

                    Details =
                        details ?? ""
                });
        }

        private static void WriteReport(
            string archiveRoot)
        {
            string reportFile =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "90_Report",
                    "ExportReport.csv");

            StringBuilder csv =
                new StringBuilder();

            csv.AppendLine(
                "Category;Device;ObjectName;" +
                "ObjectType;Status;Details");

            foreach (
                ReportEntry entry
                in ReportEntries)
            {
                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Category);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Device);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectName);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.ObjectType);

                AppendCsvValue(
                    csv,
                    entry.Status);

                csv.Append(
                    Csv(
                        entry.Details));

                csv.AppendLine();
            }

            File.WriteAllText(
                reportFile,
                csv.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private static string MakeSafeName(
            string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                name))
            {
                return "Unnamed";
            }

            string result =
                name.Trim();

            foreach (
                char invalidChar
                in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                result =
                    result.Replace(
                        invalidChar,
                        '_');
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static string Csv(
            string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return "\"\"";

            return "\"" +
                   value.Replace(
                       "\"",
                       "\"\"") +
                   "\"";
        }

# you asked

message time: 2026-10-27 08:12:19

Das blöde ist jetzt halt, dass immer die HMI-Instanz beendet wird im Hintergrund?

---

# chatgpt response

Ja — **wenn du mit „HMI-Instanz“ die laufende TIA-Portal-Instanz meinst, dann ist das sehr wahrscheinlich genau das Problem mit unserem aktuellen `using (TiaPortal ...)`**.

Siemens dokumentiert für V21, dass `Dispose()` bei einer angehängten `TiaPortal`-Instanz die Verbindung trennt bzw. die zugehörige TIA-Instanz schließen kann. Unser `using` ruft am Ende automatisch `Dispose()` auf. ([Totally Integrated Automation](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/tia-portal-openness-api-for-automation-of-engineering-workflows/tia-portal-openness-api/general-functions/diagnostic-interfaces-on-tia-portal?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Das heißt: Dieser Teil ist für dein Szenario ungünstig:

```csharp
using (TiaPortal tiaPortal = processes[0].Attach())
{
    ...
}
```

Wenn unser Programm normal endet **oder wegen einer Exception aus dem Block herausläuft**, wird `Dispose()` ausgeführt. Dadurch kann deine laufende TIA-Instanz beendet bzw. die Session getrennt werden. Das passt zu dem Verhalten, das du beobachtest. ([Totally Integrated Automation](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/tia-portal-openness-api-for-automation-of-engineering-workflows/tia-portal-openness-api/general-functions/terminating-the-connection-to-the-tia-portal?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Wichtig ist außerdem: Eine `EngineeringObjectDisposedException` allein bedeutet nicht zwingend, dass TIA abgestürzt ist. Siemens beschreibt sie auch für Objekte, die schlicht nicht mehr gültig sind. Eine echte nicht wiederherstellbare Situation wäre eher eine `NonRecoverableException`; diese kann TIA tatsächlich schließen. ([Totally Integrated Automation](https://docs.tia.siemens.cloud/r/en-us/v21/tia-portal-openness-api-for-automation-of-engineering-workflows/tia-portal-openness-api/exceptions/handling-exceptions?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Was wir ändern sollten

Für unseren Exporter, der sich an **eine bereits vom Benutzer geöffnete TIA-Instanz anhängt**, würde ich `TiaPortal` künftig **nicht mehr über `using` automatisch disposen**.

Stattdessen ungefähr:

```csharp
TiaPortal tiaPortal = null;

try
{
    tiaPortal = processes[0].Attach();

    // Export
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    // Fehlerbehandlung
}

/*
 * Absichtlich kein tiaPortal.Dispose(),
 * weil wir eine bereits laufende Benutzerinstanz
 * nicht beenden wollen.
 */
```

Das ist für unser Werkzeug deutlich sinnvoller: **Das Archivprogramm darf TIA nicht schließen.**

Einen Punkt würde ich dabei sauber trennen: Wir sollten später optional unterscheiden zwischen:

- **Attach-Modus:** Benutzer hat TIA bereits geöffnet → niemals automatisch schließen.
- **Headless-Modus:** unser Tool startet selbst eine eigene TIA-Instanz → am Ende gezielt `Dispose()`.

So wäre das auch für die spätere V19/V20/V21-Adapterstruktur sauber.

using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;

using Siemens.Engineering;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW;
using Siemens.Engineering.HW.Features;
using Siemens.Engineering.SW;
using Siemens.Engineering.SW.Blocks;
using Siemens.Engineering.HmiUnified;

namespace TiaOpennessTest
{
    internal class Program
    {
        private static readonly List<ReportEntry> ReportEntries =
            new List<ReportEntry>();

        private static readonly Dictionary<Type, MethodInfo>
            NativeExportMethodCache =
                new Dictionary<Type, MethodInfo>();

        // ============================================================
        // COUNTERS
        // ============================================================

        private static int PlcCount;
        private static int HmiCount;

        private static int PlcBlocksExported;
        private static int PlcBlocksFailed;

        private static int HmiScriptFilesExported;
        private static int HmiScriptExportsFailed;

        private static int HmiTagTablesExported;
        private static int HmiTagTablesFailed;
        private static int HmiTagFilesExported;
        private static int HmiTagsDocumented;

        private static int HmiConnectionsDocumented;

        private static int HmiScreensDocumented;
        private static int HmiRootScreensDocumented;
        private static int HmiGroupedScreensDocumented;
        private static int HmiScreenGroupsDocumented;

        private static int HmiScreenItemsDocumented;
        private static int HmiScreenEventsDocumented;
        private static int HmiDynamizationsDocumented;
        private static int HmiPropertyEventsDocumented;
        private static int HmiScreenDocumentationFailed;

        private static int HardwareDevicesDocumented;
        private static int HardwareItemsDocumented;
        private static int HardwareErrors;

        private static int RelationshipsDocumented;
        private static int RelationshipsResolvedToPlc;
        private static int RelationshipsUnresolved;
        private static int RelationshipScreenUsages;

        private static int RelationshipSystemTags;
        private static int RelationshipInternalTags;
        private static int RelationshipPlcReferenceUnresolved;
        private static int RelationshipConnectionUnresolved;

        // ============================================================
        // TIMINGS
        // ============================================================

        private static TimeSpan TotalDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HardwareDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan PlcDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan HmiScriptsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiTagTablesDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiTagsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiConnectionsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan HmiScreensDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;

        private static TimeSpan RelationshipsDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan ConnectionIndexDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan UsageIndexDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;
        private static TimeSpan RelationshipWriteDuration = TimeSpan.Zero;

        // ============================================================
        // MAIN
        // ============================================================

        private static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

            try
            {
                RunExport();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Exception actual =
                    UnwrapException(ex);

                Console.WriteLine();
                Console.WriteLine("SCHWERER FEHLER:");
                Console.WriteLine(actual.GetType().FullName);
                Console.WriteLine(actual.Message);
                Console.WriteLine(actual.StackTrace);
            }
        }

        private static void RunExport()
        {
            Stopwatch totalWatch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            var processes =
                TiaPortal.GetProcesses();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Gefundene TIA-Instanzen: {processes.Count}");

            if (processes.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Keine laufende TIA-Instanz gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            /*
             * WICHTIG:
             * Wir hängen uns an eine bereits vom Benutzer geöffnete
             * TIA-Portal-Instanz an. Deshalb absichtlich KEIN using
             * und KEIN Dispose(). Der Exporter darf diese Instanz
             * beim Programmende oder bei einer Exception nicht schließen.
             */
            TiaPortal tiaPortal =
                processes[0].Attach();

            if (tiaPortal.Projects.Count == 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(
                    "Kein geöffnetes Projekt gefunden.");

                return;
            }

            Project project =
                tiaPortal.Projects[0];

            string projectName =
                SafeEngineeringName(
                    project,
                    "UnnamedProject");

            Console.WriteLine();
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Projekt: {projectName}");

            string archiveRoot =
                CreateArchiveRoot(
                    projectName);

            Console.WriteLine();
            Console.WriteLine("Archivziel:");
            Console.WriteLine(archiveRoot);
            Console.WriteLine();

            CreateBaseDirectories(
                archiveRoot);

            WriteProjectInfo(
                archiveRoot,
                project);

            /*
             * Siemens-Collections dürfen nicht minutenlang über einen
             * offenen Enumerator verarbeitet werden. Deshalb wird die
             * Device-Collection sofort vollständig in eine normale
             * List<Device> materialisiert.
             */
            List<Device> devices =
                SnapshotProjectDevices(
                    project);

            Stopwatch watch =
                Stopwatch.StartNew();

            ExportHardware(
                archiveRoot,
                devices);

            watch.Stop();

            HardwareDuration +=
                watch.Elapsed;

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"  [Zeit Hardware: " +
                $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

            Console.WriteLine();

            List<PlcReference> plcReferences =
                BuildPlcReferences(
                    devices);

            foreach (Device device in devices)
            {
                string deviceName =
                    SafeEngineeringName(
                        device,
                        "<unbekanntes Gerät>");

                PlcSoftware plcSoftware =
                    GetPlcSoftware(
                        device);

                if (plcSoftware != null)
                {
                    string plcSoftwareName =
                        SafeEngineeringName(
                            plcSoftware,
                            "<unbekannte PLC>");

                    watch =
                        Stopwatch.StartNew();

                    ExportPlc(
                        archiveRoot,
                        plcSoftwareName,
                        plcSoftware);

                    watch.Stop();

                    PlcDuration +=
                        watch.Elapsed;

                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"  [Zeit PLC {plcSoftwareName}: " +
                        $"{FormatDuration(watch.Elapsed)}]");

                    Console.WriteLine();
                }

                HmiSoftware hmiSoftware =
                    GetUnifiedHmiSoftware(
                        device);

                if (hmiSoftware != null)
                {
                    string hmiSoftwareName =
                        SafeEngineeringName(
                            hmiSoftware,
                            "<unbekannte HMI-Software>");

                    ExportHmi(
                        archiveRoot,
                        deviceName,
                        hmiSoftwareName,
                        hmiSoftware,
                        plcReferences);
                }
            }

            WriteReport(
                archiveRoot);

            totalWatch.Stop();

            TotalDuration =
                totalWatch.Elapsed;

            WriteSummary(
                archiveRoot);
        }

        private static string CreateArchiveRoot(

        {

        private static void WriteProjectInfo(
            string archiveRoot,
            Project project)
        {
            string file =
                Path.Combine(
                    archiveRoot,
                    "00_Project",
                    "ProjectInfo.txt");

            StringBuilder text =
                new StringBuilder();

            text.AppendLine(
                "TIA Project Archive");

            text.AppendLine(
                "===================");

            text.AppendLine();

            text.AppendLine(
                $"Projektname: " +
                $"{SafeEngineeringName(project, "<unbekannt>")}");

            try
            {
                text.AppendLine(
                    $"Projektpfad: {project.Path}");

            catch

            text.AppendLine(
                ".NET Framework: 4.8");

            File.WriteAllText(
                file,
                text.ToString(),
                Encoding.UTF8);
        }
